reviews.author: Explore45295559387
reviews.title: Khyber offers world class luxury experience. A Must visit hotel
reviews.text:
I am writing to share my feedback following my recent stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa. I was thoroughly impressed with the world-class luxury and the relaxing ambience your property offers.

The hospitality, ambience, dining and activities options were truly exceptional, but what stood out most was the professional conduct of their team. I would like to specifically commend The General Manager Mr. Vinit and his team leaders, including Manzoor Akhtar Khan; as well as staff members Feroz and Arif. They ensured that every detail was attended to, helping us create wonderful memories during our stay.

Please share my sincere appreciation with the entire team for their impressive service and dedication.

Best regards,

Vikas Sharma

reviews.author: Vikram Galoth
reviews.title: None
reviews.text: Loved our stay at The Khyber Resort & Spa, Gulmarg. The property is beautifully maintained, rooms are cozy and elegant, and the surroundings are stunning. reviews.author: Pk M
reviews.title: Good property only for views but staff is not polite and rude
reviews.text:
Currently staying in Khyber hotel Gulmarg property is very good only for scenic views but the most important thing staying in a 5star property is staff respect how they make your stay remembrance.. If my message is being read by the management please train your staff and teach them to treat your guests like God that after checkout they only say wow what a  stay. 

Most important the dinner buffet..  staying in kashmir we expect to taste local kashmiri food but here you get the same food what you get in a normal hotel.. buffet  experience for dinner I would rate 1/10..

Even outside the hotel you get local kashmiri food which is far better than the hyped created by *Khyber*

reviews.author: smartjanki
reviews.title: Khyber in all it's glory
reviews.text:
The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa is truly an experience that stays with you long after you leave.Qe booked this resort  to celebrate our anniversary and the hotel took my soul to beautiful fairy land.From the very first moment, the warmth and generosity of the staff stood out—they were courteous, attentive, and always ready to help with genuine smiles, making us feel completely at home. (Nazma was welcoming staff from the front desk)The food was another highlight: delicious, thoughtfully prepared, and offering an impressive variety of spreads that catered to every taste, making each meal a delight.Junaid and Firsous left no stone unturned to pamper us with yummy food and service.Junaid a very polite and professional restaurant manager offered a memorable cake cutting experience by the lobby side with love rabab music .
Housekeeping was impeccable, with well-maintained rooms and excellent amenities that reflected luxury and comfort in every detail.
 The spa experience(shwa facial and body spa) was deeply relaxing and rejuvenating,Mary offered an amazing spa therapy ,and the heated pool was pure bliss—floating there surrounded by snow felt like one of life’s best experiences. Adding to this magic was the breathtaking snowfall and the stunning natural beauty all around, turning every moment into a picture-perfect memory.
The room itself was nothing short of spectacular, with snow-clad views right outside the glass windows and plush, elegant interiors inside. Waking up to that view felt surreal. Overall, The Khyber is not just a stay but a complete luxury escape—where comfort, nature, and exceptional hospitality come together beautifully.

reviews.author: Armaan Mehra
reviews.title: Beautiful stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Had the opportunity to spend two beautiful nights at Khyber Gulmarg. We stayed in a Himalayan View Cottage, and woke up to views of the Pir Panjal range and surrounding alpine forests! 

The property itself is stunning! The architecture  feels both grand and cozy. 
The location is a big plus - the hotel is very close to the Gulmarg Gondola, and the station is just a short walk away. 

All the staff members were very sweet and kind. I wish I could remember everyone's names. I'd like to mention Muskan at the front desk, she was responsible for our check-in. I'd like to thank Rafi from the housekeeping team and Firdaus at the restaurant. 

My favourite part of the hotel was the food! I really loved everything I tasted. The buffet  had  countless options and everything tasted great!  

Overall, a memorable stay, and we’re grateful to the entire Khyber team for their warm hospitality. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Sarvagya
reviews.title: More Than a Stay — A Memory for a Lifetime at The Khyber
reviews.text:
Our stay at The Khyber, Gulmarg was not just a holiday—it was an experience that touched our hearts.
From the very first moment, we were surrounded by warmth, care, and genuine hospitality. Every smile, every gesture, and every interaction made us feel like we were not guests, but family. The love and affection shown towards our 3-year-old son was especially moving and something we will forever remember.

A heartfelt thank you to Mr. Irfan (Duty Executive) and Mr. Ishfaq (Duty Manager)—your kindness, attentiveness, and personal touch made our stay truly special. You both went beyond your roles to ensure comfort, happiness, and beautiful memories for us.

A very special mention to Mr. Varun from the F&B team—such a warm, humble, and genuinely caring soul. His politeness, smile, and the way he connected with us added an emotional depth to our dining experience that words can hardly express.

The Khyber gave us something far greater than luxury—it gave us moments of joy, comfort, and connection that will stay with us for a lifetime. These are memories we will carry in our hearts forever.
Thank you, Team Khyber, for making our stay unforgettable. ❤️

After searching, didn't find, again called, then somebody else says that they don't serve in the room. This wasted a lot of time. Spa was exceptional! A must-try. Pool water was too hot for me, couldn't open eyes and swim. There is a kids playroom also. Overall a lot of things to do. Breakfast spread was good. Heating system is perfect.

reviews.author: araustin
reviews.title: The Khyber - Paradise in midst of the Paradise
reviews.text:
Kashmir has been always on our bucket list for years and finally this year in Jan 2025 we managed to fulfill this long overdue holiday wish through Gulmarg. The Khyber Himalayan resort has been certainly one of the most memorable stays we have experienced. Lovely beautiful property midst the snow capped mountains and valley. Great ambience, food, service and comfort. Our 4 year toddler enjoyed the stay, played a lot with the snow and had a blast in the heated indoor pool. 

To top it off, we had Khurshid pick us up and drop us back in Srinagar. A very safe pair of hands, kind and helpful. Despite the snowy conditions Khurshid skilfully drove through the valley. He also had a lot of good suggestions to explore while in Gulmarg. Also played a big hand making this all worthwhile. 

Certainly looking forward to visiting Gulmarg and staying in The Khyber again.

reviews.author: SNATH
reviews.title: Overrated paradise!
reviews.text:
Location - 5/5 
Mesmerizing view of the valley 

Food- 3.5/5 
Flavourful kasimiri wazwan served cold. 
Breakfast spread was good but most dishes served at the buffet were again cold.

Service & Hospitality-2/5 - 
Check in & check out experience below average. The staff their seem to have a very casual attitude. 

Cleanliness- 1/5
we booked a Himalayan view luxury room for 2 nights.
We found a bunch of hair in our bathroom at the time of check in. Bathroom was flooded on both days due plumbing issues. 

Swimming Pool -2/5
 The swimming pool is supposed to be their USP. The view from the pool area is spectacular and perfect for creating a great photo album. The hotel claims the water is heated but the water was not even luke warm. With snowfall and minus temperatures outside we were expecting to enjoy a swim in the heated pool. BIG DISAPPOINTMENT!!!

Overall, the property is great to stay at for just 1 night. Enjoy the views and multiple  photo ops. The hotel felt like a prison on day 2 as there is not too much to do at the property itself. The hotel has no in house activities or music night planned for their guests for entertainment. There is no alcohol served at the hotel. They have no contract with vendors for guests to enjoy ATV rides or other activities. Even an evening with bonfire and heaters at their Cafe is on chargeable basis which is to be booked in advance. Rooms are extremely noisy, we could hear people talking in the room opposite to ours. 

This group of hotels has a lot to learn in terms of  hospitality, customer service and satisfaction from its contemporaries like Taj and Oberoi.

Special mention for the staff at the reception area and especially Mr. Hilal who took us around this amazing property with love and affection. Found him to be very courteous and a very well behaved person.
Last but not the least this resort is at par with best of resorts  anywhere in the world.

reviews.author: ushma
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text:
The hotel is extremely  well managed and maintained by army of staff.
Every nook and corner I saw someone cleaning, dusting or polishing always.
The buffet is well balanced with something for all and the live counters of chaat are a favourite. 
The italian restaurant  has a nice fine dine feel to it.
The breakfast also is prompt and wholesome.
The pool has a killer view and for me was the highlight of the stay.
The resort is quite close to the gondola so you can do your activities there which need to be booked online.
If in gulmarg then definitely  khyber!!!

reviews.author: Rashmika
reviews.title: Sincere Feedback.. Extremely Thankful to Mr. Rafi The worthy Manager!!!
reviews.text:
Very peaceful place to stay, excellent staff , greatly taken care by Mr. Rafi.. We arrived at the property in freezing cold weather but were soon warmed by the hospitality of Mr Rafi.. He is just beyond amazing,, would rate his hospitality at par with the other properties we had been till now!! How well managed his team is... Each guest is warmly welcomed with a cup of kehwa... The rooms and other areas inside and out of the property are extremely cosy and one can roam around wearing just a kurta while its freezing at sub zero temperature outside... We are extremely thankful to Mr. Rafi  who was continuously checking on us i may say multiple times every single day our stay!!.. Can't get enough of your hospitality.. Mr Rafi and his team are superstars in their commitment to work... 

🙏🙏🙏Highly Obliged

reviews.author: Rakesh lightwale
reviews.title: What a breathtaking Property!!!
reviews.text:
Everything there is plastered !!
What a beauty,,If you are yearning for solace you must hold yourself in this alluring Property for the reason that it bestow us with the harmonious or we can say peaceable views,,,when you stand in the gallery of the rooms holding a hot cup of tea, you feel lost throughout the time moreover when you find the crew  hardworking ,well mannered, amiable and hospitable you feel more peaceful and special!! 
We particularly I am very Thankful to  Mr. Rafi at the front desk who assisted us in our entire stay..He is a gem 💎 of a person honestly a rare Gem... Standing all the day to ensure we had a pleasant stay....He Treated my family  in a well manner and gave us so many memories to cherish...Thank you !!!!

reviews.author: charuratra
reviews.title: Awful Stay Experience!!
reviews.text:
Apparently wanted to write to GM. But you guys have not even put his email address on the site.

Started with a bad check-in experience where an hour before coming when I called the lady who answered, confirmed there is a hi-tea being served and will be there till 6pm. We reached at 5.40, asked where can we go for the hi-tea, the guy said there is no hi-tea and we must be mistaken, when told him that the female on the phone confirmed they said we can go and check the hi-tea area if we don’t believe. Kind of shocking how you guys talk to guests. Rather than apologising or arranging something you are saying go and check.

Next blunder was going for the Steam and Sauna. Area was not even clean and for the first time I couldn’t even take a shower and came to the room to take a shower as it was so dirty and wet everywhere. Steam was not even working even though temperature was 99 but it wasn’t effective at all. When told the lady she went inside the steam with her footwear’s. 

there were not even towels or bathrobes. The lady on the reception of Steam Sauna didn’t even bother to check or arrange. After asking for it she arranged it. 

Next was from the live pasta counter asked for a white sauce pasta and it came all cold, probably chef didn’t had enough time to cook it well. 

All in all doesn’t seems like this is one of the highest rated hotels in India. Probably just the location is the reason.

After staying with the best of the hotels in India, came with very high expectations but this is definitely not the place where customer service and quality of service exist.

Room No - 5004

reviews.author: Vikash
reviews.title: Winter abode in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
One of the best time in Kashmir was spent at Khyber,truly a Himalayan delight.we were greeted exceptionally well by the team and a welcome Kashmir Kawa was offered.Checkin Formalities we’re completed in 5 minutes for us though the hotel was super busy with incoming guest.Kudos to the front office guy Taher.

Our stay and room were super.We came to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary and this Himalayan delight lived up to its expectations.Our room was beautifully decorated by the House keeping team and a complimentary cake was kept in our room to make us feel special.

Views of snow kept mountains from the room are mesmerising and you don’t feel like going away.

They have a excellent swimming pool and one must not miss taking a dip in it ,it’s the best tho g you can have in a freezing cold there.Heated pool will make you very comfortable and the view from pool is outstanding.

Food is excellent and they have a wide variety to choose from.though Iam not a foodie so didn’t try much.

One must try their coffee shop ,they have wide variety to choose from one and make amazing coffees.

Overall it was a great experience for us at Khyber and we look forward to come back soon to this winter delight.

reviews.author: Jil A
reviews.title: Khyber with amazing staff
reviews.text: I would like to thank Khyber for amazing stay . Beautiful property and amazing views. Special thanks to Asif Hussain - airport representative for Khyber. Amazing service. One of our baggage didn’t arrive to Srinagar. He very nicely handled the situation and made sure we got our bag at the hotel as soon as possible. Also helped us a lot at the airport making everything smooth. Thank you so much and also all the staff at Khyber took good care of us

reviews.author: Abhishek Jain
reviews.title: Best hospitality
reviews.text: One of the finest properties. Especially the food out here. Cherry on a cake is the hospitality of Mr Imtiaz. Whatever we ask, he smiles and serves it. Kudos to him and his complete team. Whenever you come here, do call his name. Thank me later.

reviews.author: drkakkar
reviews.title: Enchanting & a Surreal experience..
reviews.text:
Though we have been to Gulmarg almost 5 years back, but a visit in winters was long pending. The stay in Khyber too was on the bucket list and the resort lived upto our expectations and beyond.
We,a family of four stayed in the property last week and didn't feel like leaving after spending two nights there!
The check in was seamless and Tahir at Front Office gave us a guided tour and explained the facilities available in the resort. The room was cosy, ambience great and the huge window gave us a mesmerizing view of the snow and lovely pine trees. The heating was adequate and the housekeeping staff was courteous, helpful and available with a smile at our beck and call. As the sofa-cum-bed was small for us due to our height, they readily arranged an extra bed for us.
The restraunt gives a beautiful view of valley and snow covered fields, but you need to be seated near the windows for the same. Breakfast time the place is crowded and sometimes difficult to manage by the staff. 
Once pointed out the problem, Mr Bilal, the F&B Incharge took care of us personally and even arranged stuffed paranthas for us, though it wasn't there in the buffet menu. Bilal needs a special mention, who doesn't shy away from any responsibility and was seen to tend the tables, when his colleagues were busy with guests. His presence in restaurant was comforting. The food is tasty and buffet had good variety.
Varun is the second person in F&B who impressed us with his calm demeanor and bubbly personality. He manages newly opened Italian affair, Brava, and the place is really warm and cosy with some nice delicacies to offer. He made us feel special and helped in selection of the dishes there. We met SuperChef Devraj in Brava and were impressed with his culinary skills.
Mr Manzoor Khan at FO also managed the show with ease and confidence.

The all weather pool is something to experience definitely. Myself and the kids enjoyed the pool, jacuzzi and steam bath there.

Overall, we had an entralling stay here. Every nook and corner is well planned, the staff is extremely courteous and available to help. Though the Khyber is synonymous with Gulmarg now-a-days, still all the working hands were down to earth and helpful.

We would love to stay there again and enjoy the beauty of Gulmarg!

reviews.author: AnkitBaid
reviews.title: Beautiful property but absolutely poor service and customer service attitude does not exist.
reviews.text:

Room Service:
a. Poor clearing of the rooms and bathrooms. WC were dirty throughout our stay
b. Tea Not refilled.
c. Coffee not present in the room even after reminders
d. Hand shower + over head shower work together. No way to stop one.

Games Room

b. Foosball table non functional because of lack of balls

SPA
a. Reception extremely rude and unprofessional

reviews.author: V P
reviews.title: Excellent stay with excellent staff!
reviews.text: We travel-led as a couple to celebrate our first anniversary. manzoor  from the front office helped in providing us a lovely room with the most stunning views of Himalaya.. In room dining and housekeeping staff went above and beyond to fulfill all our whims for an unforgettable dinner and experience. Must must visit.

reviews.author: Abhishek C
reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for our anniversary. After much trying we got a reservation at the hotel and we were very excited to stay. The hotel indeed is beautiful but we were disappointed with our stay. Probably the hotel is overbooked but hospitality, cleanliness was horrid. 

1. The room heating was adjusted at 31 degrees. After feeling suffocated I called the reception and the man came after 3 hours to adjust it after repeatedly calling. We literally had to freeze to death as we were suffocated in our room. 

2. I came back after ski-ing and our room was apparently done but dirty wine glasses remained. Creamer was spilled and the bathroom was dirty. 

3. We booked a spa and they cancelled our reservation without informing us! This was ridiculous as we rushed back for the appointment from skiing. 

4. We requested for a private hot fire dinner and they kept diverting us from one person to the other.the dining restaurant get like a dorm mess during dinner with too many people and no COVID protocols. Food is over priced and takes long to come. I also waited for 30 mins for my dosa at breakfast, which ultimately didn’t come.

5. Next e come to the Shisha lounge and they tell us that Shisha’s are all over when again we had messaged and requested for it ! Again another one.. 

I kept trying to get kn touch with the manager but they kept diverting us from one perosn to the other. 

Why is the hotel overbooked if they can’t accommodate guests? If I’m paying this amount I would like the hotel to accommodate us on experiences. Otherwise I would have just stayed at Highland Park ! The hotel is overhyped and is monopolising being the only 5 star here. 

The best part of our Gulmarg experience was the 2 day skiing and the gondola. The local instructors and the tour guides are very sweet and click a lot of pictures for you. Yes amaing ones ! And there is Yaseen bhai who has a shop outside highland park hotel - he is an awesome tour guide. Do yourself a favour, save 35K a night and stay at Highland Park.

reviews.author: dhariwalamit

reviews.author: Shubham
reviews.title: excellent property but service needs to improve
reviews.text:
4 star is just for the sake of property which is just humongous and beautiful, its grandeur will leave you in aww and services built within is just shocking, specially the centrally heated pool. Though we didn't opt for spa service but apparently they provide great service.

Coming to service they fall really short of the  benchmark expected since you pay such a premium and hefty price to stay here. few instances of poor service during our stay -
- it was snowing heavily on our check in day and our cab couldn't make it up their slope so I called reception (which takes forever to answer) to send us any 4x4 vehicle of their property which we were absolutely denied without any hesitation. Similar incident was taken care so well by ITC pine and peak in Pahalgam where they volunteered to drop us during heavy snow.
- Room service was just garbage, everything took longer than usual to be executed, they didn't have candles in their housekeeping, housekeeping staff lost one of our lens case during clean up which was left on washbasin counter, we were denied to eat fresh fruits from breakfast buffet as we were checking out early though they provided us with packed breakfast.

such incidents at budget/mid range hotels are acceptable but it is not expected from property such as this which boasts about being one of the best winter property in world.

All the outdoor activities like ATV, sking, Gondola were within walking distance of hardly 5-7 mins. Other than that, the facilities provided by the Hotel were numerous. You cannot miss taking a dip in the pool when you are in Khyber; you will be astounded by the beauty of it.
Furthermore, you can enjoy watching a movie at the in-house theatre or playing billiards with your friends. One of the most beautiful places to be at during holidays. I cannot wait to revisit this place and soak in its beauty.   
Thank you Khyber, for making my trip so memorable!

reviews.author: Abhinava C
reviews.title: Home@Khyber
reviews.text: There are few places and people that make a lasting impression and Khyber definitely is on, this 29th Dec I landed in Gulmarg in a vehicle with broken ice chains without which you literally are skying on 4 wheels :-), cold as hell, I and my 15 yr old stood at the Khyber main porch. Ranjeet saw us struggling and took us in warmly, got us to a heated area and settled us down. Irfan being the humble soul he is …somehow managed a room when bookings all over Gulmarg were hitting the roof, the personal touch and care were phenomenal…Irfan is someone who can separate the wheat from the chaff, professional and caring to the core . These interventions made the trip memorable and a lasting memory forever. Cannot thank Ranjeet and Irfan enough for who they are and the unusual spirit they hold which is just so infectious and a pure humbling experience. Do well guys and promise to see you soon. Rgds/Abhi

reviews.author: Janaki Ganesh
reviews.title: Unforgettably amazing !!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Khyber to celebrate Christmas and New Year and our stay was a little over 2 weeks ! 
From the word get go, the stay was perfect ! The views from our balcony overlooking the snow clad mountains was nothing short of picture perfect. The rooms were luxurious, stocked with every possible amenity and the room service team was courteous and attentive. 
GM Mr Vinit Chabbra has done a spectacular job of running Khyber ranging from the exceptional buffet spreads to the incredibly efficient and responsible staff that goes out of their way to make your stay memorable. Mr Shyam who heads Food and Beverage put together a brilliant spread for Christmas and New Years with an unbeatable variety in dishes and desserts !! Mr Irfann Hussain from Front Office was incredibly helpful and guided us a lot with very useful tips and local information which made our stay and our outdoor activities extremely comfortable. He also went out of his way to address our every concern and query in the most perfect manner possible ! 
Will definitely be returning to Khyber for several more long stays in the near future.

reviews.author: Alekya

reviews.author: Srinivas Maganti
reviews.title: Breath Taking Views in Winter
reviews.text:
Was here for 4nights , the place is beyond imaginable , did not think a place like this existed in India.

Hotel staff are super friendly, special mention to Perray Firdous for making our stay more comfortable.

reviews.author: Pawan R
reviews.title: Harrasment from local govt authorities
reviews.text:
Police has no mercy on tourist. They made us walk for 1 km from gandola station to hotel. As there were some VIP at hotel. The temperature was -3° and I walked 1 km with my 3 yr old child.
If they have Vip at hotel, will they trouble amd harrash all other occupants and tourists staying at hotel ?
When asked to hotel management they gave flying answers.
This happened with me on 22nd January 2021.
Management shall ask local govt authorities to allow guests vehicles to the hotels. Or you have to walk 1km on steep mountain in very cold temperature.

I also felt hotel is more interested in Vip guests staying with them rather than other citizens

Think before you book.

reviews.author: Karan
reviews.title: Marvellous Experience !!
reviews.text:
Celebrated our 15th wedding anniversary at Khyber Gulmarg. Memorable indeed. The resort is huge and has the most spectacular views of the Himalayas. Rooms are really good & spacious and the bathrooms are a different world altogether.
The famous heated swimming pool was shut due to COVID but that gives a reason to definitely return back next year.
Great Staff - especially FIRDOUS at the restaurant is a gem of a person & very proactive.
There are numerous seating arrangements around the resort and their Kehwa drink is to die for.
But most importantly, when you travel to kashmir in harsh winters, there are many things which requires plan B just incase your original plan deviates due to flights & road disruptions. Heres where the travel agent plays the most important role. 
Highly recommend HIMALAYAN GLACIER agency Mr. Azharbhai 9205461904. 
Excellent planning & re-planning after my flights were postponed by 2 days. He took care of rebooking hotels, transfers & most importantly is very fast in arranging alternate options when its urgent. Very prompt response & friendly as well.
Overall great experience at KHYBER..  No wonder its packed for the next 2 months..
Keep up the good work guys !!

reviews.author: Sumit_Sarawgi
reviews.title: Mixed Emotions
reviews.text:
This review can be little long.

Khyber is a beautiful dream which you will always like to come true. The same thing happened with me. I got lucky to get a room here during my anniversary.

But, the starting of my trip was little upsetting. A small issue happened which could had been handled more professionally and in a more sincere manner which is expected from a star hotel like Khyber. But I think sometimes, you take it lightly and think you can get away with it. But I had to let it go and compromise as I didn't want to spoily 4 nights stay here. I had asked the reception that I wanted to meet the General Manager just to share my feelings but that never happened. I don't know what it was, ego or miscommunication

Secondly, for two consecutive nights, the hotel has blocked their restaurant "Calabash" for VIPs. This was the place where you can relax and have a great evening time when you have nothing to do in Gulmarg. Just think, guests who had come to stay here for 2 nights had no options to relax anywhere else except the lobby which was packed to the brim. Sorry but it felt like a marketplace there with no service as all the help was busy with the VIPs. This feels wrong when your other restaurant "Nouf" and other facilities like the swimming pool is closed due to covid.

Now the good part. The rooms are excellent and brilliant. The people helping you out in the restaurant and other places always have a smile. Special mention to Mr Raees and Mr Firdos who were commendable. The food here is amazing.

I think I will have to come back to experience the real Khyber which I have heard and dreamt of. Hopefully things change for the better..

reviews.author: Ravi Vashi Melwani
reviews.title: The most beautiful resort in INDIA
reviews.text: The Khyber resort Gulmarg  is the most beautiful resort in INDIA. Located in Gulmarg, Kashmir it is lead by  the most dynamic GM Vinit Chhabra accompanied by Front Officer Manager Manzoor, and the team who are  so inspired and motivated, making Khyber Himalayan Spa Resort, among the most amazing resorts that i have visited in  India

reviews.author: Vipul M
reviews.title: Review

We had little difficulty co-ordinating the reservations as they didn’t return calls quickly . But once we arrived we experienced the best of hospitality, excellent views & 5 star service .

reviews.author: Anushi Gupta
reviews.title: Kashmir trip
reviews.text: Its a very beautiful property with an amazing view..!! Welcoming wd traditional drink..and the lively lobby..!!! And wat all makes it more good, was the staff... very helpful staff..!! The only problem was wd my room bathroom.. pot seat was wobbling..when I called, the staff came and he repaired it. Bt, also informed us that it will again wobble coz its made of wood 🤔. Then, flush was broken and again, I had to call the housekeeping, staff came and repaired it. Then, there was some problem wd the bathtub washer,the water we filled was slowly slowly draining out 🙄 And then, wd the shower area.. hand shower was leaking all the time!!!! We had to called the HK everytime after using the shower..!!! And I won't say the staff didn't help.. they did there best.. however, I was surprised by one of the manager in lobby.. coz , when my husband told him bot the whole senerio, all he said was it is not there mistake its a technical mistake..!! As if we don't know that..🙈🤔 and there was no further help or enquiry from any management behalf!!! U guys really need to work on ur management level staff!!! Atleast some of them...!!

reviews.author: Pankit C
reviews.title: One of the best properties with the most most disappointing service
reviews.text:
We stayed at Khyber during the COVID era for the New Years. We had the Himalayan view room for 4 nights. It is one of the best properties with an amazing location. The view from the hotel is to die for. The property has been well maintained as well. A 5 on 5 for the property is a no brainer.

When it comes to service, it was purely disastrous. Overall, to get anything from the front desk, in-room dining to housekeeping, it took a minimum of 2 calls. Nothing was addressed in one go. I understand there might be a shortage of staff due to covid. But thee needs to be some customer empathy. It's the most important thing in this industry. There was zero customer empathy. The staff was least bothered. It was a disappointing experience overall.

A special mention for the new year con. There was no new year gala dinner when I booked. They introduced this later. They were charging a mind-boggling INR 10,000 per person for just food and music. Obviously, I opted out. But what they did was, they shut everything down in the hotel - restaurant, lounge, etc. The only thing available was the in-room dining. This was shocking. It was almost like being held on gun-point to attend the gala dinner for an unreasonable price. A ton of other guests around were pissed about this as well.

Overall, it's a great property which is not run by professional hoteliers. 2 points are purely for the property and the view and it's a 0 for everything else.

reviews.author: Devesh B Mittle
reviews.title: India's only Luxury Ski Resort
reviews.text:
Fantastic property in the ski capital of India Gulmarg.

Room - Very spacious and well made with excellent views from large floor to ceiling windows. Bathrooms a bit small but has all the amenities. Super comfortable beds and most important perfect heaters during winters.

Food - Very nice & tasty. Good variety in Buffets during breakfast & dinner in the coffee shop The Cloves. They need to add another fine dining restaurant as they have only the coffee shop as an option other than a tea lounge area called Chaikash. 

Service - Superb the entire staff is very warm & hospitable on the property. Would like to give a special mention to a few of them, Mr Murrad (Front office manager) Mr Jehangir (Front Office) Mr Aijaz Ahmad (Captian at The Cloves) & Mr Aadil (Chaikash)

Spa - Well made but need to do a bit of maintenance & Upkeep.

Overall a must-do once.

reviews.author: big_paan
reviews.title: Beautiful stay at the Khyber
reviews.text:
We had a short stay at the Khyber, but long enough to share some insights with you!

The L’Occcitane spa - Boooking the treatments, checking in, and the treatment itself were all absolutely five-star. They pay exquisite attention to detail, excel in customer service, and provide a very clean and professional treatment. The only downside was the sound of kids screaming in the pool, but about 5 minutes into the blissful experience, I could no longer hear anything.

Dining - We ate breakfast and dinner at the main restaurant. The breakfast had a nice selection of food, as to be expected at a breakfast buffet at such a property in India. Dinner was decent, but not at all worth the exorbitant prices if you order one dish per person. Most dishes are big enough to share. The customer service was excellent in the restaurant. My gratitude to Tawheed for taking such good care of us!

Rooms - we were in a pretty standard room. The lack of air conditioning made the night almost unbearable, as the temperature range in our room was 27.5-29.5 degrees Celsius. A fan was provided, but the circulation of hot air can only do so much! Because it’s primarily a winter resort, they only have heating.

I struggle with rating the overall customer service. There were some points that stood out. Pakeeza at check in went above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay for us, and even arranged a special treat for my mom’s birthday! As mentioned above, restaurant staff were excellent as well, as were the security and front door teams. But there were other points that were a little slow. For example, it took 8 hours and 4 reminders to get a rollaway bed in our room. I honestly would have had no trouble getting the bed myself and making it. Similarly, we had to ask a number of times for more water.

In the end, I would definitely recommend this property. I’d love to see it in full swing in the winter, the way it’s meant to be enjoyed. Maybe I’ll take a break from the Canadian Rockies and ski Gulmarg next year!

Thanks!

(Please note, I wrote this review in June on my iPhone... Just getting around to posting it now as I didn't have WiFi while traveling)

reviews.author: MrinalSinha

reviews.author: Ashita M
reviews.title: Experience worth having!
reviews.text:
positive impression of Khyber started as soon as I made bookings with the reservation counter at Khyber where mr Firdaus accommodated my special demands ( for kids) with no fuss or obligation  . We ( a family of 4) visited Khyber in January first week after much speculation ( because of what you read in paper or listen in news about Srinagar, which is not true- it’s very safe for tourists  ) .We were pleasantly surprised when it started snowing as soon as we landed in Srinagar . In spite of delayed flight, the transport incharge of Khyber was standing waiting for us .The experienced cab driver from Khyber constantly kept a track of the snow fall levels during our 1&1/2 hour journey to the hotel and was very responsible in driving . He knew the in’s and out of driving in snow laden roads and where all traffic will get slow due to snowing and kept us apprised of the same . 
Our next best moment was when we entered Gulmarg which was ,by then , completely blanketed with fresh snowfall which glistened beautifully on the tall fir and pine trees , which is exactly where Khyber is located. We were greeted with smiles by the guards Fiyaz Ahmad, Sunil , Danish, Baburam who all helped us in later days with other things too . 
As we entered Khyber, we were taken aback by the richness  of interiors done in traditional Kashmiri style .. the wooden panelling on wall and luxurious carpeted floors bought much needed warmth to the ambience. Rooms were spacious enough . The view from the room was breathtaking- all snow laden dark green fir and pine trees with not a sound to disturb. Next ,we went for a sumptuous meal in the restaurant (as it was delicious - we ended up ordering two servings of everything- but it was a bad idea for day 1- should have had lighter food ). 
We would especially take a moment to thank Mr Ishfaq( associate trainee F&B), Mr Firdaus ( Sen. Ass.F&B) , mr Irfan ( TL F&B), Gh Quadir ( F&B) , mr Sajaad ( trainee), mr Aiyaz ( supervisor F&B), mr Vikram Singh ( Sn chef ), mr Anil ( chef) , Mr Ishfaq( Incharge -in room dining ) and of course mr Basharat ( manager F&B) - for serving us so well - with kahwa, in room dining preparing special non spicy food for my kids and delicious live counters , quick service with smiles all giving us a memorable experience . 
Most of the staff was from Kashmir itself and they were all so pleasant and down to earth and good natured and it was a delight to have conversations with them . Khyber belongs to a Kashmiri family and they have maintained the true spirit of Kashmir in terms of (royal ) interiors, culture and hospitality . 
Regarding sightseeing, there are hotel associated guides ( but not employees of hotel ) , whom you can find standing at the hotel gate at 9 am sharp every morning. They are very responsible ,be it in terms of arranging for you the right warm outfits , gondola ride , ATV , or bargaining for pashminas- as I was told  ( Although we had prebooked mr Yaseen  through reference of Owners of Mercury Himalayan Explorations who are very well experienced since years and helped me plan everything especially with young kids  ).  
Gulmarg is a place which has its own charm in every season - winter ( snow ), spring and summer ( strawberries and apple orchids and beautiful greenery), autumn ( beautiful red coloured trees) - but it is especially good for skiing enthusiasts who if experienced- can traverse the uninhibited mountain sides with trained guides or if novice -simply learn skiing ( which needs a minimum of 5-6 days for basics)
I cannot end before mentioning my gratitude  to Mr Mohammad Rafi , duty manager Khyber for going an extra step for quickly sending me back my important package which I left in the locker by mistake. He was constantly in touch with me till my package arrived safely. I am grateful. 
All in all , it was a marvellous experience and I am thankful to all the Kashmiri people for their warmth and hospitality. And once again , Gulmarg is safe for tourists. 
Thank you Khyber for this memorable experience .

reviews.author: Sunilponraj
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: This is good place and the staff of hotel especially arif in front office desk and in live cooking station khrusan chief and the entire team welcome us good and stay was excellent with the team and the managers too our first grade to hotel entire team and the second to hotel room and the view of Himalayan range it was pleasant stay in the hotel

reviews.author: NSB83
reviews.title: Khyber, you beauty!
reviews.text:
We booked a stay at Khyber for 6 days starting December 25th. I'm going to be as specific and succinct as possible.

Room - We took room with the glass window and not the balcony because with Sub zero temperature we weren't sure of the utility. We don't regret that decision. 

Best Parts: 

1. The pool, jacuzzi , steam and sauna - There's really nothing quite like the way they have them all together at Khyber 

2. Food is average but not bad at all and service is fantastic which makes up for it! The Hookah lounge is a great place to kick back and chill in the evening. 

3. Buffet breakfast is a decent Indian spread but when you stay for 6 days you know the pattern :) 

4. Igloo offers a good variety of options to enagage in fun activities with your child. 

5. The airport representative - Asif is absolutely fantastic! We had trouble with our flight and Asif really helped us through all of it. Really appreciate that! 

The not so great now - (1) They forgot we were there on our anniversary trip despite me reminders on the phone and the day we checked in. (2) When a family stays in a hotel for an extended period of time and not the usual day or two we do expect to meet the hotel manager. I didn't see him around at all. Would've definitely added a more personal touch to our long stay. 

I would HIGHLY recommend this hotel and will be back just before 2019 comes to a close.

reviews.author: Jassani
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!!
reviews.text:
A stay in Khyber Himalyan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg is indeed an enlightening experience with its beautiful surroundings and surreal beauty. Our group of 8 stay there for two nights. The people at Khyber are truly amazing with their warm hospitalities and eagerness to please and pamper you. If in Gulamrg Khyber is the one and only choice to experience true Kashmiri hospitality!
Kudos to the Khyber Team!!

reviews.author: as2722
reviews.title: Remarkably extraordinary! One of the most amazing stays I have ever had!
reviews.text:
If you are going to Kashmir on leisure, Khyber is an experience you must not miss! It's one of the most amazing properties I have ever stayed in. Proximity to the Gondola, beautiful location, well-maintained property, and extremely courteous and responsive staff are just a few of the qualities I can begin with. From their vast spread in dining to their amazing menu of pillows, it's all fabulous.
I took a package tour and was advised against staying at Khyber (reasons unknown to me), but I can tell you it was a complete value-for-money decision. 
If you can, you must - is all I would say.

reviews.author: Kanchan S
reviews.title: Grateful for hospitality!
reviews.text: Khyber can be truely defined as Paradise on the earth. Here I would like to highlight something beyong stay experience. We were in Khyber during New year 2019. On the day of our travel back to Delhi, got informed by Indigo airline about cancellation of flight due to weather concern and was scheduled for next day travel. Mr. Asif Hussain who represents Khyber and work at Srinagar airport turned out to be a saviour. He was their to guide us at airport in such tough time. He went extra miles to look into feasible options with all other airlines and finally got us boarded in the earliest available flight. He been kind, humble and cooperative. I can't thank him enough for the relentless effort he put forward to help us the best way. We highly recommend his services and Kashmir memories would always be cherished for people like them. Thank you Asif Bhai! God bless You.

reviews.author: Muzammil A
reviews.title: Amazing property
reviews.text:
We had stayed for 2 nights 04/Jan-05/Jan we booked two rooms with Himalayan View, we must say people visiting Gulmarg should stay at this property; they have the most beautiful views from the room. Overall the property was just too good. The staff and hospitality is just above the best. The Jacuzzi is awesome. 
Only low points are the pool and food.
Pool was a bit cold, not a big deal though, at such extreme cold conditions any temperature would have felt jittery.
Food here is I felt was only vegetarian, if you are a non veg lover this place is not for you. Buffets hardly have any non veg options.
We wanted to have an A la carte for the dinner but the restaurant manager duped us to go for a buffet by offering 1 pax discounts. We paid 7+ grands just to have Panner and Veg. Not his mistake though, I should have been wise to check the buffet menu before taking a call. For the other night we made a wiser decision to have our food outside and we thoroughly enjoyed.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Raz.Habz
