reviews.text: My recent holiday was absolutely fabulous at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa in Gulmarg..the services were outstanding the staff were most pleasant & food absolutely perfect..our rooms were most comfortable & i would like to thank management for such a eell maintained & high standard resort..i will definately be revisiting as this was one of the most memorable holidays my family & i have enjoyed.

reviews.author: rishabh j
reviews.title: Beautiful getaway
reviews.text: Went over to this property twice. It's about an hour's drive from Srinagar airport. The hotel is just amazing. It's very well located and has some great facilities. The staff is very sweet and helpful and are willing to do whatever it takes to make your stay comfortable. They have an indoor heated pool which just steals the show. It's probably one of the best hotels in India with one of the best restaurant in the area. However, please note that they do not serve alcohol.

reviews.author: vmahajan
reviews.title: A 5 Star Hotel that's gives India it's own slice of Switzerland and more  !!
reviews.text:
I have been attempting to book a room here over the Christmas period for the past 2 years now and I always end up reacting a little late by when all rooms get lapped up. This time not to be outdone I ensured I was miles ahead and had a lovely "Gulmarg View with Balcony room" waiting for me. 

I had high expectations of the hotel and rightly so, it's website and promotional video are one of the finest I have ever seen and being a seasoned traveller was a few percentile sceptical that it might be as one would expect "dressed up" for the promotion material. I went about the hotel with a fine tooth comb looking for reasons to give them a thumbs down and boy was it tough. The pictures of the rooms / bathrooms etc are an exact representation of the hotel and this is a rarity.

On check in we were greeted by the lovely Ms Khalida (who upon reading this will remember I promised to give a fair unbiased review on check out :) There was lovely Cava a hot local beverage that was served to all of us and the check in procedure was flawless. I did arrive at about 4 and probably missed the rush since check in is at 2 and I recommend this during the peak season if your not the wait patiently type.

We had stayed for 3 nights over the Christmas 
period and you can't get more festive than that. They had a Santa Clause prancing around giving out sweets to the kids on demand through the day, a nice little touch I must say. 

The Breakfast buffet had a mix of Indian and continental fare enough for everyone to indulge in as per ones palate. I do recommend as I did with the check in, however the reverse in this case show up early as there is a bit of a wait if you come in late in order to get a table.

Dinner was a buffet as well though I do recommend going over the Ala carte menu for a more robust choice especially if your looking to sample various types of ethnic non vegetarian fare. They do have a few on the buffet but if you want the real kickers be prepared to order from the menu. I have seen a few reviews where people complain that the restaurant is expensive, my answer is Khyber is not exactly a budget property, if you can afford the room rates there should he no reason to penny pinch elsewhere.

There are a host of guides standing outside the foyer and on day 1 I was not sure if they were there to dive deep into my pockets, then again you can negotiate terms but the service is if I may say so as promised. Do not hesitate to use there services even for a few hundred more it's worth it in terms of convenience.

The Spa run by Loccitane as all their Spas was exemplary and the pool the finest I have been to in my life in terms of the over all experience. The Jaccuzi was HOT and had 8 seats, and not a lacklustre mildy warm experience that some hotels have for the sake of saying they offer a Jaccuzi. I have read other reviews where one was complaining about the size of the Sauna well it perhaps could have been slightly larger but I'm considering every time I went there was just 1 or 2 other people it did not matter.

I also did read a review a few days ago of someone who had a terrible experience thats what one would call the joker in the pack, I also did have a slight issue of a chocked shower drain which was intended to immediately. No hotel is without it's imperfections therefore one must in view of the over all situation allow somethings to pass. I have picked holes in the finest properties on earth that being said were all human. 

The housekeeping team deserves special mention especially Muzzamil who tended to every need from extra towels to a turn down service without a word. Every time I walked the passages on cue Every single time irrespective of who the staff member was I was greeted throughout my stay with a smile and a Good morning /, evening, it's these little things that go a long way.

I did travel by my 8 and 5 year old and if any one needs suggestions on the property with children do write in. My children had a BALL at the Igloo which is basically a den in the basement with a lot of entertainment in tow.

I have returned and have recommended the property to my friends and Khyber has already had a few reservations confirmed in view of my excellent experience. I thank everyone at Khyber and will definitely be back dinner than later.

reviews.author: Atul S
reviews.title: Surreal, invigorating and Dreamy getaway, fantastic service too !!
reviews.text: We were there over the new years period with the extended family and the facilities, location, service and can-do approach of staff beats the best in the world. With views from our balconies of the Himalayan View room that took our breath away and snowflakes in our hands-wish we had discovered this earlier than the best resorts of the swiss alps. Mr. Chhabra, the GM leads his team inspiringly and some that stood out during our stay included all the Housekeeping staff (Imran in particular), Mukesh at the coffee shop but above all the superstar who defines the Kashmiri spirit of hospitality was Asif - the airport rep who welcomed us with pride and joyful spirit and managed to pull strings relentlessly when our flights got canceled due to bad weather. Having travelled the world, I recommend this to all with a case of wanderlust-get it on your bucket list !!!

reviews.author: Laksh2009
reviews.title: Beautiful beautiful place!!!
reviews.text:
This review is quite a bit late but the memories are very fresh and that feeling of awe still intact. This place really is paradise! The hotel itself is very tastefully done with rich decor. The rooms are very comfy with a balcony that literally takes you out to the Himalayas. 
The staff deserve a very special mention here. They are such warm people always ready to help. We booked the den for a movie which we enjoyed with yum food served right there. The spa was relaxing after a day of sightseeing. The resort vehicles would be the best way to travel around as it is safe and do ask for Mr Akbar to show you around, a very nice gentleman.

reviews.author: viviangomes2005
reviews.title: Great and cosy getaway
reviews.text: I visited and stayed at Khyber resort with family last month. It was an extremely comfortable and cosy experience right from the moment we set foot on the property. Unfortunately my wife developed some fever before we landed bit Khyber also had an in house doctor who was able to guide us with proper treatment. Overall, the food was sumptuous, facilities were top notch and views were great. The only slight feedback would  be to improve the children's play area as the temperature there was not regulated and it was absolutely freezing there. Net net, I will have no hesitation in staying here again on my next trip.

reviews.author: mansi j
reviews.title: Heaven 😍😍
reviews.text:
Witnessed snowfall for the first time here..
Heated swimming with an awesome view of snow ❄️, tress and mountain ⛰ 
Super friendly staff
Perfect to go in the month of January.
Bonfire in snow with extreme warm snacks served with amazing songs is just the perfect combination anyone could wish for!!!
Would suggest a must visit.
It is truly heaven on earth
One of the best trips I have ever had !!

reviews.author: JASJIT S
reviews.title: Truly a lap of luxury
reviews.text:
The Khyber stands out and stands tall in Gulmarg. From the time you step out of the car and into the lobby, the warm hospitality of the staff hits you. 
Great rooms all with superb view in each one of them. Excellent heating. Great facilities.
It’s an experience worth having if you can fit it into your budget. 
Some minor negatives that can be and should be recitified. It’s difficult to walk up to the property. I feel the hotel should provide a free service to their clients. 
The evening room service is not so good. Replenishment of tea, water, turning of sheets is non-existent. However, I have to say, once you ask for this, it comes in no time at all. 
Secondly, I think the food leaves a lot to be desired. It is not really fine dining, but it’s definitely not value for money. For dinner you have virtually no choices and the buffet is too highly priced. The management seriously needs to look into this. This is a common complaint that I overheard from friends traveling with me and others who have been here before.
Now for the team. Pakeezah is a wonderful hostess. Bubbly, lively and makes you feel welcome from the word go. Sameer at the Sheesha Lounge was warmth and excellence personified. Khyber has a fine team and it should be proud of the same.

reviews.author: tanvi_jain14
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text:
Witnessing Snow fall!!! What else do you want in your life.
Beautiful view, rooms, food service
Bonfire in snow is a thing to do.
Heated pool with a snow covered trees and mountains view couldn’t be better!

reviews.author: Kunal N
reviews.title: Luxury amidst Nature
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights to celebrate our anniversary in this January, 2018. It is a beautiful property & very well maintained rooms & very warm staff who welcome you with some awesome Kahwa. Kashmir is a must visit for every Indian ! It is the most beautiful part of our country that we should be proud of. It has decent workout gym & a very good Spa too. Food was pretty good & we had a decent spread on alacart over 3 days. Highly recommend everyone for this

reviews.author: Numan
reviews.title: Sharing experience
reviews.text: Let me first tell u .i have visited all other best hotels in gulmarg like vintage, highland park etc but the kind of food and the location of this hotel is exceptional..good management ,nice service and other amenities... awesome gym n facilities.... overall very good hotel

reviews.author: Rajesh Mohan 68
reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text:
They say “Get enchanted by the Heaven in Heaven. The Khyber is one of the best luxury resort in Gulmarg, Srinagar” They must add its most expensive too ! 
Dined @ Chaikash a space for chais, coffees, tisanes and kahwah. Ordered finger food, and tea & the bill was astronomical. The ambience was great though

reviews.author: Aditi1613
reviews.title: Beautiful Property but poor hospitality
reviews.text:
Pros: 
Extremely Beautiful property
Great View
Covered with Snow in winters
Warm water pool with great view  (it is maintained at 28-10 degree Temp)
Food is ok
They even gave 1 room for early checkin (we booked 2 rooms)

Cons:
Poor in terms of hospitability

They charged us for a mini bar item that we did not use, it was barely priced at 60 Rs, we told them that we did not eat it, so they kept enquiring about it like CID for a 60 Rupee item, nevertheless we asked them to keep the change, this reflected bad hospitality 

Our driver got stuck 3 km from the resort, we asked them to provide cab to that point to which they refused stating various reasons, like unavailability of cabs (how is that even possible) etc etc we got really worried coz we had a flight to catch

this left bad taste while leaving the property

reviews.author: VivekSangita
reviews.title: Castle in fairy land
reviews.text: Its a lifetime experience. The property is a piece of art and marvel. But its the great hospitality which pumps life into it. Staff is extremely cordial. Menu is lavish. Rooms are large very well equipped with best of modern amenities. View from the rooms and also from the balcony is breath taking. Hotel has taken care of even smallest need of its guests like a room to store boots and over coats which are stored and returned with immense care.

reviews.author: Gopal Bansala
reviews.title: Hospitality
reviews.text: It was a great experience with this hotel. The services of staff was very good specially of  Mr. Sham The food was very good. They have feel us special on the birthday of one of our friend Mr. Vipul Jain

reviews.author: rishivij
reviews.title: A heavenly resort in the hills
reviews.text:
We came in a group of 7 couples , all from Nagpur and we stayed for 2 nights at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg and the experience was wonderful. It is indeed one of the best Hill Resort, not only in India but in whole world . 

The overall ambience is amazing , the rooms are awesome and well maintained and the views from the rooms are very beautiful . The spa , steam , jacuzzi are just too good and the best part is the heated swimming pool having glass walls giving you full view of the snowy mountains. The staff is very polite and co operative  , the temperature is well maintained to keep you cozy in winters . I must say that if you want to enjoy a heavenly Hill Resort in india , just book Khyber Himalayan Resort of Gulmarg and You will have a great time 

On the flip side , the food is very expensive and there are no other alternate options available for dinner in winters

reviews.author: Kalilur R
reviews.title: Excellent property at excellent location.
reviews.text: An exceptional hotel I have stayed in recent times. The location and ambience is great.Even in  the chill whether of December the whole hotel was maintained in warmth.Start from the reception to every place the staffs are cordial and very helpful. The  rooms are spacious and comfortable. The breakfast had good spread of variety foods .We have enjoyed a very delicious south indian food.I have not seen such a scenic resort even in Swiss.In all aspects it is a great hotel.

reviews.author: devojha1978
reviews.title: Best trip
reviews.text: Fun holiday in Gulmerg. The hotel was just lovely – it’s a boutique hotel. We loved the balconies and the views were stunning from our rooms. The food was great. Do try the spa you wll love it. They were kind enough to send us a cake for my birthday! We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Sachin G
reviews.title: Food not good
reviews.text: Very nice resort &rooms but food quality is very poor   doesn't have taste in any of it's dishes ....tried North Indian food which was absolutely tasteless ...even the breads were not freshly served...stayed for 3days from 4th Jan 2018 to 7th Jan 2018 ...didn't find the perfect taste in d food in all the 3days ...our 3 days stay made me realize that the restaurant is comparatively smaller keeping in mind the resort ..we tried dal makhni, Yellow dal, Hari mirch paneer, kashmiri dum aloo , methi paneer makhni , & kashmiri lotus stem ...all below average ..also the breakfast buffet was pathetic .

reviews.author: Dwarak N
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text:
Beautiful Property right in Gulmarg amidst the Glaciers!
Fabulous service from the staff who work 24*7 to keep their guests happy.From their air side support staff to the folks at the spa,simply amazing service levels!
Special mention to GH.Qadir in the all day dining restaurant for his exemplary service and a never say die attitude to make the best version of the food available on our tables!kudos to him and the other F&B staffer the restaurant.
Overall a highly recommended property for a luxury holiday in Kashmir!

reviews.author: FinaIshak
reviews.title: Excellent Stay and Service
reviews.text:
We had the luxury suite and from the first day we have had the best service from the staff. One particular staff by the name of Burhan was very accommodating and he made sure that our stay was as comfortable as ever. We stayed there for 6 nights and had enough time to use the facilities such as the indoor pool and the jacuzzi, which were very welcoming after a hard day's work at the skiing slope. 

The location itself was amazing as we were surrounded by the mountains and the snow during winter, something that you look forward to everytime you wake up in the morning. Would highly recommend this hotel, and would definitely come again insya Allah.

reviews.author: Kunal S
reviews.title: Luxury property with a fantastic location
reviews.text: Luxurious property with great rooms. Since we travelled in the last week of December the heating was extremely good all over the property. We even used the heated pool, its perfect since the water is lukewarm. The only disappointment was the food from the buffet which was ok but this was more than made up by the excellent service of Mr Tawheed and team who made some fresh food as per our requests. Overall the best property in Gulmarg by far.

reviews.author: VidyuthBhandary
reviews.title: Heaven is a place on earth !!!
reviews.text: To best describe the experience at The Kyber would be in one word - "JANNAT". By describing the stay as magical would still be incomplete. The view from the room is STUNNING. Beats even Switzerland. And thanks Afwaq Ahmed for all the courtesy extended to us. Lastly, like i experienced, the spirit of the local people is the reason why Kashmir is still alive / exists !!!

reviews.author: FCARitesh
reviews.title: Luxury Redefined..
reviews.text: If there is a heaven on earth it is Kashmir and if it is Khyber Himalayan Resort then you're probably at the best place in heaven. The resort gives you amazing view of Himalayas from their balcony rooms. Luxury like never experienced before and hospitality like never heard of. It was a pleasure meeting Vikas Sharma from management who works relentlessly to ensure that his guests experience of their lifetime. I would only say.. if you haven't seen this, you haven't seen much..

reviews.author: LiveWhileAlive
reviews.title: Perfect, Almost
reviews.text:
Arrival was very welcoming, the staff are terrific. The location is amidst snow-covered mountains and pine trees, beautiful views all around, one couldn't do better with the location. The gondola ride is a 5 minute walk down the road, but if you are older or not used to walking in the snow, then get a ride. The restaurant offers excellent food choices, although a bit expensive. 

Couple points, we had a room with twin beds, this typically means two separate beds, but here the beds are joined, we had to ask them to separate these beds, yet I could hear my freind snore. My friend left his boots in the cloak room, and a hotel guest took his boots, the staff traced the guest, sent a couple staff members and got the boots back. Every time they erred, they fixed it, every single time.

That said, to be honest and fair, I would say they are a good solid 4 star hotel, compared to places such as The Monasterio in Lima, Peru. Even a 4.5, but don't let that take away anything from this beautiful, well managed, friendly place. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Timmisoni
reviews.title: " The Hotel "
reviews.text:
The experience of hospitality starts from the pick up at Srinagar Airport and also ends when you are dropped back. The Hotel is excellent beyond words but I believe dedicated staff takes it to a different level. The staff is very 
Courteous polite efficient and ever helping. 
The view of the mountains from the hotel leaves you awestruck.
Food is excellent and the buffet well laid.
Overall an unforgettable experience.
Guys keep up the good work

reviews.author: MalikandScott
reviews.title: Hospitality....at it's best
reviews.text: It was just incredible being in Khyber, their Hospitality is awesome with best pool views you might ever see......room with balcony gives you extra edge....if you are at Khyber you just need not to go anywhere else.....it’s a kind of resort where you see everything you can see in gulmarg......

reviews.author: Akhil C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: ........is a very beautiful property. We stayed here for first time and had a very nice experience. Staff is very cooperative here and very small or big thing of ours was taken care. It has amazing ambitions and very nicely maintained. Food is very delicious and quality is very well maintained. Mr. Bilal, who takes care of administration  , takes great care of guests and make them sure of every comfort.

reviews.author: dj031979
reviews.title: PARADISE ON EARTH
reviews.text: Its one of the most amazing properties i have ever stayed ..will visit every year for sure..thanks to sajjad the duty manager for upgrading us to the gulmarg view rooms with balcony ...would highly recommend these rooms or the himalayan view ones.the staff are very courteous specially the one handling the pool area..forgot his name though i guess it was tahir..everything about the hotel is brilliant ....most memorable stay so far....thank u khyber..see u soon

reviews.author: pritish_10
reviews.title: An Excellent Stay !!!
reviews.text: I have visited many five star hotels, but the stay at Khyber was one notch above any place I've ever been. From the airport representative, car drivers, security guards, hotel staff everyone is extremely courteous and friendly and go beyond their duty to make you feel comfortable. Extremely well trained and hospitable staff. The personal attention that they give to every guest, just makes the whole experience really good. The 2 night stay at this resort was really amazing, and I cant find any negative or anything which was not upto the mark to mention here. The Kashmiri Kahwa was too die for, so tasty and piping hot !!!! Mr. Bilal and the person taking care of the tea lounge in Khyber, really took excellent care of us. We had the most amazing view from our rooms, and the view from the pool is just breathtaking. One of the best stays ever and I'm definitely coming back here (it's very rarely that I praise something so much ;)) but honestly every single aspect of service and hospitality far far exceeds the expectations. Really happy and I hope you continue to maintain these standards of hospitality and service. Hats off to the staff and management  !! Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: Vikram Devare
reviews.title: Beautiful and Luxurious
reviews.text:
Beautiful views of the Himalayas and Gulmarg, luxurious setting and excellent service. Need I say more?

My wife and I travelled in January 2017 in the middle of the winter and we were treated to a true snowy winter experience. The snow covered landscape is absolutely breathtaking and I recommend going in this weather to experience winter and snow in its full glory.

Pros:
1. Amazing views of the Himalayas
2. Location - In the heart of all the action, from the Gondola to the Ski slopes and the Gulmarg market
3. Service - Special mention to Bilal, Hamid, Iqbal for making our stay comfortable
4. The heated pool, gym and spa!

Cons:
Wish they made arrangements for snow boots, etc but this is a minor thing as boots and jackets are easily available around

We had a wonderful stay and if we could go back every year, we would.

reviews.author: sumitgup
reviews.title: Finest Experience in Hills
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber for 2 nights, by far Khyber is the best resort on hills. Unmatched comfort, superb food, extremely courteous staff, kids friendly atmosphere....in simple term one big reason to visit Gulmarg will be Khyber

reviews.author: minijeswal
reviews.title: Khyber makes gulmarg even more beautifuk
reviews.text:
We planned our visit to Gulmarg only because of Khyber. Being one of the top 10 resorts of Asia , khyber has proven its ranking absolutely right.
The entire hotel staff was the sweetest ever. From parvez, bilal , showkat to people attending us at the pool and restaurant everyone treated us like god and took the best care of us.
The view from swimming pool is the best part of khyber.
Rooms are amazing too.
Thank you for having us at Khyber , we shall definitely see you all soon again.
I will advice people who are planning a visit to Kashmir to please visit Khyber.

reviews.author: neeraj404
reviews.title: Great Value for Money, Amazing Resort !!
reviews.text: A wonderful place to experience snow filled winter, i have stayed here for 2 Nights from 14 Jan 2017 onwards with my family, the hotel premises, the rooms and the amenities are great and very well maintained, food is very delicious, the heated pool is welcome in the freezing cold weather, the best part of this resort is the well trained staff who really take good care of yourself. Mr. Billal in the front desk is one such person who is always smiling and ensure that you get all comfort during your stay. Mr. Showkat Khan in the F&B section is another gem person who suggest you what to go for during all meals, he is very hard working and energetic person who ensures that you enjoy your stay by all possible means. Resort is located at the best location in Gulmarg, rooms are very neat and clean and spacious, service standards are superb...There is great value for money as you will feel very comfortable in this resort.

reviews.author: vkchoksy
reviews.title: Excellent Hote;
reviews.text:
The hotel is great

Staff excellent

Food Good

Enjoyed our stay

will surely go back

The heated pool is welcome

the gym is well equipped

the managers are very helpful

The property is lovely

Lovely views from the room

enjoyed with my family of 5

reviews.author: Deepak A
reviews.title: Too good to be true
reviews.text: A wonderful place to experience a snow filled winter. The hotel premises, the rooms, the amenities, the location, the staff, the food, the hospitality everything is super super good... Totally out of the world experience... I would love to stay in khyber every winter. This hotel deserves a 7star rating. Everything is perfect.

reviews.author: Sree G
reviews.title: Stay in Khyber in Dec
reviews.text:
Hi,

I had pleasure of staying in Khyber Resort. I had travelled to Gulmarg on Dec 28th and had stayed there for 2 nights. They had upgraded by room which was a nice gesture. The location of the property is breath taking. It is a serene place, I had hoped for the snowfall, but unfortunately weather god had other ideas. But the views from the property was amazing. The hospitality was at its best. I had loved to stay there for more days, provided there was snowfall, but it didn't. Now again planning to there in Jan if there is a snowfall. Food was excellent, lot of continental food was available. Hoping to visit Gulmarg and Khyber in Jan end again, hopefully with snowfall.

reviews.author: Bavithra D
reviews.title: Second Honey Moon
reviews.text: Our family and friends were afraid of visit to gulmarg regarding the safety but we felt the very safe and enjoyed the whole visit. We were received by Nazir at airport with a warm welcome. Nazir was a good guy who served us,  as a guide, for the visit to skiing and shopping. We thank him a lot for the guidance. Khyber rooms were clean with good views of the Himalayas and Alpine trees. Restaurant was finger licking good. The hoocka was great, with the signature green apple flavor. Swimming pool with water sauna and steam is definitely worth the visit. The gym and swimming pool was almost empty so we spent hours in luxury. Spa massage was wonderful especially the lemon ... massage. We could be writing pages about the gulmarg and Khyber resort as the memory of the visit will stay with us as a delight.

reviews.author: Vishvajeet_Patil
reviews.title: The Khyber during X'Mas
reviews.text:
It was an awesome experience staying at The Khyber during last week of December. 
The Hotel staff made us feel very much at home & took special care of all of us. The Luxury room with Balcony was much above my expectation & the Dinner too was very Lavish. Very helpful Hotel staff, always ready to help whenever required.

The Khyber for me is the best Hotel option in Gulmarg !!!

reviews.author: BlueWinchester
reviews.title: Royal Stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights and we had a great time. The Hotel has a beautiful wooden architecture,  perfect for honeymooners like us.  They have a very good breakfast spread. We opted for Ala carte for dinner and that was also good. Only one con i would say is wifi here is chargeable unlike Taj Vivanta Srinagar so four stars for that.

reviews.author: nkeswani
reviews.title: Scenic Gulmarg and the Beautiful Khyber!
reviews.text: Stayed here from the 26th until the 28th of Dec 2016. Firstly I would like to compliment the service that they provided, the front desk was always helpful at all times. The view from the rooms was beautiful and scenic although when I went, it had just snowed once. The food at the restaurant was delicious; specially the Masala dosa station they had during breakfast time and also Aloo Paratha was yummy. We had the biryani and fish tikka for dinner as well. It was delicious. The Kahwah tea that they provided during check in was amazing. The room itself was spacious and the bed was comfortable; the bathroom was clean and the hot water pressure was too good. Overall Khyber spa and resorts is a beautiful place to stay and spend holidays in. Truly a wonderful experience. Thank you Khyber Resort & Spa.

reviews.author: Manik Dhodi
reviews.title: A Heaven in Heaven
reviews.text: If Kashmir is called heaven, one may call this place a Heaven in heaven. Beautiful hotel wherein wood dominates the eyes. Heart melting views from all around the hotel. The "Kava" welcome drink is a blessing.

reviews.author: mformalay
reviews.title: Wish tripadvisor had a 6th star
reviews.text:
One visits lots of 5 stars hotels and resorts in India and aborad. Most of them gives a good service. Khyber's service is surely a notch above .They are genuinely happy to see you and take care of you. People like shawkat at clove, hamid at front desk and each and everyone was really good. Everything was taken care . Rooms are amazing. Book the himalayan view rooms. spa was good. pool really nice ,kids will have fun.Food was good. 
Some stuff that can we little better is stuff for kids. Create more interesting stuff for them to be busy. Keep up the good work. we are surely coming back again. YOU GUYS ROCK.

reviews.author: GauravAndSonali
reviews.title: Perfect hot spring refuge from the snow
reviews.text:
Great location, very close to the ski lift / gondola / ATV rides / ice skating rink etc. 

Excellent service. The staff couldn't do enough and were always eager to please. 

Game room and swimming pool kept my daughter busy. 

He spa was the perfect opportunity to take shelter from the cold weather outside. 

The best part was, the lobby , restaurant and corridors of the hotel were kept pleasantly warm, so we didn't need to layer up inside the hotel. 

It was the perfect refuge. We will definitely be back the next time we are in Kashmir.

reviews.author: Prachi513
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with the best possible view!
reviews.text:
Khyber is a luxurious resort located walking distance from the Gulmarg Gondola. The best part about this resort is the view from everywhere on the property. Both Gulmarg view and Himalayan view rooms are equally good. It was a memorable experience to watch the moon-lit silver mountains from the balcony of our room. The bathrooms are just perfect. Loved the spa and the heated swimming pool. The breakfast spread is good too. 
The heating in the room needs to be constantly adjusted to arrive at a comfortable temperature.

reviews.author: Shai1411
reviews.title: Special mention to the restaurant staff of The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa
reviews.text: I have stayed in The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa earlier too & this year in Jan 2016 went for a week with my family & relatives. The hotel is an excellent property with great ambiance with all the luxury & amenity of a modern luxurious hotel. Special mention has to be made of the restaurant staff. They are extremely warm & caring. They ensured that we were taken good care off & made it a point to come & connect with everyone around. This place lacks the warmth & the human touch except for the dining area. If you looking for a luxurious property & good food this is a nice place to be in.

reviews.author: Bhavik Khera
reviews.title: Himalayan King
reviews.text:
truly a great place to stay if visiting Gulmarg. ideally located with close access to all the activities around gulmarg. great hotel spaces. good food. ask them to do a private dinner at the top and bonfire in the lawns on a nice day (will cost extra). 

lounge for consuming alcohol is available but you need to take your own. food is good and buffets are a good spread. good activity room for children.

reviews.author: rics9999
reviews.title: The Best in Gulmarg
reviews.text: This was my first visit to Kashmir. My stay at Khyber was exceptionally good. I loved the resort. The indoor heated pool, restaurants & other facilities is excellent. The staff extremely polite and very helpful.   The accommodation is nice and very comfortable . Having said all this , it was disappointing that the hotel charged for the wifi which was INR 750 a day.

reviews.author: Rishiraj17
reviews.title: Not seen a better resort!!
reviews.text: I visited the Khyber with family in November 2015, the experience was amazing to say the least, we were put up in one of the deluxe rooms that I shall strongly recommend, since these have a balcony that has a recliner chair and a beautiful head lamp on top. The resort is tastefully done to meet international standards and is unexpected to disappoint any tourist from any walk of life. We spent half a day looking around the place as the swimming pool, gym and spa were located at various corners of this vast property, the lobby is very beautiful and should be seen patiently ,the gym is impressive and open till 11pm, so gives enough time to relax after a day of trek and adventure. The kids play area is equipped with a play station, foosball and table tennis. Security is impressive but polite. The bathrooms are very good since these are of concern to a lot of travelers, one can be reassured the bathrooms are very well designed with a huge tub that can accommodate two adults. We had snow all around our balconies and that was exactly what we came for. Sipping a warm cup of coffee in a balcony surrounded by snow is mesmerizing. The only flipside was the food that probably didn’t match the standards, but it was ok, not bad. The resort is conveniently located near the Gondola entry point, so one can walk down, a tourist guide is helpful as he purchases Gondola tickets before hand and keeps sledgewallas away. Snow scooter for level 1 and 2 should not cost more than Rs 1000 and guide will take Rs 600, rented shoes and jackets for Rs 400 for one person, skis’ with teacher comes at Rs 600 per person for one hour, and Gondola till Level 2 is Rs 1400 per person. I strongly recommend going to Level 2, its clean and very beautiful, but don’t get fleeced by touts offering skis’ as walking in snow is more enjoyable and fun. Khyber is the place to be in Gulmarg if one can afford it, because it’s costly, but well worth it.

reviews.author: RMAggar
reviews.title: Magnificent and Impressive
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is one of the most inspiring places I visited first in 1972 and then in 1974 and planned once again in October 2015. We were told that there is a striking change and major transformation in hotels at Gulmarg since 1974 and therefore, while browsing internet to find out which hotel to reserve for our holidays in Gulmarg, we were highly impressed by the positive reviews of the Khyber; and if this was not enough, I was compelled to get our accommodation pre-reserved because I was mesmerised by the views of the hills all-around and the valley down from a distance the Restaurant ‘NOUF’ in the Khyber offered.  After checking in I first of all went to the deck of the ‘Nouf’ and relaxed there for quite some time, thinking that we shall have our evening tea/ drinks there.  Thereafter we checked in our room and it exceeded all my expectations; because the huge bay-window of the room gave me the same view as that while sitting on the deck of Rouf.  We all know that the first impressions are long lasting. How correct is this saying.
Khyber in Gulmarg is in stark departure from the rest of all other hotels in Gulmarg. It is at a short distance upwards from Gondola and All-Terrain Vehicles stand. It is magnificent and impressive. It is vast and newly constructed.   I was highly impressed by the architecture, designing, the amount spent especially on the quality and quantity of wood used all-around the resort. It is located on the hilltop in the lap of other hills ever green Pine and Fir trees on two sides, hills on the third side and valley on the rest and amidst score of pine trees.   Linen was neat and clean. Bath room was spacious and with all modern quality fittings. Room service was remarkable. Hot water indoor swimming pool was neat and impressive. We enjoyed the services of health club and the gym. Complimentary breakfast spread was superb.  However, in Kashmir’s such a good resort we could not get good kashmiri food. Had the ala-carte food been good (as expected), the resort could get my par-excellent.

reviews.author: nikhilzaveri
reviews.title: Out of this world
reviews.text: Can't believe the hotel can match the heaven on earth...Kashmir is indeed heaven on earth nd this hotel matched it. We had gone for our anniversary in winter nd  the service ,ambiance nd view from the room was unparallel .the best part was we were swimming in the beautiful heated swimming pool nd it was 2degrees cold outside.. Really had a nice time. Hope they provide the transport to nd fro at their cost next time.

reviews.author: Vivek Sharma
reviews.title: Worth visiting, food and service can be better
reviews.text:
First up, I am a native of J&K and frankly I felt a lot of pride while staying in this property, that someone from my state had the courage and vision to invest in a property of this grandeur. A big thumbs up to the owners who have created one of the best properties I have ever stayed in. The resort is done beautifully, both on the outside and interiors. In fact, walking through the lobby area and the corridors, you actually get this feeling that someone has indeed built this property with a lot of passion. It is beautiful from both the inside and the outside, and the heated pool with glass walls and a view of snow-clad mountains from the outside is simply breathtaking.
The resort is indeed very expensive but at the end of the experience, you will feel that it is worth the money spent. However, there are three downsides:
1. The food was just okay. I gorge on Kashmiri food but not even a single thing I had could be called mouth watering (and it doesn't feel good when it is also outrageously expensive). Bored with the food, we started eating outside food for lunch and dinners over the next two days
2. Wifi is paid and ridiculously expensive. It will not cost a lot to offer a free Wifi service and on the other hand I'm not sure how much you earn through a paid Wifi service-take that measured call to make customers happier
3. Room service was pathetic-we had to wait for a good 45 minutes to get some basic crockery into our room and had to call up at least 4-5 times to finally get it. At another occasion, we had ordered chinese food and asked for Soy, Chilli and tomato sauce. We just got a bottle of tomato sauce after 30 minutes and the staff member told us that he will get us the rest soon, he never turned up!!
Apart from the minor irritants above which can be taken care of, it was definitely an unforgettable stay. Am likely to come back again.

reviews.author: Sagar P
reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.text: Very friendly staff, including the Hotel Management. The food, rooms and the ambience of the resort are to be cherished for life. In house medical services are provided, which can be necessary if one goes for skiing or other adventure sports. The best resort to stay if you go to Gulmarg!

reviews.author: aamer_ali
reviews.title: 5 star hotel with spectacular views
reviews.text: I booked this hotel after reading the reviews on tripadvisor and the hotel met our expectations barring some minor hiccups. This 5 star hotel is optimum placed offering spectacular views to the Himalayas and at the same time a 10 minute walk to the Gulmarg Gondola Station. I stayed here for two nights on the 4th and 5th January with my wife and 3 small children and had booked the Himalayan view room. Room 2011 was on the first floor , centrally located and had the best views of the hotel. My appreciation to the staff for having arranged one of the best room for us. It was snowing when we arrived and the balcony views were just surreal. However one must understand that when arriving at the hotel a change of car is required at Tangmarg during January when it usually snows as only cars fitted with chain tires are allowed to go upto Gulmarg. Waiting times can be long. Also Boots and Jackets that are rented are not allowed inside the hotel premise. They have a cloak room where you can store them prior to entering the hotel, however with small children this hassle is best avoided if you don’t wear them at all and carry them instead. A minor hiccup at the time of check-in was that our luggage was not delivered to our room promptly. It arrived after I had spoken to the front desk about 2 hours post check-in. The welcome drink , Kashmiri kahwa was refreshing indeed, however nothing was served to our three children. We were guided promptly to our room and Nazia briefed us about the room and hotel facilities adequately. The Himalayan view room lives to its name, “experience like a star”, and like celebrities did indeed we experience. The view is just awesome, the best in my entire stay of hotels so far. Nothing  beats the snow capped himlayan mountains and the snow studded fir trees infront of the white hotel grounds.  From snowfall, to sunshine to fog, each has its own marvelous view. The Room was fabulously large, well furnished, and very warm even with sub-zero temperatures outside. The sofa turned into an extra bed and was useful when you have children around.  The toilet also had the himlayan view and the kids relished every moment in the bubble bath tub. Hot water was immediate, and plenty and never ran out even after we filled the tub to the brim.  The hotel’s Igloo was well equipped, table tennis, carom, air hockey, kept the children occupied, however the playstation joysticks weren’t working. The Restaurant cloves had delicious north/ south Indian food and kashmiri cusine. The freshly prepared hot dosas and omlete during breakfast were a hit with the kids. The pasta corner was great at dinner.  I particularly enjoyed the non-vegetarian kashmiri cusine and the sweet dishes laced with kashmiri saffron. Instead of Ala-carte I would advise families to go for the dinner buffet as children get included complimentary. The hotel grounds had a feet of snow and was enough for us to enjoy thoroughly. Last but not the least returning to the hotel after a tiring day and then swimming in their heated pool with the amazing views to the pristine nature is truly an unforgettable experience, something that should be in your list of things to do. The Airport drop arranged by the hotel concierge was fine. I would advise that you start at-least 5 hours prior to your flight departure time. The spectacular views of this hotel have been ingrained in my memory forever and I truly look forward to staying here again.

reviews.author: Shruti P
reviews.title: Luxury you'll fall in love with
reviews.text: I travelled with my family in the month of October.  Though we checked in before time we were served with kehwa while our rooms were being prepared.  My young toddler had a wonderful time running here and there which was met with a smile by the courteous and friendly staff. Very near to the gandola ride this is the place to stay in gulmarg.

reviews.author: Hemzzy
reviews.title: Luxury in a winter wonderland
reviews.text: Hotel is very luxurious, rooms and bathrooms included. Kahwa Tea (welcome drink) was a special treat.  Staff and Management were friendly and especially Zaffir Malik who was always at our service. The food was delicious most of all the vegetarian Kashmiri dishes.

reviews.author: Nirmal C
reviews.title: An experience, U'll yearn to repeat
reviews.text:
I don't understand why i didn't visit this place enough!
Is the question that came to my mind when my stay in Khyber - Gulmarg was coming to an end. I went there as a family holiday, we were 6 of us (My parents, sister, brother in law, my wife & me).
So cherished and fun was my trip that a greedy part of me felt i should not tell more people about it, as that would help preserve this wonderful place from commercialisation.
To Illustrate my point, lets start with Travel time, from Mumbai. It takes only 8 hours tops to reach Khyber - Gulmarg. Compare that to Manali and 8 hours is only from Chandighar to Manali.
Even before the plane lands, Srinarag literally hugs you with its snow capped mountain range, which i may add is a breath taking sight. Being done with this first impression, in a matter of 2 hours you are at the lobby of Khyber where you will meet the most courteous and warm staff to usher into your room, which is in stark contrast to the freezing temperatures outside.
The place is centrally heated, kawaz in the lobby area are on the house and its surprising how khyber functions so effortlessly in such adverse weather conditions. The secret is its staff. Hats off to them , their energy, their dedication, attention to detail is something words cannot do justice to and i think they are definitely drinking some Kashmiri concoction that gives them superhuman strength to do their work.;)
In the lobby & restaurant there are:
Shyam, Basharat, Ativ, Saptrishi & Aabid who you will see on their toes around the clock & at the pool side which faces the Affarwat you'll find Naseer & Zubaida who single handily cater to a plethora of guests of different whims & requests. 
The food is something the taste of which i yet recall fondly and the view from the rooms can be visualise just by closing the eyes, once you've been there.
If Gulmarg is the place one is hitting, Khyber is the place to be.
I look forward to planning a trip in summer where the landscape will be diffrent but the faces will be same at Khyber. :)

reviews.author: Manuj
reviews.title: Luxury at super premium rates !!
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel in the month of August. Hotel offers unparallel luxury in Gulmarg. I am a vegetarian and faced no issues with finding vegetarian food rather I loved their veg Biryani & Dum aloo kashmiri. Rooms are luxurious and toiletries match the class. All said stay at this hotel when you want to splurge but rest assured view from hotel coffee room is spectacular.

reviews.author: rahulg77
reviews.title: True luxury in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I went to Gulmarg with my wife and son. Everything was perfect right from check in. The staff was very courteous. The GM - Surjit Herbert was around in the lobby and spending time meeting all the guest. We got kahwa as welcome drink and since. My son didn't want kahwa he ordered a hot chocolate for him

The dinner and breakfast was also good and delicious. As good as one can expect up in the mountains. Only thing I didn't enjoy was the dessert on both the nights we had dinner there. They should do something about the quality of desserts. 

The spa was of excellent quality. 

Couldn't fault even one thing. Will definitely stay there if I travel with my family.

reviews.author: Divs_Kataria
reviews.title: Just beautiful!!!
reviews.text: We visited Khyber in January 2016 for lunch at their restaurant Cloves, the all day dining multi cuisine restaurant. The resort is just beautiful and divine. Lovely architecture inside with hints of Persian -Arabic culture. We had ala carte instead of buffet (which is Rs. 1800 + taxes) per person. We called for mushroom tikka with ulta parantha as starter and for main course we had aloom dum (must have if vegetarian), garlic naan and boondi raita. We ended our meal with scrumptious frozen panacotta with wild berries. Our bill came to around Rs. 2500. If you are in Gulmarg, do visit this place for awesome food and great hospitality. The premises of Khyber looks really great for stay as well with snow all around.

reviews.author: palanivelbabu
reviews.title: THE BEST EXPERIENCE IN GULMARG
reviews.text:
Beautifully located with a scenic view from all sides and the main places of interest are easily accessible from this resort. The food they serve is amazing and do not forget to be lost by the taste of the BAKED YOGURT.Service is good and very courteous staff.
The best place to stay at GULMARG..

reviews.author: Sahiba B
reviews.title: Truly magical!
reviews.text:
We spent two nights at khyber and we were blown away by the beauty of the hotel and he hospitality! The views are magical from all the rooms, the food is exceptional and the hotel staff is warm, friendly and go out of their way to serve you. I informed the hotel that it was our anniversary trip and they sent a complimentary cake with a special note on the card, with the message that we had asked to be written on the cake. 

The kahwa served at chaikash was the best in all of Kashmir, the tabak maas was outstanding and our server-iqbal was at our beck and call. 

The spa experience is a must and so is a dip in the heated indoor pool. It's a different experience to swim overlooking the forest, trees dusted with snow. 

I would like to make a special mention of a few people who went an extra mile to serve us and make our stay memorable- Nazia and Iqbal. Asif at the chaikash counted was always smiling and also offered me a free kahwa :) 

Thank you everyone at Khyber. I strongly recommend this hotel to all travellers to Gulmarg. Gulmarg isn't the same if you haven't spent at least one night at Khyber!

reviews.author: hemant b
reviews.title: One of the Best Resorts in India During the Winters!
reviews.text:
The view and location of the Resort is just amazing! 
Starting from the Lobby to the restaurants to the hookah lounge to the chai bar to the rooms to the view! The food is really really good, love the chickens, kebabs and even Dal Makhani ( Yummmm ), the resort has a facility for spa as well, all must try it, its pretty good.

reviews.author: Arshad786848
reviews.title: Super Place to Visit
reviews.text: This is a place where a person should visit if he is visiting Kashmir, though little expensive but a place for value of Money. I was fully satisfied and plans to visit next time shortly. The food was good and the place was super, the staff was excellent.

reviews.author: nidhi27
reviews.title: Yeh Haseen Wadiyan at Khyber
reviews.text:
Awesome property...staff was very courteous and helpful. 

Just felt that rooms should have been serviced before guests check in and not attended to when asked for it.

The welcome kahwa tea was the best we have had ... our group was big but the staff ensured we had a comfortable stay and our trip was memorable. 

The heated pool was loved by kids and adults...

reviews.author: ashwika2008
reviews.title: Khyber Spa and resorts
reviews.text:
We went to Kashmir in the month of November...and chose to stay in Khyber for 1 night and I am glad we did...we were lucky to get snow fall a night before we reached Gulmarg.The whole of Kyhber was covered in snow..It was all so beautiful..I could open the window of my room and touch snow..The resort is truely a luxury resort..Staff is very helpful n courteous. They have an insulated swimming pool which was unfortunately under renovation when we went..They have a nice gym and..I loved the seating areas they have kept at different places in the resort..
Food is very expensive though..So go for a package deal
.. I would strongly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: crbkrishnan
reviews.title: Excellent resort, breathtaking place
reviews.text:
Had a luxurious stay with wife and 2yo daughter. The Himalayan view room with balcony was just as shown in the pictures with breathtaking views of the mountains from the balcony and bathtub. The room was clean and spacious with a separate, comfortable walk-in closet. 
The swimming pool is just terrific - warm water, full view of the mountain - and on a clear, sunny day, a swim in the pool is one to remember for a long time. 
The lobby and lounge are tastefully done and are a great advert for Kashmiri art.
The restaurant is expensive but the dishes are tasty. Concierge services are not great, one needs to look out for a local taxi or guide just outside to go out but there were plenty when we went.
Overall, a great and memorable experience; would love to go back sometime in the future.

reviews.author: aparajita b
reviews.title: Luxurious & Indulgent
reviews.text:
Khyber is the kind of hotel you spoil yourself with. When its completely snowed out outside, you can sit in the centrally heated hotel, with decent food and areas to sit and sip your hot chocolate and watch the snow falling around you.

The rooms are luxurious and well appointed, but have small issues like the heating system, which has a mind of its own, a bathroom floor which floods a little while you're still in the shower, and the shower which is a little tricky to figure out. Nothing that cannot be ignored, when you realise the temperature outside is -12.

The staff is very pleasant, everybody from the guards at the gate (who deserve a medal for standing in that much snow), the serving staff at their restaurant, the reception, captains, house keeping staff, every individual is top notch and a its a pleasure to interact with them.

The food is super expensive, and considering there is no way you can venture out in the snow at dinner time to eat somewhere else, talk to the staff to give you a package deal. The food itself is good, with some stand outs like the mutton raan and the kadhi, though the temperature of the food is a bit of an issue.

reviews.author: ajaymehta20
reviews.title: Gstaad and a hotel to match!
reviews.text:
I'm not a snow person! Decided to stay at the Khyber for 3 nights with the family, 2 kids and my parents. from the airport till the hotel and throughout our stay, the service, the quality of people, the food, the rooms, gym, pool, spa and the overall quality were all, in two words, FIRST RATE!

Special mention to - Zafar, at the front desk, very pleasant young man who was eager to meet our requests and did so efficiently! - Shyam - at the Restaurant - super chap who knew that a good meal was the best remedy for a day out in the snow - he did not stop the goodies and was very intuitive and efficient! 

I don't have the names of the some of the other staff, but they were all Super and really made us feel special! 

My compliments to the GM too! He was again intuitive and forthcoming!

Great Stay!

reviews.author: Anon299
reviews.title: Excellent Ski/Mountain Resort
reviews.text:
There is simply nothing to fault this hotel about. I doubt if you would find a better ski/mountain resort anywhere else in the world. 
Excellent rooms, excellent service, excellent food, amazing property and facilities.
Superb indoor heated pool and spa facilities.
The staff could not be friendlier or more helpful.

reviews.author: kalebjohn
reviews.title: Only a snow resort
reviews.text: Khyber gulmarg is a snow resort typically suited to skiers while we were there it did not snow and may be because of that we d not enjoy our stay. The hotel has average views infact we liked the views of Highlands park as much better. The food also is typical 5* food and heavy. We do not recommend khyber without snow.

reviews.author: charukesi
reviews.title: Classy in every way
reviews.text:
I recently spent a memorable three days at The Khyber and came away utterly relaxed and happy with the experience. Everything about this place spells class - from the warm, wooden decor to the gracious hospitality of everyone, from the GM to the wait staff at the restaurant. I stayed in a mountain view room and woke up every morning to stunning views of snow-capped mountains and fir trees. 

The Khyber is also located within walking distance of the Gulmarg gondola but if you wish for a complete unwind experience, you can stay put at the resort. Or head to the spa. The L'Occitane spa here is pure indulgence and not to be missed.

The food at The Khyber is also a winner, beginning from the lavish breakfast spread and ending with a traditional Kashmiri Wazwan at dinner. My favourite space was the Chaikash tea lounge, where I spent a lot of time sipping on kahwa and looking out at the mountains.

This is a property I can't wait to go back to, perhaps to enjoy it in another season.

reviews.author: D_Saxena
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the property for our offsite recently and it was an excellent choice, we chose to stay in Himalyan View rooms and must say each morning presented with amazing views of snow clad mountains, food very regular great except the Kashmiri (wazwan) which was a real treat, very courteous staff, Excellent Spa, Indoor heated pool, all very well maintained. 

Special Thanks to the GM, Mr Sujith Herbert who is doing an excellent job of keeping the guests happy.. will return for sure!!

reviews.author: Ashish Jain
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel and comfort
reviews.text: Recently stayed for 3 nights, must stay in rooms with balcony, amazing view. Very comfortable stay, good food and not to miss superb SPA, Jacuzzi and hot water pool. Especially if you are in winter time during snow season a must stay hotel.

reviews.author: Raj B
reviews.title: Top Class
reviews.text: We stayed here in jan 2015. This is an amazing property very well located near gondola  in Gulmarg. The rooms are spacious and very well furnished. Premium rooms had balconies, which had beautiful views of the himalayan snow mountains. The interiors of rooms are very tastefully done, the bathrooms too are very spacious with bath tub and best fittings. and there is a changing room cum wardrobe too. The linen is top class, and the house keeping service again top class. The restaurant serves tasteful kashmiri, continental, chinese and italian cuisine. Their service is again top class. The breakfast too is pretty elaborate. The staff at the hotel is very courteous. All throughout our stay, all the staff would greet us on our way through the hotel with great respect. The hotel has a wonderful indoor heated swimming pool and an excellent well equipped gym. The spa too is run by L'occitane (I hope I get the spelling correct) which is one of the best spas in Europe. All the top corporates and who is who of the country come to stay in this wonderful resort. There are lots of other facilities in the resort which we did not explore. Overall its one of our life's best experiences of a holiday in this resort. Special thanks to Mr. Fahim & Mr. Sujith Herbert for giving us a very good deal and taking special care of us during our stay.

reviews.author: KunalSinha81
reviews.title: Luxury on paradise
reviews.text:
Excellent place and must visit...right from arrival to your departure you will feel at home and hospitality is at its best.staffs are very courteous and well trained and there is always smile on their faces.rooms are very spacious and luxurious equipped with all modern amenities.
Special thanks to Mr. Sujith ,who is the general manager for his excellent management.however a small area of improvement I can see is they can start drop in and pick up from the gondola point to their gate which is a very steep climb by foot and local hawkers will charge like anything for a 2 minutes drop.
Highly recommended by me and looking forward to come back soon.

reviews.author: Deepika1973
reviews.title: Hospitality at its BEST
reviews.text:
Being the only good hotel in Gulmarg it maintains its reputation too. Very situational as its only 5 mins walk to the Gondola from the hotel. 
 Beautifully made in all wood,the hotel gives a very welcoming feel and the staff put its best to make their guests comfortable.
 A special thanks to staff and especially Arshid Wani who made our private Bbq dinner a most memorable one and to top it all with a view of fresh snowfall.
 With a spectacular view of gulmarg covered in all snow and the hospitality of Khyber hotel and staff,it was one of our most memorable trip.

reviews.author: Firas1973
reviews.title: Pleasant Surprise
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at Khyber for a week early January of 2015, and it has been nothing short of spectacular. Right from the airport pick-up with the friendly driver Hamid, to Zaffar at check-In and across all the different departments at the hotel, we were greeted with warmth, great hospitality and exceptional service. The hotel is clean and modern, with a local retro feel to it. Our room was spacious, comfortable with all the modern amenities you would expect from a 5 star hotel, and we had a big balcony looking over the breathtaking white Himalayan mountains. Wow!

It is also worth mentioning that the people of Kashmir are an extremely welcoming people that are social and friendly. Gulmarg and the surrounding villages are no exception. 

Thank you Gulmarg.

reviews.author: VibhavAgrahari
reviews.title: Gulmarg, Kashmir, India
reviews.text: Beautiful property, best location, tempting food, nice & courteous staff. A bar-b-que dinner was organised for us which was simply superb. Spa by Loccatane was also very good. Our overall stay was good. Would love to go there again & again !!

reviews.author: Achal Manglik
reviews.title: The Khyber E Khas Effect 10on10
reviews.text: So it all started with one small mention by one of my friend. I stayed in this property with my group for 4 nights to do some filming of our show The Dewarist Mtv. This place has given us something special which cant de describe , it has some special vibe with breathtaking views which are unforgettable. Everything is smooth starting from airport pick up , lovely 2 hours drive to hotel and then the true heave , "You have arrived" . Best part is Mr Sujith Herbert's GM of this unique property will be there in lobby always to make sure you are having a great time. Just stop anytime and hot kawa will be there for you. F&B staff is the sweetest of all , just initiate your request , One tip , Find Aman and ask for khyber special ice cream. One of the best spa and swimming pool i have ever visited and everyone welcome you with smile that you forget that you away from home. Whole Property is centrally Heated one of its kind and give an advantage to be best in all seasons. Just go and spend some quality time with your loved ones. At the end a big thanks to Mr.Omar for creating this gem on earth and Mr.Faheem for the super deal. Thank you all !

reviews.author: Code-Name-God
reviews.title: The Gem of Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Thought the whole air trip to the hotel was full of gloominess that the snow was would not have been as much as the last year. But everything changed while Chauffeur greeted with a warm welcome at the airport. We talked a lot about the recent flood happened in Srinagar and how fast it has recovered. I could not find much signs of the flood around the route. Everything was same as before. From Tangmarg the scene started to become white and the beauty of snow was visible.
When I reached the hotel the checkin process was just like as we are back to our home after a long break. The fascinating fact was that everyone around was so happy to welcome you to your new home. The interior of the hotel was so wonderful and maintained in such a nice manner that the wood work amazed me how a boutique hotel could exist in such a poles apart weather.
The room was so large and beautifully maintained that it had everything to make your vacation a memorable one. The amenities were spread from the large LCD TV to a minute emergency torch where you won't need to call the reception for anything else.
In every way the indoors mirror the beauty of the outdoors. The widespread resort boasts different options to get engaged like the 'Chaikash' the coffee lounge, 'Cloves' the restaurant, 'Calabash' the cigar & sheesha lounge, 'Igloo' the kids area, and 'Den' the movie theatre.
'The Khyber Spa by L'Occitane' one of the must try area which includes Spa, Gym, Heated Pool, Separate Steam, Sauna, & Jacuzzi for Men & Woman. The Spa is one of India’s most luxurious and holistic well-being experience. I would recommend a treatments set which can include and Massage & Facial or Scrub, Wrap, & Massage. They are so professional & will pamper you like in a heaven of indulgence.
Thanks to Mr. Sujit Herbert the General Manager who is always there to make sure that you are having a great stay, Mr. Jerin Philip the Front of the House Man who will assist you in each and every aspect of your needs, Mr. Santosh Pandey the Executive Home Keeper who will make sure the stay is far better than at your home, and each employee who takes care of their area so well that you will feel like not to return to your home.

reviews.author: Nikhilraj1968
reviews.title: The Khyber
reviews.text:
This was our second time at the Khyber and it was brilliant. The GM and the staff left no stone un-turned to ensure that we had the best vacation possible. The service at the Khyber is very good with every staff well trained and mannered. So the atmosphere is always very positive.

The heated pool is one of the best feature of the hotel. A fully equipped gym with steam, sauna and jacuzzi and a top class spa helps take away the aches form the skiing and trekking. Good food at the restaurants kept us well fed.

The hotel is very close to the gondola to ride to the ski slopes and also close to the bunny slope for beginners.

Excellent value.

reviews.author: Harsh S
reviews.title: The place to stay
reviews.text: Wonderful ambience, heated swimming pool, relaxing jacuzzi, extensive menu, mouth watering food, wonderful service, eye passing decor. Highly recommended. Wooden architecture was pleasing. Lot of sit-in and sit-out areas with expansive view of the snow clad mountains.

reviews.author: SamayGambhir
reviews.title: Amazing holiday
reviews.text: I feel that it was the best hotel in the area. The staff are extremely polite, helpful and efficient. the views of the balcony and nouf are amazing. The rooms at the hotel were amazing. There were good bathrooms in the room. Every room had a heating system.   The location is amazing for a person visiting for an outdoor activity. It is a minute away from the gondola cable car service and 5 minutes away from the golf course/ beginner slopes in ski season. The design of the room was very thoughtful. The highlight of the hotel was the pool and spa complex. They have a heated pool and separate jacuzzis, saunas and steam baths for men and women. Just sitting in the jacuzzi after 5 hours of skiing was very relaxing. The view from the swimming pool is amazing. you feel the warmth of the pool while looking at the snow capped himalayas. I however did not use the spa. The hospitality provided by the hotel was great. The only downside was that the facilities at the igloo (gaming area) were not so good. They had only two games for the xbox and used all sorts of equipment for different games. They have a really good restaurant. the kashmiri kahwa is a must try. special meantion to the staff Ishfaq(restaurant), Sajad Ahmed Lone(restaurant and Gulzar(housekeeping). Overall it was an amazing holiday.

reviews.author: ahmedunaiz
reviews.title: Great family retreat!
reviews.text:
What an experience! 
This was my first trip to Kashmir and going to Gulmarg and staying at the Khyber hotel made it all the more memorable. The staff were really friendly and went out of they way to make us feel comfortable, we had kids with us  and the hotel was equipped to take care of them, they had play area and a room with games and stuff.
The spa treatments were really world class, after a day of skiing and being outdoor  the massage was relaxing and masseurs were experienced.they even had a steam room in each of the massage rooms. 
We used the gym and heated pool as well as the jacuzzi . All of which were clean and well maintained.
The rooms were tastefully furnished and care was taken to provide all the necessary comforts. The deep sunken tub with Himalayan view had a romantic yet relaxing feel.
They even have a cloak room at the entrance to leave the boots and snow gear. That was very thoughtful and convenient.
The hotel felt like a palace and was maintained like a seven star stay. 
I would definitely recommend it for families it really worth the stay.

reviews.author: MFNAZ
reviews.title: Best resort
reviews.text: We stayed here in the month of July,it was the best experience  we had.staff of the hotel is well trained.Hotel is newly built n will take time to get better in all aspects.We enjoyed our stay.Would love to visit again.

reviews.author: 102brijesht
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth :)
reviews.text: One of the best resorts in India, Its certainly a heaven on earth, once you stay at khyber you're not going anywhere else. You come to the balcony of your room & what you experience is surely not to be described in words, snow clad peaks, amazing forests, The gondola rides close by & the world class restaurants serving amazing kashmiri cuisine. There's a brilliant cinnamon fragrance around the property, wonderful managed & a luxurious experience put together by the management. Can't wait to get back here.

reviews.author: kumsachu
reviews.title: Fantabulous
reviews.text:
What more can we have asked for a beautiful resort with mind blowing scenery all around taking care of each and every guest like their own family members.

RESORT AMBIANCE:
The Ambiance is perfect and beautiful. They have paid attention to even the smallest of the details. All wall decorations and antiques are sourced locally displaying Kashmiri's culture and history.

ROOMS : 
We stayed in Premier room. It was spacious and well designed. Nicely done corridors leading to the room and well planned bathroom and bed. The view out of the window is amazing. Centrally heated and attentive room service.

RESTAURANT :
Food was awesome. We tried both the buffet and ala carte bith were outstanding. In fact the local dishes like mutton roganjosh etc were mouth watering. Very tender meat. Some guests have written that menu was too small. But I think it is a fair enough menu given the remote location of the resort and the variety it offers I was pretty impressed. 

STAFF:
Reserved the best for the last :). Where ever you go, how well you enjoy your vacation depends on the people around you. We felt like we were at home when we stayed in Khyber. Right from the manager, waiters, secutriy every one was very friendly and welcoming. Infact  most of them shared there contacts with us and some of them even messaged and checked whether we reached Bangalore safely as our flight was cancelled at the last moment.
SUJIT
SHAKIB
AZAAD
AIJAZ  are just few names of a endless list.

When our flight was cancelled they helped us in booking an earlier flight and arranged the transport to airport with ease. 

Even during our reservation Imran and Quershi were very helpful in answering all of our queries with respect to the resort.

All of them are efficient in their work and also very friendly.

Truly a five star resort and worth all the money which you pay for.

reviews.author: Avijit D
reviews.title: Has the potential to mature into its distinctive uniqueness....
reviews.text:
It's important to state, at the onset that khyber, is just a couple of years old. So its distinctiveness & certain elements of its character is yet to evolve. But certainly got the start going for it, which has put Gulmarg glamourously on the map of snow destinations.

The Architecture and the picturesque setting, modern bathrooms, heated indoor pool, the spa and being a short trot away from the Gondola are definitely spectacular starts. It's probably the most comfortable and luxurious that you can get as a winter destination. Is an Must do experience.

The human interactions, the distinctive food as well as integration with the local culture & environment is what creates lasting impressions. Food for thought, as Khyber i am sure, will go about creating its distinctive uniqueness in years to come.

Allow me to elaborate.....

Will always remember Gul Chacha, our guide and the chacha for the whole Gulmarg. Will remembers the conversations with locals @ Bakshi dhaba down at the village. Unfortunately, don't remember any such human interactions @ Khyber which have made an impact. Pakizah at the front desk was sweet & did stretch herself to attend to our needs. Should be mentioned. An unfortunate start to our stay at Khyber was that while checking in, the front desk announced that the transfer that we had made prior to arrival was short by 11k INR, so if we could settle that first before settling into our rooms. After showing email interactions with Imran Khan @ reservations, the front desk apologized that they had made an error and everything was paid. Maybe systems issue, but was not a very great start to human interactions within 15 mins of arriving @ Khyber.

Surprisingly Kashmiri dishes were not part of the room service menu. The buffet dinner was standard stuff without any emphasis on local culture & cuisine. The Tabak Maas and the roganjosh that we ordered Ala-carte, was similar or worse than what we have had at any restaurant at Delhi or Mumbai or other metros.

Little details could have made the difference. Gondola tickets made available right at the hotel for example, anti-skid mats in the showers (and please do away with the decorative carpet in the bathroom. Slipped and almost fell twice), personalised butlers, more seating capacity for breakfast across the property, are some of the suggestions, which could be positive steps in the right direction.

Will probably return to experience Khyber 2.0

reviews.author: Amios7368
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text:
The Gm, the finest smiling man greeting 24/7,the food great the staff receptive 
A must visit to the travellers who like cold weather conditions, 
Only drawback no bar, I trapped in the hotel nothing to do, if travelling alone
Swimming pool fabulously heated 
Kahva should be served at tea time with snacks complimentary, 
The  restaurant staff super good.... 
 Concierge and travel desk absent though all staff helpful but would prefer a full time desk. 
Also a suggestion for a kashmir goods shop very much required.
