reviews.author: Bobby15801
reviews.title: THE BEST SERVICE EVER
reviews.text:
We, my children and grand children, stayed at the Khyber from 3 Jan 2015 to 13 Jan 2015. We had come to enjoy the snow and do some skiing - but it was not to be. Though we were a little disappointed as there was no snow, the staff of this wonderful hotel made up for this lack of snow and made our stay most enjoyable and memorable. 
We were received and welcomed by the General Manager, Mr Sujith Herbert personally, inspite of his busy schedule as the hotel was fully booked. This warm gesture of his made us forget the lack of snow. Through out our stay the complete staff were very friendly and most efficient and ensured there was nothing wanting. Whereas I thank the complete staff for making are stay so comfortable I would also like to make a special mention of Dy Manager Zafar and house keeping staff Gulzar & Ishfaq Wani. I would like to make a special mention of Mr Herbert, who went out of his way to make us comfortable and made it feel like a home away from home, a gesture very few people at his level do. 
Thanks team KHYBER we will definitely be back soon and highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: GurgaonShaishav
reviews.title: The best resort in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Stayed at Khyber, in the first week of January 2015. The big attraction of Gulmarg - the Gandola, is very close to the resort.

Experience - very good, to start with. They welcome you with a hot Kahwa - which was very good. Checked in well, The pickup at the Srinagar hotel was also well organised (costs additional). Staff is well trained, ready to help you in which ever way they can. From giving advice, to giving contact numbers for shopping etc, they will also help you in every possible side. Room service was prompt, always delivered the tea / snacks in time. Spa - is a luxury. Steam room / Sauna / Jacoozi / Gym are well maintained. The restaurant (only one operational) had good cooked food. And the B/fast spread was also nice.
Some let downs though : The Bathrooms - will not give a five star resort look. Tiles (at least in our room - 2003) were not well set. Could see the strains, easily. The Shower point would leak, makign the external wooden area wet. To operate the shower, one had to go in and get some cold water, before you get the hot water experience. Somethign wrong with the shower.
There was no choice of the restaurants (although, as I said, the one restaurant did serve good food),
Some names, worth mentioning. Sujith H, GM, was very courteous to give us cash and add the same to our final bill. ATMs somehow are very difficult to find in Gulmarg. Atir in the F&B was always there to greet us in the restaurant and help us get everything fresh. Muzaffar in the hookah bar - his service / approach - should be appreciated.

reviews.author: ramaaIndia
reviews.title: Beauty , with some beast issues .
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber  during the last week of December  2014 . The hotel is built very close to the gondola and is a visual treat . There was some snow , and we  were awed with the entire experience of driving in into the  hotel..The lobby  was mind blowingly awesome and the kahwa delicious . Our check in  was very smooth , in fact the service was excellent throughout our stay .Every staff member was very courteous and eager to please . The restaurant staff especially were extremely  courteous and  prompt in their service . Food was exorbitantly expensive , but then in Gulmarg ,  choices are few . Sheer pampering during the spa sessions , very professional . 
Letdown - quality of sleep , we were in the  premier rooms  and there was an issue with the heating   in the room , the room felt stuffy at night  and though the problem was instantly attended to , it just spoilt that night for us . We again faced the same issue on our second night stay there , but we slept through as we were tired , having gone to apharwat that day 
This was not expected , for a five star luxury resort and it was a definite letdown after having stayed in the Hyatt group of hotels in the same trip.
This apart , Khyber is a very beautiful  place to stay in and enjoy for sure ! would maybe stay there again .

reviews.author: anubhavbindraa
reviews.title: Could have been much better
reviews.text: Hotel Khyber in gulmarg is a relatively new hotel and best in its class in gulmarg. The rooms are a mix and match of everything but workable. The lobby looks lika a museum with loads of memorabilia. The food is not that tasty as it should have been and service is slow. Spa though is good. For the price should have been much better.

reviews.author: Ravi D
reviews.title: A must to visit Khyber Himalayan resort Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber on Dec 25th 2014 to 28th Dec 2014, and what a place to stay in.The reception guys introduce you to this beautiful property overlooking the snow capped mountains.Take a room with a balcony.The pine tress are a stone throw away and at a few mile distance you see the snowy Himalayan range and the view is just magnificent.In the morning the cold winds blow and sipping coffee in the balcony breathing that air is a true aphrodisiac.I traveled with my wife and daughter and the staff makes you feel so warm.The buffet is just great but also try the kashmiri dishes from the Ala card its good too.The location of the hotel allows kids to play in the snow in the hotel itself and jumping back to a warm environment as soon as the play is over.The hotel is like a fortress and the security guys are just fab.They look the NSG kinds.
Special thanks to Mr Sujith Herbert, the general manager  a special person you can never miss during your stay.Guys from the restaurant,Aijaz and Ishfaq doing a great job.cheers!!

reviews.author: Dutchie_in_Delhi
reviews.title: At this price point, should do better!
reviews.text:
We went to the Khyber to spend Christmas on the roof of the world.
Although our overall experience was pleasant, the mountains beautiful, the hotel nicely decorated and the company splendid (3 best friends!), there were some disappointments which at this price point are nearly unacceptable.
Kashmir is a wonderful but conflicted area, and the existence of this resort is a good sign for its development and economic growth. Being owned by a local, the love for the valley is to be seen throughout the resort, beautiful handicrafts and traditional furniture are applied with care.
The spa is gorgeous and wonderful, all three of us got a treatment there which deeply relaxed us.
Now, for the disappointments:
- tea served was Tetley.... Seriously? In India? In a luxury resort? A supermarket brand tea bag? 
- our (standard) room had view over the parking lot.
- even though we had had several email exchanges with the resort, check in was confused and staff nervous.
- only one restaurant was open. It was OK but nothing exceptional. Actually there was a second restaurant open. Specializing in grilled meats. But it served outdoors, with temperatures below zero.... Even the gas heaters couldn't make up for the cold.
- the hotel has a snooker table, but in that room you can neither eat nor drink.
- no alcohol. I understand it's Kashmir, but still.
- slow service, at breakfast we had to wait upwards of 10 minutes to get our coffee/tea
-diesel fumes from heating system wafting their way into the hotel.

So overall I would, unfortunately, not go back here.

reviews.author: amritadelhi
reviews.title: Khyber only if you a foreigner
reviews.text: We stayed in hotel Khyber resorts Gulmarg and during our stay we experienced that you are not treated equitant to what foreigners are. While we were in dinning there were 2 foreign groups, one from Europe and another far eastern, & all focus was on them and consequently our service was delayed and staff was not attentive to us. We want to remind the management that we probably paid as much as those foreign groups pay so why the discrimination. Be aware specially if you are going in winters when foreign groups come for skiing.

Some pointers though: ..in winter, oil heaters maybe more useful as the room gets very dry with the air-conditioning heaters. It will be good to have some heathers in the bathrooms. The buffet at the restaurant was average.  Overall, a memorable experience and well worth recommending to others

reviews.author: Michael R
reviews.title: Khyber Ski Holiday
reviews.text:
We visited the Khyber on a family skiing holiday along with several other families during the second week of January 2014. 

Overall we were very pleased with our stay, and we look forward to returning on an annual basis.

Rooms:  We had two adjoining balcony rooms.  They were spacious and well appointed.  The beds and pillows were very comfortable.  Storage areas were enough to accommodate all of our extra ski gear / clothing.  However the passage way between rooms was a little narrow.  Bathrooms were spacious with lots of natural light.  Overall the fit and finish of the rooms was quite nice.

Service:  Outstanding!  We travel frequently each year (Asia, Europe, and North America), so we are exposed to many levels of service.  The personalized service we received at the Khyber was excellent on a global scale.  The team at all levels are very well trained, and attentive to details.

There was some work going on near our room - down the hall leading towards the Spa and pool.  When walking through there was a strong odour from the paint / adhesive being used.  However this was not noticeable in our rooms, nor was it persistent throughout our stay.  Both the staff and the trades people did a good job at minimizing the inconvenience.  Even the trades people were very courteous as we walked by!

Special mention for Mr. Adityia, GM.  He seemed to be always present in the main hall, and checking on how his guests were enjoying their stay.  It was very clear that he enjoys his role, and takes great pride in the property he looks after.

Monsoor at the front desk was also exemplary in his assistance.  Both check in and check out was seamless. 

Aabid, general assistance at the front door.  On a daily basis he helped with ski boots, equipment, and the general chaos of getting several kids ready for a day on the mountain.  He went far beyond the call of duty - and it was greatly appreciated!  

Location: There is tremendous natural beauty surrounding Gulmarg and the Khyber is well situated to enjoy all of it.  Fantastic views from almost every part of the resort, we enjoyed all of it.

Moving between the hotel and the gondola requires the use of the hotel transport.  The walk is simply too far for children (especially in ski boots).  Moreover given the grade of the hill and icy conditions it wouldn't be advisable to walk. After a day of skiing, the last thing you'll want to do is hike back up that hill. The transport provided by the hotel was hit and miss, granted there were many guests utilizing the service.  Taking the direct number of the driver helped.

Possibly with some future planning, this property could be ski in ski out - but for now, take the transport and skip the walk.    

From a skiers perspective, there are two things missing at this property:
1) a large fireplace in a common area.  After a full day of skiing, sitting next to the fire is a great way to relax and warm up.  Possibly this is something they can add outside on one of the large patios at a later time.
2) a good Ski shop.  It would be a tremendous service and convenience for skiers if there were a quality facility within the resort to: 
     a) Purchase clothing, equipment, or accessories that may have been forgotten or lost
     b) Rent equipment - skis, boots, poles, gear, ect.
     c) Ski School - 85% of the skiers in Gulmarg appear to be utilizing some form of instruction 
     d) Ski / tour guides - skiing, trekking, snowshoeing, snowmobiling, ect.

While many of these points can be found within Gulmarg, they are in various stages of development.  Some are great, some good, others are to be avoided.  Gulmarg may be decades behind whats offered at European and North American ski resorts - but its changing quickly.   It would be great to have a single stop location within the resort that maintained the quality and service of the hotel itself.

Overall a great property worthy of a recommendation.

Thank you to the Khyber staff for a memorable holiday.

reviews.author: Dinesh B
reviews.title: Holidays in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Extremely great location near the Gondola (for skiers) with well furnished and comfortable rooms.Excellent food but service can be very patchy and takes time. Stayed in December 2013/Jan 2014 for peak season and not all restaurants were opened apart from a central buffet. Room service was very slow.The dedicated shuttle service into Gulmarg can be non-existent during high occupancies. Rafi at the Front Desk was excellent sorting out our issues. I was not told that alcohol was not served when i made my reservations,

reviews.author: Anshu S
reviews.title: Great Stay and Enjoyed
reviews.text:

The hotel is luxurious with spectacular view from the room
One can just sit in the balcony and keep watching the mountains and natural beauty of the place

reviews.author: Nikhilraj1968
reviews.title: The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa
reviews.text:
Wonderful hotel.Stunning view from our room. Friendly and very accommodatiing staff.Great food.

reviews.author: DELHIGURU
reviews.title: OVER RATED BUT NO OTHER CHOICE
reviews.text: Ok, I stay in the best hotels of the world but I am not at all fussy. I take most hotels in good stride. Being a road warrior, I am in hotels across the globe more than 150 nights a year. I was very excited about my first trip to Kashmir and my initial stay was at the Taj Vivanta in Srinagr which was excellent (would hopefully write a separate review abt that). Anyway, expectations were high about Khyber. Excellent, mind boggling, wow were some of the superlatives which I heard from people about this property. Well, anything but that. Heaven forbid you are not in their deluxe wing but in the premium wing. Congrats if you are because you can hear everything what your neighbors are talking about, from going to the loo to what time does breakfast end. Every word. We saw "comedy nights with Kapil" without even switching on our own TV. So, what these guys have done is build a brick wall of one brick and ensured you can hear every word, every loud f&&& which happens in both the corridor outside your room and in your neighbor's room. Ok, given they have built a hotel in one of the world's most beautiful places which would have been rough terrain to build a hotel but still, no excuses for the rates they were charging us. If hearing your neighbors talk about their loo habits was not bad enough, the nauseating smell in the corridors would kill you. Seriously. Bad bad bad smell in all corridors and attempted to cover it  up with "Ittar" fragrance, especially again in the lower premium room corridors. It was the worst smell and that is what will hit you the moment you enter the hotel. The third aspect of my review is the funniest and most dangerous. I twist the knob of my rain shower and boom, I get an electric shock through the handle. I thought I imagined it. I turn down the water pressure and boom again, another mild electric shock. Yes it was fixed after my complaint but still that was quite a first. Couple of other peculiar points :- the hotel does not have enough cars of its own to cater to all the guests. In the cigar room, cigars and sheeshas are allowed but no ciggies!!!!!!!! Breakfast buffets was bad. Bad in taste and bland.  Very claustrophobic hotel. The problem is there is no other hotel in Gulmarg, with Highland park gone down the drain over time (the old Kashmir travelers still speak so nostalgically about it but alas, it's finished... Went there for a drink and promptly walked out... It seemed they had not changed the curtains in 50 years)..... So, for all delhiites and bombayiites used to the luxuries of their Oberoi and taj hotels, you will find this property very very disappointing....at most a 3 star property... In my books, not even that... Oh yes, some of the staff was very helpful and that was a plus....gulmarg was amazing and it snowed when we ushered in 2014.... So the electric shocks, smells, bad breakfast buffets were all forgotten in the chill and thrill of awesome snow falling from the heavens :). Forgot to mention, no bar in the hotel and it does not serve any alcohol so BYOB people and there is no liquor shop in Gulmarg

reviews.author: Kunal B
reviews.title: Well Built Property but Location of Highland Park the best
reviews.text:
Its a beautiful Property with well appointed rooms and good central heating. We were provided a Complimentary Upgrade for which I would like to thank the management.

However, the hotel disappointed in the variety that was laid out in the buffet (breakfast lunch dinner). Having just come from the Lalit Srinagar the buffets were a big disappointment. The Ala Carte was comparatively better. There were issues regarding availability of a vehicle for the gondola drops and pick-ups especially in the snowy-Icy Wintertime up the steep slope of the Hotel. The Kahwa served at the hotel was excellent. The spa seemed in good shape but the pool had some heating issues which should hopefully be sorted out soon. The location of the pool is excellent though. 

Though the Hotel does provide excellent views of the mountains but the main affarwat peak gets blocked due to the pine trees. In fact the best views of the meadows as well as mount affarwat are to be had from the Highland Park. 

Though we enjoyed our stay at the hotel but I believe the hotel is a bit overpriced.

reviews.author: Amitarya28

You wont believe your eyes for a moment that in Gulmarg such jewel hotel can come up..very well designed; at an amazing location; warmth at its peak; excellent n well balanced food preperation; nice presentation... truly stupendous...every time i looked outside my room's window it was as if i m seeing a wallpaper... good job done 'The Khyber'...

reviews.author: rajatwal
reviews.title: New hotel in average location
reviews.text: Hotel khyber in gulmarg is a new property and we stayed after booking through our travel agent. We had a breakfast plan and we ordered a la carte for the main course, the food was good but exorbitantly priced specialty the vegetarian meals. The hotel and rooms are nice but the location is very average as some of the other hotels in gulmarg like nedous & highlands offer much better views. We were not informed by our agent that the hotel did not have a bar, that too after paying 17k per room, which ruined our holiday as besides gondola there's nothing else to do in gulmarg. reviews.author: TraveldocMumbai
reviews.title: The Khyber experience - heaven on earth
reviews.text:
We were 2 families and had booked our stay in Luxury Balcony Rooms for 3 nights well in advance by direct payment.

The back office is a little slow in their response and one may require to telephone once or twice to get acknowledgement of funds transferred. I suggest that they have a pre-determined  cut-off time window (say 3 working days) to streamline this.

The location of this resort is really 8 star ! The view from the room gives a heaven on earth feel in winter. We were welcomed with Kahwa and the check-in was smooth.

There were few issues in the bathroom area which had leak around the glass partition which they fixed with sealant and the other room had a problem with the bath tub taps which also they fixed by 2 people working for more than 2 hours. Apart from this the rooms were in immaculate condition and upkeep.

Whenever there was a power outage the power came back within 10 seconds ! We were also informed of an emergency flashlight in the room, but we never required to use it.

If one wants to experience the beauty of Gulmarg and relax, then Khyber is the place.

We had 3 teenagers with us interested in learning skiing and we had contacted Khursheed (9906609693) well in advance and he took excellent care of the children and all of them learnt to balance and do basic skiing within 3 separate sessions of about 2 hours each. Snow shoes were delivered to our hotel within a hour of our arrival.

Khyber provided free drop and pick-up to and from the Golf course where the beginners slopes are and their service was prompt. Thank you Mr. Mudasir - Concierge.

The breakfast was a lavish spread and we have never eaten such tasty Potato Vadas even here in Mumbai ! 2 mini-meals items like fish stew, chicken stew, chole, baked beans and pao-bhaji were always on the menu for breakfast !

We had nearly all our meals in the our rooms since the children were tired after the skiing sessions and the service  was immaculate. We were particularly impressed by Mr.Yasir Ahmed Shah (Guest services associate) and Khyber management should cite him as an example for others to follow. The Chicken Tikka  in red chilli & Seekh Kababs were fantastic. The Chinese and Continental  food was also delicious and we were given the liberty to order from the daily buffet menu also.

I am not too sure about this ( and my apologies in advance, if I am wrong ), but the menu card seems to have mixed up Rista with Gushtaba in describing Rista as one with white gravy and Gushtaba with red gravy while the converse is true ! Mirchwangan Korma really stood out as a spicy dish.

The changing rooms in the gym & spa area  were not fully functional and we were one of the first guests to enjoy the swimming pool which was heated to about 27 Celsius. A small kiddies pool was also functional. The steam room should be operational as I write this review, but sauna was functional. The pool attendant was kind to deliver our swimming costumes dried to our room within an hour ! The hygiene in the spa (outsourced) was immaculate. There is also a small café just outside the pool for beverages/snacks.

The heating within all areas of  the resort  is really comfortable and it may sound paradoxical but one actually looks forward to the blast of icy air (at a cool minus celsius) hitting your face as you step out of the hotel. In fact Khyber has installed transparent plastic vertical split curtains outside to even minimise this blast of icy air !

The resort is in the process of opening a new cottage section with small individual cottages, which should be another attraction, but we were in no way bothered by any noise and / or workers.

Khyber will turn out to be a world-class resort if only they train their restaurant & house-keeping staff to five star standards. The front office guys, concierge, vehicle drivers are perhaps the only ones who really stand out. Mr. Mudasir (Concierge) satisfies every request. We extended our stay by 1 more night since the children were enjoying the skiing lessons and the food; were lucky to be accomodated for the additional night due to the efforts of Mr. Manuj Bahl & Mr. Wasim. Thank you for the wonderful experience ! We will visit again.

Visiting Gulmarg without staying at Khyber will deny you the heaven on earth experience.

reviews.author: Amit_Mittal66
reviews.title: Great hotel and location
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is great and its ambiance amazing - done up in wood and warm feeling. Very upmarket pricing both in room and food. The hotel has complimentary pick up and drop to the gondola which is at the bottom of the small hill (its good in the evening when you are returning , we preferred to walk down).  Beware of the absolutely unreasonable MANDATORY dinner over Christmas eve priced at Rs 4725/- per head (just not worth it) which is not informed, billed to the guests and not informed by the travel agent or agoda website (the same kind of mandatory cover charge applies for even the new year eve).  Other than that the stay was wonderful -  if the weather had been good in terms of less cold, then the bar-be que option on the 1st floor would have been great.  The balcony rooms are good; however their bathroom / tub area (especially on the ground floor and below levels) is viewable from adjoining or the top floors if you keep the blind up (if you keep the blind down then the USP of seeing the snow clad mountain slopes while having a hot tub bath is of no use). reviews.text:

it is located at a height, close to the gondola ski lift where the serious skiers would want to be.
since the property is very new, they do not have protocols set in place for skiers - people were entering with their ski boots and ski sticks - which must be murder on the flooring as well as carpeting! they need to set up a changing room/ lounge for skiers to change their footwear etc.
The central atrium is awesome with a high dome, wooden flooring, thick carpets and walls adorned with great paintings.
we sat in the tea lounge and ordered the kashmiri tea - ' kahwa' and it was delicious - flavoured with saffron and served with sliced almonds on the side.
had a chat with the hotel manager who was knowledgeable, pleasant, helpful and passionate about his role - the plan is to set up a spa as well as a year round swimming pool soon. he proudly announced that the property is already a member of the 'small luxury hotel' group - a great honour.
we dined at the coffee shop - the menu is extensive, compared to what was till now available at Gulmarg. The order got confused - they got us stuff we had not ordered, but were prompt to rectify.
a great property, very very new, hopefully with a great future!

Our favorite bit was the large traditional diwans/chairs that have been set up in the lobby, perfect for soothing your tired feet after a strenuous day up the mountain or just curling up with a book. 

Hotel staff members were very kind in helping out with local transport, medicines etc. We were quite impressed by their tea bar and hookah lounge. Buffet lunch/breakfast was very good. Do not miss the hara-bhara kebabs which were absolutely mind blowing.

I cant wait to plan another holiday to Khyber Himalayan to experience yet another day in the life of a king!

reviews.author: pankaj
reviews.title: Great location and view but needs improvement with pricing and customer service
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐ 7/10

We stayed at Khyber Resort & Spa with our family for one night during Eid and had a mixed but generally enjoyable experience.

The highlight of the resort is undoubtedly the accommodation and location. The rooms are exceptionally spacious, beautifully designed, well-lit, and offer spectacular views. The swimming pool is absolutely stunning—temperature-controlled, impeccably maintained, and surrounded by breathtaking scenery. It is easily one of the most memorable features of the property.

However, there are a few areas where the experience fell short of expectations.

The biggest disappointment was the in-room dining. While we expected premium pricing at a luxury resort, the value for money was difficult to justify. We paid approximately ₹2,000 for a pizza and another ₹2,000 for a club sandwich. Unfortunately, the club sandwich that arrived was more like a basic chicken-and-mayonnaise sandwich rather than the classic club sandwich we expected. The pizza was equally underwhelming—flat, ordinary, and more reminiscent of a commercial pizza than a premium resort offering. The food presentation and overall dining experience did not match the pricing.

Room service was also slower than expected and could certainly be more responsive.

As we stayed during Eid and our package included both breakfast and dinner, we were hoping for a special festive dining experience showcasing local Kashmiri cuisine or Eid specialties. Instead, the dinner buffet felt fairly standard and lacked the festive touch we had anticipated.

Another point worth mentioning is the cost of the extra bed. We requested an additional bed for our child and were charged approximately ₹13,000, including breakfast and dinner. While we understand that Khyber is positioned as a luxury resort, this felt excessive when compared with other premium properties we stayed at during the same trip. At Pine & Peak, Pahalgam, we paid around ₹4,500 for an extra bed, and at Taj Dal View, Srinagar, approximately ₹5,000. Khyber’s charge was therefore more than two-and-a-half times higher. Premium pricing is expected, but the differential felt difficult to justify.

What disappointed me most, however, was the handling of guest feedback at checkout. Before leaving, I wanted to share my observations directly with the Front Office or Operations Manager so that the feedback could be used constructively. The receptionist kindly offered to contact the manager, but I was informed that the manager was busy in a meeting and that I should simply post my feedback online instead. For a property of this stature, I found this response disappointing. Guest feedback—whether positive or negative—is valuable, and taking a few moments to acknowledge a departing guest’s concerns would have demonstrated a stronger commitment to customer service and continuous improvement.

To be fair, Khyber is a beautiful luxury property with world-class views, spacious rooms, and excellent facilities. However, the pricing of ancillary services, dining experience, and responsiveness to guest feedback are areas where the resort can improve.

Overall, I would rate the experience 7/10. Had the pricing of add-on services been more reasonable and the service experience more polished, it could easily have been a 9/10 stay.

— Pankaj

reviews.title: Visiting the mountain

We travel from JAMMU to Srinagar with AIR INDIA,  our tour was organize by TRK HOSPITALITY AND LOGISTICS,  TRK does a incredible job booking flights, hotels tours, etc.   Once we arrive in Srinagar we were greeting by Kyber hotel associates, Asif Husain, we provided us with wonderful Kashmiri tea Kava,  it was delicious,  then he introduce me to our driver Kareem who drove us to the hotel,  Hotel is about 1:30 min from Srinagar Airport.  Akbar gave us lot of information regarding the area, how they grow rice and dry fruits.  Ride was comfortable joyful,  the whole area was full of security forces,

Last 45 min of drive was extremely scenic, we climb up to 9000ft and it got colder.   

Hotel is absolutely beautiful with great service.   We has some appetizers while we wait for our rooms to be ready.  Hotel does not have a Bar, but a lovely Italian resto, great buffet,  our waiter Abdul Kadir, was phenomenal.  We kids had a little upset stomach,  he promptly got us a doctor.  Like in 10 min.  Doc provided some medicine to the kids and by morning they were fine.

reviews.author: Madhuri S
reviews.title: Luxury with an extra touch of love and care
reviews.text:
We booked the Himalayan view deluxe rooms that come with a balcony sitout with brilliant views of the snow capped Apharwat peak and other ranges around. It's difficult to even imagine a better located property. It's a couple of mins walk from the prime attraction - the Gondola (cable car ropeway) that takes one close to the top of the Apharwat peak - and then a short snowy trek to get to the top. The Khilanmarg horse riding point surrounded by the characteristic conifers of Kashmir is a few mins walk too.

Rooms and bathrooms are well appointed and decently sized, though not lavish. But what caught my attention most is the level of attention to detail in service. When we asked to be shifted to the upper floor from the originally assigned room on the lower floor corner - the request was accomodated with a smile with no hassle. I'm more used to dark, dirty looks from even the best of properties - when asking for anything they haven't offered upfront. The attitude of "yes, with pleasure", was apparent across all service staff from the very helpful concierge, restaurant staff, housekeeping and even the security guards. Rare to find an uniformly friendly, helpful band of staff - especially when they were very clearly running full house. 

The local kashmiri fare served a la care at their main restaurant Clove deserves a special mention, along with the excellent deli and bakery Chaikash. Their selection of bakery surprisingly rivaled some of the best I've sampled in Europe, and hardly ever if at all anywhere in India. Compliments to the chef Hira Singh (insta @chefhira). His fruit gateaux and butter croissants were particularly amazing.

The rest of their Indian food leaves much to desire though. And the dinner buffet is a total disaster - or at least it was on the only evening we opted for it. The breakfast buffet is excellent though. Rest of the meals for us were all a la carte.

A special call out to Firdaus at Cloves who took care of us during most of our meals both a la carte and buffet. And to Rahul who served us at Chaikash.

But even perfect isn't ever perfectly perfect. Here are somethings that I thought could be better.

- A travel desk even if it were outsourced to help with the rides, sightseeing etc. They do actually have a bevy of cab drivers, atv and horseride hire folks almost always present within the premises. A chat with the security person gets you what you need. But it's puzzling why it isn't better organized with a desk
- Chaikash shuts by 6.30-7 PM. It's by far the best located with views of the peaks as well as beautifully set with lounge seats. While their sheesha lounge at the other end of the lobby opens when Chaikash shuts. It seems like converting Chaikash to accommodate the same services may have been a superior experience. I'm sure they have good reasons to do what they do. But it's not apparent.
- Room cleaning is the only service that was surprisingly shoddy. Under the toilet and on tables were a hurried job with stains and streaks still visible post cleaning.

reviews.author: PKS
reviews.title: Appreciation
reviews.text:
I address this communication with a feeling called happiness . The main reason for this feeling called happiness is this beautiful staycation experience, which me and my family had at this beautiful place called The Khyber Himalayan resort and spa. 

It is often believed that bricks and walls make a house, but it is the feelings which make a house a home. The feeling of ‘being Home’ is the feeling of being taken well care of. I can make a confident statement that I felt home at this beautiful aforementioned property because my family and myself were taken care of beautifully. 

The following categories of services are a special highlight of this beautiful property which make this property the best one : 
1) hospitality and service 
2) food and in-room dining 
3) heating and ventilation 
4) amenities and activities 
5) rooms and planning 
6) ambience and quality 

I take this opportunity to make a special mention for the people that made an impression with their outstanding skills and overwhelming personality (in order of interaction at the property) : 
1) Mr Mohammed Rafi (Duty Manager) 
2) Mr Imran Hussain (team leader) 
3) Mr Gautam Chauhan (Sous Chef) 
4) Mr Satyaprakash Mishra (executive Chef) 
5) Mr Mukammil (team leader F&B services) 
6) Mr Arif Hussain (Breakfast team) 
7) Mr Firdos parry (Breakfast team) 

I must appreciate the way, all of the above mentioned gentleman have assisted me with all chivalry and grace. A special mention for mr Mohammed Rafi Who despite having a busy schedule was available whenever assistance was required. Mr Imran has been most helpful when it came to local and property  guidance. 

It is rather believed that an empty stomach can lead you no where. Mr Gautam Chauhan made sure that we have the tastiest meals. On special request from my family mr Chauhan and Mr Mishra made delicious deserts, which I must say have still left me finger licking. 

Mr Mukammil, mr Arif, and Mr Firdos are the quickest when it comes to getting the order on the Table. Despite a hall full of guest the trio made sure that orders reach on table in absolute punctuality and in top order of freshness. 

The property is very well planned and is a must visit. If you are in for a long and lovely staycation The Khyber Himalayan resort is the place to stay. The property makes sure that you are rejuvenated and fresh for years to come. The indoor swimming pool and gymnasium is a must visit if you’re staying here. I personally had an amazingly good workout and an energising swim. -paras sukhwani

reviews.author: Yaduvendra Mathur
reviews.title: A Dream come true !
reviews.text: Holidaying at Gulmarg and staying at Khyber was on our to-do list for years. It's a dream come true. The entire experience was top class - from making our reservations to our stay, checkout and even some refunds - Mansoor of Front Office was most helpful especially in also supporting a cancellation of my friend's booking....the staff was very very helpful for making our stay truly a dream holiday.The Khyber management gave us a room on the first floor that had an amazing view off the Apharwat snowclad range and top... We had dinner in our room as the balcony is wide and spacious - room' service is prompt... bed linen is world class 600 count linen even better than luxury seven star hotels......bath tub in room has a great view too ..well planned for a resort experience......the breakfast is international standards and well spread out though the dining room you'll find is always packed with guests as this property is mostly 100 percent booked.....the Khyber spa and pool are extremely beautiful and tops of the tops ...  a warm sanctuary. Suggest staying in a room on the first floor as it comes with balconies facing the snow side view.... they're a bit expensive but totally worth it. There's no lift to the first floor but it's not a problem as the stairs is easy to negotiate. All wooden alpine style construction smells and feels very nice.....The property is right in the centre of Gulmarg so it's easy to walk down to the gondola ski lifts and for taking a horse ride to the golf course and the temple in the meadows or take a stroll through the small town to the stream.....we wished we could've stayed another day for exploring the place. The GM is a cordial person and is managing the property well. Khyber without double is a dream place and with definitely the finest hotel view.
