reviews.title: Motilalji Group
reviews.text: We were at Khyber for lunch on 13th May 2022. We were a group of 75 pax and must say the arrangements were amazing. The group really had a great time. And special thanks to the fnb manager Vaibhav and Randhir. The location is beautiful and the lunch was scrumptious. Would definitely love to visit again sometime soon.

reviews.author: Dhumil j
reviews.title: Amazing stay at Khyber
reviews.text:
We had amazing stay at Khyber and entire staff did great hospitality during our entire stay.

Special thanks to Irfan Hussain and his team to take care of every small thing during our stay to make our stay memorable and pleasant.

I highly recommend Irfan Hussain and his team.

reviews.author: hitenge
reviews.title: Very disappointed with hygiene and arrogant staff attitude
reviews.text:
We stayed for 2 nights from 02/05/22 to 04/05/22. The most shocking thing was cockroach at the buffet table. I immediately reported this to the staff and restaurant manager.  Also spoke to GM Mr. Chabbra. They promised that they will look into this and get is pest controlled immediately. This I am sure must have been done by them but to find cockroaches in buffet table for such an expensive high class hotel is unbelievable.

The next day my wife stayed home as she was not feeling well. She even skipped her breakfast. She requested housekeeping to clean the room so that she could sleep. Inspite of 3 calls, noone attended the room. At the end at 3 pm she went to reception to complain and then the rooms were cleaned. 

What I realised was that there is lot of arrogance set in the staff. The Hotel is fully packed for next 6 months. They have increased the rates to crazy levels and still the demand is very high so they do not seem to be bothered about customers.

I made a written complaint to the owner from the Hotel but am yet to receive reply.

Mr. Gautam, restaurant manager and Mr. Mohammad Rafi Bhat Duty Manger did try their best to pacify us and correct the mistakes. Even GM called my wife but all this after two unpleasant experiences. It was more of a fire fighting after blunders. 

The best thing for them is to bring new people who are humble. Ideally, they should give the Hotel to someone like Taj to manage. I have been to several Taj luxury properties and nowhere arrogance is seen. If a mistake happens they go all the way to correct it and the system ensures that it is not repeated with other guests.

I found many small maintenance issues like balcony handles not fully functional and dustbin covers are not operational which all are due to lack of supervision and the attitude.

Well now the good thing. The Hotel is located at beautiful place with very good view. It has heated swimming pool and spa. The gym has lot of Equipments. It is just 5 minute walk from the Gondola. The rooms are spacious. The buffet spread is good (minus the cockroach). They need another restaurant as people have to wait to get place for dinner.

I hope my views are taken in right spirit. I usually never criticise publicly but a genuine feedback is a must so that other guests do not suffer.

reviews.author: maneesh
reviews.title: Expensive hotel - very average for the price
reviews.text:
Stayed at Khyber with family and friends. The hotel is rated 5 star and charges USD 600 plus plus..for a room..

Positives : location near the gondola/ cable ride and that’s it..

For the price, we got a room facing the grass fences to start with. The room sizes are quite average and are designed for couples and not families.. 

The food is super expensive and probably the worst I have had in years…on the last day, for example the chef made me a special Kashmiri dish ( I appreciated the gesture because they had already goofed up) and I vomited the entire night. My family are all down with gastro issues as well..

It’s such a large hotel but there is literally nothing for the kids..a heated but dirty swimming pool…

Loud local music and dance till 1030 pm in the lobby area..didn’t understand this at all.. 

The staff are polite and helpful so will commend them for that. For the gastro issues, the staff helped me with the medicine as well. 

Will never go back to Khyber for sure…

reviews.author: Hargun
reviews.title: Enjoyed
reviews.text: I personally really enjoyed the stay here. I would definitely recommend this place to stay in . The food was also good . The rooms were really comfortable to stay in. The view is the best thing about the resort . The staff was also really helpful and gave a lot of attention to our necessities. Mr Firdous Parray , the staff who would come for the room cleaning and all the others were really helpful. I came here about 6 to 7 years before and the resort has really improved from before.

reviews.author: Faiz R
reviews.title: Amazing hospitality
reviews.text: Great hospitality. Special mention for Irfan for making our stay extra special. The entire staff was very helpful. Loved the amazing view of the sunshine mountains from our room's balcony. Highly picturesque location. We loved the warm water pool too

reviews.author: RWADERA
reviews.title: Excellent family holiday
reviews.text: A beautiful resort close to Gondola with superb mountain views and a heated pool. One of its kind in India. Enjoyed with family and kids want to visit again. The Hukka lounge is lovely. Carry your own liquor. Carry a good camera to capture the nature

reviews.author: Anil S
reviews.title: Pinnacle of service and luxury
reviews.text: We were on our 25th anniversary holiday and spent 3 nights at Khyber as a part of the celebration. We couldn’t have chosen a better place for the occasion. A hotel service cannot get better than this. The staff is super helpful and attentive to guest’s needs all the time. The hotel oozes out luxury is all areas starting from the lobby itself. The staff matches the hotel’s opulence toe to toe.  The main restaurant Cloves serves a big variety of delicious food from all corners of India. I am a vegetarian and I must say that I was spoilt for choices. If I have to single out a person from the fabulous restaurant staff then Firdous Parray deserves this special mention. He is an amazing guy, always mindful of our need, we never had to a word. Well done!

reviews.author: Sahil
reviews.title: Best Honeymoon location
reviews.text: Best place to visit in Gulmarg in summers as well as winters. Stayed at the Himalayan view rooms, it was very spacious & the view too was very serene. The staff is very friendly & helpful. Special thanks to Upamanyu for the hospitality. We really had a great time at the resort.

reviews.author: Kartik
reviews.title: Reviews about staff & hotel
reviews.text:
Its our first trip to khyber we had a wonderful experience great staff especially UPAMANYU DHAR
he was really helpful and provided with a lot of local knowledge the place is beating and a must visit 🤩

reviews.author: KL A
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Khyber resort. It is the best resort at Gulmarg. The heated swimming pool , the great view from the room and specially the live music at the dinner time was so nice which made the dinner so enjoyable. The refreshing drinks and the fresh food was  so  yummy that I don't have words to describe.

reviews.author: Mek06
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text:
Had a great stay at Khyber! Brilliant hospitality great food ! great view from the room 
A special thanks to Mohammad Rafi the duty manager of Khyber to give us this beautiful room with this gorgeous view!! His efforts are highly appreciated since everything was booked! 
Thanks to the staff for the great service ♥️

reviews.author: Rahul C
reviews.title: A STAY IN JANNAT !!
reviews.text: We visited the KHYBER HOTEL in Gulmarg in the month of April , and had an absolute JANNAT EXPERIENCE…ofcourse due the hotel location, the snow mountains , the mesmerizing views and ofcourse the HEATED POOL staring at the snow mountains   . Similarly the team at the hotel provided great service and special VVIP services provided by WASIM from guest relations who made our trip extremely comfortable, shyam from F&B team who gave us impeccable service at all times and IMRAN from restaurant service team who looked after us very well !!

reviews.author: Shiksha
reviews.title: Disappointing Honeymoon Stay
reviews.text:
When you think of luxury stays in India, The Khyber Himalayan Resort tops the list. We went their on our honeymoon for 3 days and were heavily disappointed with the hospitality and food served there. We had all our meals at the hotel itself thanks to the lockdown, and to my surprise the staff behavior wasn’t warm at all. However, I would definitely like to give a special mention to the chef who after listening to our food reviews did curate a special dinner for us which wasn’t great either but we appreciate the effort.
When call yourself the only luxury five star in Gulmarg its not just the property and the view but what stands out for me is the hospitality, which was completely missing during our stay along with the food.

For my husband and I khyber really needs to up its game when they charge a bomb!!!

reviews.author: Sunny Chauhan
reviews.title: "THE BEST "
reviews.text: khyber is a pretty big brand in kashmir valley and from this comes the beautiful resort and spa The KHYBER ,the best of lots in gulmarg  correction in kashmir valley for that matter.The most gorgeous resorts you can visit great food hospitality location true five star.Highly recommended from my end

reviews.author: anjtolani
reviews.title: Hanging in the lap of nature
reviews.text: From the big sized balcony of our suite all we heard during our entire stay at this hotel was the sound of birds and silence of the mighty mountains. The Khyber in Gulmarg is not just the best hotel in that location but also one of the best hotels in all of Kashmir. It's location is breath taking, the staff are always eager to assist and the F&B at this hotel is superlative. They do some fabulous wazwan dishes which for first timers to Kashmir, like us awed us. Our first ever authentic kahwa was served to us at check-in at the hotel and we have become die hard kahwa fans ever since. The Chef was also planning to get an authentic Kashmiri winter breakfast spread organised by us but this being summer wasn't the right time for it we were told. But we still managed to have the nun chai one of the mornings over breakfast. This hotel is situated close to the market and the gondola point, yet isolated enough to allow its guests to destress after a day spent outside. When we stayed at the hotel in May, they had snow in their premises and that was a cause of huge excitement for us. Their temperature control pool with a break taking view of the pine trees and snow capped mountains is an absolute highlight and on our trip we carried a swimsuit just for that one dip in the pool even at those low temperatures that Gulmarg experiences even in May. I can't even imagine how much prettier this hotel would be in winter

reviews.author: utkarsh k
reviews.title: PARADISE
reviews.text:
Extremely Good Hospitality Each and Every Thing is Taken Care of Very Professionally , Lovely Architecture Of This Beautiful Hotel I have Worked There As a Team Member All The Staff and Management Extremely Helpful...
One Should Visit this Hotel Once And Then You'll Go Again and Again...

reviews.author: Ruchika B
reviews.title: Excellent Property!
reviews.text:
We went to The Khyber Resort in May 2019 with kids and another family. We had heard a lot about the hotel and its service and went with certain expectations. Needless to say, the place surpassed all expectations. We cannot rave enough about the place, property, SERVICE, pool, spa and everything. Have not seen a pool with a better view. Spa is not to be missed.
Kashmir in itself is a stunning place. The place and safe for tourists and locals are ever helping and super sweet.

reviews.author: Mayurb0123
reviews.title: This is the hotel You should once visit in your lifetime.
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber to celebrate our anniversary & stayed there for 3 nights from 30 April to 3 May 2019. Many people had recommended me this hotel & I had very high expectation from the time i booked my trip but it was even above my expectations. The Location of the hotel itself wins your heart. 

The weather in Gulmarg changes within Half Hours & this makes trips more enjoyable. The Buffet is expensive as it cost around 2500/meal per person so we opted for A-la Carte & it saved us as the buffet dinner is not every day setup but depends on Occupancy which was low on 2 days & hence every one had A-la Carte.

Food taste is awesome & they also have dedicated Sheesha/Hookah lounge in evening. The Gondola Ride is just Walking distance from here.The best thing about hotel is Warm Heated Swimming Pool overlooking mountains which is just pleasure to eyes.

Overall it was perfect stay & we would definitely visit again but this time during Snow from Dec to Feb

Thanks,

reviews.author: Bob A
reviews.title: Not 5 Star
reviews.text:
The vista from this hotel is exceptional with snow covered peaks from our balcony. And the food at the hotel restaurant during dinner (night) is very good.
But the place is quite dark and dingy and the hot water in the shower in the room wasn’t hot enough. The insulation between rooms is poor as we were annoyed by the constant screaming of a young child next door. The bainne maree food at breakfast times is like many other hotels in India in that it is not served hot and the choices are poor unless you like Indian breads - to make matters worse breakfast is not served until 8.00 am in the morning which is too late for those travelling to new destinations. All in all disappointing for such a lovely and pristine area

reviews.author: PrashantSanghvi
reviews.title: 25000 per night is it WORTH ?
reviews.text:
The moment we say Gulmarg two things come to our mind GANDOLA which is World's highest and longest cable car  and the most sought after resort Khyber!!! Gandola I will definitely recommend but Khyber I would say is a waste of money as they don't have proper view for base category of rooms as evident from the pictures our room was too close to parking lot even after a complaint to the duty manager they were not able to give us a better room as for this amount of money you can stay at Taj Srinagar which has definitely a better view further they just provide 4 bottles of water in a day any additional is chargeable also as informed to us even the tea coffee will be replenished only to the extent of 20% of the stock They provide just two Twinings tea  and some open Tetley bags which is evidenced from the pic uploaded we are not theives or beggars which management should understand even no complimentary fruit basket and they don't even consider your anniversary or birthdays which other hotels do consider and makes some arrangements to make the guest feel special,  staff needs to be trained on customer relationship inspite of rooms going empty they have a policy to keep it vacant. 
Over all it was a disappointment to end our holidays at Khyber

reviews.author: Nikhilbal
reviews.title: Truely a five star👍
reviews.text: Kyber resort..Only five star hotel in gulmarg..right next to gondola station..it was a truely a five star experience..strongly recommended if you are going to gulmarg.staffs are friendly..good entertainment

reviews.author: Trip400959
reviews.title: Hyped up property
reviews.text:
Always had a different vision of Kashmir and it just puts me off how the tourism is here with the safety and many many things. It's a dirty place though it looks good in pictures one has to really think twice to spend a holiday here. We paid 4000 for each ATV to go to phase 2 gondola as phase 1 was closed  but actualy it was working and they shut it off for the pony rides and atv's as its an additional income. The people here try to rip you off further if you stay in Khyber.

Now the good things about Khyber so far.. they have an amazing view for the rooms with balcony. The food is amazing and yes it is very expensive each dish starts wth 800rs and goes upto 1800 plus. They have a nice indoor heated pool and jaccuzi and a gym. 

Except the view of the room there is nothn much to this property and its fairly small and old decor. Showers have no adjustment to the force of water and its very very hard to take a shower with either too hot or too cold water gushing. We are a group of 10people staying here and we all feel it's just a hyped up property !!!

At the end I feel 5days at Khyber all the excitement i had just fell flat and I shudve taken a holiday elsewhere out of the country.

reviews.author: Sreyans J
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text: This is a must stay hotel in gulmarg. Amazing hotel amazing view amazing spa amazing food amazing swimming. Amazing staff . Words are not enough. Higly recommended. Sheesha too also good. Drinks not available. Happy stayed thr. Though didn't get upgraded to higher category room but still . Lil expensive.

reviews.author: Hari G
reviews.title: Excellent property, but definitely overpriced
reviews.text:
We were welcomed with traditional Kashmiri tea in the tea lounge. The views from the lounge were beautiful. The hotel had a very cozy yet luxurious feel to it. 

Was particularly impressed by the indoor pool and facilities. The food and restaurant should have been better given the price-point of the hotel. Rooms were spacious and well furnished. The property overall was very well maintained. 

In summary, anyone on a luxury trip should stay here, but be prepared to shell out 20k+ for the hotel's deluxe room.

reviews.author: sanjaychawla740
reviews.title: Location is not that Pictureisque what as shown on the website
reviews.text: Average Hotel especially comppared to the price they charge,high minded staff and ordinary food,had asked for a copy of bill thrice to be sent through the mail but nobody has bothered so far,looks very different from what its shown on the website

reviews.author: naushad97
reviews.title: best hotel in gulmarg
reviews.text: Khyber is the best place to stay in gulmurg ,very good service and nice food ,very nice and clean room,have a temperature pool ,must stay in this resort when visiting gulmarg we have a very good time there

reviews.author: nilshah07
reviews.title: Nilesh shah
reviews.text: Best hotel of gulmarg with Himalayan view room. Very good indoor swimming pool with temperature control. Nice staff lead by ms khalida are very supportive and hospitality is at is best. A must stay property.

reviews.author: Soumendra B
reviews.title: Best place of stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Khyber hotel is the best place to spend your holidays in leisure. Just at he foothill of Gulmargh it commands a magnificent look of the snow clad Himalayas. The resturant of hotel has the most authentic Kashmiri food and the trout fish is out of this world. The cherry on the top is the heated swimming pool.

reviews.author: Tejas J
reviews.title: The best in Gulmarg !!
reviews.text:
I had visited this property in first week of march for 3 nights. Let me be clear this is a no where close to 5 star property,unlike other grand 5 stars I have stayed at, they only have one restaurant and neither they have any activities for their guests, however this is the best luxury property Gulmarg has currently.(and only one with heated pool ) 

We had booked  Luxury room Gulmarg View but upgraded it to Himalayan view and the view was worth the extra bucks. Our check in was seamless , being offered to sit in lobby area while our formalities were being taken care of .At check in Mr Sakib from front desk was assisting us, and we requested him if there were any room with Himalayan view were available to which he promptly replied "yes there are and that will be additional".We requested him that we need to see his senior(to discuss the upgrade thing), he went inside was back in 30 seconds saying that his senior is busy in a meeting,to which we asked him to see us whenever he is available, and without any fuss we checked in our room.I was expecting his senior to call me or meet me during my 3 nights stay but not once did Sakib or his senior bothered to call or ask. Pretty arrogant  and very unprofessional attitude for front desk staff and not expected especially when you are being charged a bomb.
My room's remote wasn't working and neither was the telephone handset, even the indirect lighting weren't working,this didn't bothered me but this small things which always matters.

the positives
1) Majority of staff will sport sweet Kashmiri smile on their face.
   Special mention for Restaurant staff Aijaz, Iqbal, Irfan for their superb hospitality and       their senior Mr Mukesh, (F and B manager) .Trust me this team is only reason we had all meals in restaurant inspite of not booking all meals package.Front desk Ms Pakeeza is also very helpful and always available at your disposal, sadly our interaction happened only during check out.
2) we did not book for all meals package and I suggest don't, as their al Carta menu is extensive and the food is yummy.we had all 6 meals there, it costs us much lesser than  all meals package
3) Spa by locctaine is good and the rates are on par with other star hotels
4) heated pool 
Gulmarg itself is beautiful and you will be wowed by Gulmarg's beauty.
A must visit place to people to who want to have luxury at their disposal at remotest location and don't shelling out extra.

reviews.author: Vianny D
reviews.title: Paradise feel on Earth
reviews.text: We a family of three, had a one and a half day experience in the first week on April 2018.This property is fantastically maintained. We were stupefied by the breathtaking view this hotel offered us. Our entire stay was well taken care of by Mr. Basharat who left no stone unturned in ensuring we enjoyed the best & warm hospitilality. We are grateful for the upgrade and the complimentary .as well. Couldn't ask for more. It is approximately a 5mins downhill walk from the hotel to the gate of the Gondola Ticket Counter. I do agree with some of the reviwers who visited this hotel about the service staff in the restuarant. It does happen when there an outpour of tourists, it gets a bit uneasy handling the pressure of good service. Neverthless, I still would recommend this hotel. Go and grab this life time experience and be mesmerized by God's creation here.I would definitely come again next time here, given an opportunity! All the best to the management :)

reviews.author: Minakkshi19
reviews.title: Ultimate experience
reviews.text:
Nestled in Gulmarg , Himalayan mountains is the beautiful Khyber resort.

Ticked box one of the items in my bucket list!
Warm beautiful scenic and ultimate experience . Some of the rooms do not have a good view. So check the same , staff is warm and proactive. 
Children friendly.

reviews.author: Vivek S
reviews.title: Winter paradise!
reviews.text: The Khyber Himalayan resort & Spa is undoubtedly one of the most luxurious resorts in India. Absolutely stunning property with the views of snow capped mountains all around. The best part of the hotel is the heated swimming pool which is a real delight after a long day. The food is very good however we did not find any Kashmiri Speciality dishes in the buffet hence we ordered the wazwan which was fantastic. The staff are very warm and friendly, they served us a lovely mug of hot chocolate on the upper deck in the evening. Overall a truly memorable stay. We got a lovely room with a large balcony.

reviews.author: nirajsomaiya
reviews.title: taj mahal of india
reviews.text: the hotel is outstanding and one of the best hotels i have stayed in india. you have to take rooms facing the himalayan side. they are odd numbers in 2000 series and even number in 4000 series. hotel has over 80 rooms. the food is out the world. service is outstanding. the pool is indoor heated one and spa is really good. the hotel is just a 2 minute drive from the gondola.

reviews.author: Abhishekduta
reviews.title: Service is appaling
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber for 2 nights. The property is beautiful especially the heated pool. Its get crowded at time but you can still enjoy. the location of the hotel is also good, only 5 minutes walk from the hotel is the Gandola. However everything is a let down due to the poor service offered by the staff (only at restaurant). They are extremely rude. 
The food is also average and overly priced.

reviews.author: Carlos E
reviews.title: Perfect Winter Escape
reviews.text:
First thing I want to apologize to the hotel team for posting this review so late! We actually stayed in Feb 2017. 

The hotel was fantastic! If you want a winter land escape look no further.  The team was attentive and extremely friendly.  Our driver Shabir had a fantastic personality and was very pleasant/safe drive. 

Being in such a remote location, food was very important. To be honest we only ate a la cart and Kashmiri staples. They where all great and we really enjoyed the food.

In general I hope the geopolitical situation gets better. The hotel and the team deserve to host many more people in this wonderful hotel.  

We where my wife, baby infant and my self on this trip. It was great to relax and to bond together in the long winter days.

reviews.author: Moin A
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with excellent Management
reviews.text:
I visited this beautiful property with a group of 40 people and was one of the best hotel accommodation's I have ever had, the rooms are very elegant,the buffet is beyond expectations and best is the management of the property,the staff is very cooperative and is attentive and quick to respond for any need.
Special thanks to Manzoor bhai,Rauf and their team for making our trip very memorable.
Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: Dipali G
reviews.title: An amazing place
reviews.text: The resort enjoys a great location and is beautifully designed. Wood and use of local design make it a visual delight. We had booked a premier room but we got upgraded to a luxury room with a balcony overlooking the valley. The room was well planned and spacious. We enjoyed the local food at the restaurant. The spa was also good. Did not use the heated pool. The resort is closeby to the gondola ride. The service was good and we would definitely want to visit it again

reviews.author: hemantmehta79
reviews.title: Majestic resort with top of line services
reviews.text:
We stayed at Khyber in the first week of April for 3 days. One word that describes this place " Magnificient". I am sure one would think, how did they build a resort with this level of grandeur at 10000 feet above the ground ! We stayed at a time when there was unexpected snowfall in Srinagar and there was a complete cutoff of internet, TV and road networks for a brief period. The hotel staff was amazingly courteous in catering to various guest requests at this time. The rooms were spic an span and property top class. There would be only a few suggestions that could further enhance the experience of people traveling from o/s India:

1) Foreign Exchange-Hotel only changes US dollar. For other currencies, one needs to go down in the market to get money changed in the bank. Unfortunately, for us when it was snowing all the banks were completely closed and we had tough time to get currency changed.However, the staff was very helpful and provided us with a cash advance to meet local expense. ideally, we should have carried more INR but did not anticipate Hotel may not be able to change other major currencies. A new learning as Taj at Sri Nagar and Pine N Peak at Pahalgam were easily able to change other currencies ( We were carrying Singapore Dollar) . 

2) Alacarte menu was excellent. However, the buffet tends to be slightly repetitive if one is staying for a period of 2 or 3 days. food quality again was excellent in the buffet. My son still tells me to go back to Kashmir to eat dosa at Khyber :)

3) Bar facilities- Guess, this may have to do with Government permissions, but was surprised that the property does not serve alcohol.

All in all, this resort is in the ranks of Ritz, Four Seasons, Taj, Oberoi and other high end Hotels.I would definitely comeback to Gulmarg and stay again at Khyber. The staff is great and really takes good care of you. Take the Himalayan view room, if you can as it has direct view of the valley.Serene and beautiful.

reviews.author: INDIA_DEEPAK
reviews.title: Beautiful property but bad hospitality towards the guest
reviews.text:
After our 2 days stay @ Hotel Vintage we had booked other 2 days @ Hotel Khyber which is 1.5 Kms away from it.

Due to heavy snowfall we called Khyber to get us transfered from Vintage but the duty manager Mr. Sakibh refused saying that the cars had stucked up.  We managed to hire a cab with the help of Vintage staff. The cab driver refused to drive till reception of Khyber  due to steep slope.

We again called up at Khyber to help us but Mr. Sakibh again refused using harsh words, saying that the ATV was not working. We saw the ATV  making rounds to and fro from the hotel till the Gandola side which was just  150m away.

 After watching all this we had to use hard words.We had booking in their hotel and if some problem was arising to get upto there they should have helped  in that scenario.

Latter ATV person showing courtesy carried us alongwith the luggage. In all this more than half of our day was spoiled.

All that was not  expected from such a big resort.

All that behaviour of the duty Manager Mr. Sakibh on that day spoiled our holiday mood.

Overall the property is awesome and really beautiful. The other staff members  at dining, reception or housekeeping  were really nice and polite. Mr.  Manzoor   & Mr. Pervez at front desk were really very nice and helpful for rest of our stay. Tahir and  Mudasir @ Swimming pool were too nice & helpful.

The property is undoubtedly very beautiful,comfortable and awesome. The food is also fine.

reviews.author: 250manojk
reviews.title: One night is enough
reviews.text: Stayed over here for one night,well its the most expensive hotel in gulmarg,approx 16-18k per night,huge property lots of things to do in hotel,best part temperature control swimming pool followed by jacuzzi steam sauna,games room for kids including table tennis n carrom,lots of seating area in hotel,they have billiards room too,once u r in this hotel just njoyy the property dont think of goin out on tat day,fud is expensive in this hotel check b4 ur booking abt fud,fud is gud,rooms i stayed in had bathtub,heater facility plus a balcony,rooms r gud,njoyyed our stay over here.

reviews.author: RAKESH MEHTA
reviews.title: One of the best resort i have ever stayed
reviews.text:
Kashmir India's answer to world for Swiss. Awesome beauty just cant explain in words you need to be there to experience it. Everything is calm in Srinagar, Gulmarg & Phalgam it's the media being spoiled sport and spreading rumors issues are there but in rural areas of Srinagar where we never need to go. Local's are very nice sweet, helpful, genuine & Honest.

The Khyber is simply super take a Himalayan view room you get mesmerizing view of snow claded Himalayan mountains. 

Heated swimming pool, sauna, Jacuzzi & gym truly wonderful. Spa is expensive didn't try it but would be surely nice.

Food is simply superb taste is really great. Buffet is expensive but go for A La Carte that's better and economical. Chef Veer was really co-operative and help full gave us good Jain food. 

Duty manager was really co-operative she ensured best service for us.

Overall The Khyber i rate 10/10.

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: Out of the world! A Must-Visit Resort
reviews.text:
What can I write to describe such a beautiful resort when we found it as tucked  in the midst of a thick conifer forest, covered in snow blanket on a sunny afternoon of March. If I were to judge the best hotel in India, I would rate this hotel resort as the best. I even dare to say that in winter, this would compete even with the luxury resorts at Gstad/St Moritz of Europe.

The architecture is stunning and augmented by high-end finishes to provide a unique luxury experience for the guests. We enjoyed the warmth of the room while braving the continuous snow fall and a -10C temperature outside. Kahwa provided at the lobby was the right potion we required after a long day in the snow. 

I found the quality of the food to be little off the mark. The dinner buffet was elaborate but some of the dishes were very average - lack of Kashmiri flavours and touch. However, the ala carte dishes were better in comparison. I must say this can be easily overlooked considering the location, weather conditions and continuous efforts by the staff to take care of the guests.

Recommend this strongly to include in one's bucket list and one has to come in winters to enjoy the unique weather conditions and a white landscape to take up skiing

reviews.author: Megha S
reviews.title: birthday celebration
reviews.text:
The drive to gulmarg was itself a very very inspiring one. as soon as you stepin the property you are mesmerized by the scale and detailing of the property. was extremely impressed with the hotel staff and their concern as we were protected by a con driver by mr puneet kumar Singh  the front office manager at khyber. highly recommed !
seriously hats off to the hositality.
look forward to more visits.

reviews.author: Pranjaljandial
reviews.title: The greatest!
reviews.text: One of the best resorts i have come across while travelling across the world. For 17 years i have been travelling with friends and family and this is one must stay resort. Ultra relaxing and luxurious, the hest food and views. And the perfect swimming pool . The jacuzzi is a must gogo !

reviews.author: Pradeep S
reviews.title: Getaway Destination
reviews.text: Our stay at the Khyber Resorts , Gulmarg was one of the best Holiday destinations we had .. there was everything you can imagine to be there at the Resort. Nestled amongst the Pine trees on the Himalayas .. we had a perfect Dream Holiday .. Rooms with scenic views.. Heated Indoor Pool .. La'Occitane Spa... the Gondola station a stone's throw away.. above all the ever courteous and smiling staff ready to lend ear to you. The Breakfast and Dinner spread was also sumptuous and full of variety off food for different palates. On the whole it was much more than we could think of .. we had a great Holiday .. would strongly recommend for any couple/family looking for a 2-3 day Holiday in Kashmir. Keep it up.

reviews.author: Himesh Shah
reviews.title: Khyber Review
reviews.text:
Unbelievable location, Amazing Property but a very below average hospitality! Very disappointing experience! Unfriendly staff, they seem to be least bothered about the comfort and requirements of hotel guests.
The location is very close to Gondola but do not expect any kind of service or assistance from the hotel for the Gondola ride. Food is very average! Special Jain request was intimated to the hotel well in advance but no arrangements were made for the same on both the days of my stay. Very limited options were offered to me upon request and that too as if they were doing a favor to me! It is time these hotels start realising the fact that we pay the same tariff what others are paying and still they do not take any care of us. In fact one of the waiters had the audacity to back answer that we are giving you some Jain food on request! Overhyped Hotel, Jain community pls avoid this Hotel!

reviews.author: Panks_29
reviews.title: Quality deteriorated from what heard and expected
reviews.text:
I was with my family and friends with small kids when i visited Khyber in April 2017. At the very outset, they gave us rooms which were far off the reception and dining area. We had to use elevators twice and we (especially our kids) had a hard time to go to room and come to dining area at regular frequency. Swimming pool was even far and it took ages to reach there. When requested, they informed us that all the rooms are booked which was not the case.

On the next day, room was not cleaned properly at all. 
(1) Towels were lying on the chair.
(2) Dust bin was not emptied.
(3) Drinking water was not kept.
(4) Glasses and spoons were not washed.
(5) Soap, shampoo conditioner were not replaced.

On issuing a feedback form, they informed us that it will not happen the next time when we come. As if, we will travel again, the next time.

reviews.author: Hetal S
reviews.title: Mesmerizing Heaven
reviews.text:
Khyber is on a lap of heaven ... words not enough to describe ma heavenly stay at this hotel ...  whichever corner u go u will see pure and just beautiful nature 

Great grand hotel with great grand hospitality ...

M coming back here sooooooon

reviews.author: shrimalihospital
reviews.title: PICTURE PERFECT
reviews.text: Visited Khyber along with my husband, kids and grand children, hotel's location offers some of the best views of Gulmarg. The ambience of the hotel transports you to an era bygone. On arriving to the hotel front desk staff (Asrar) smoothed our check in process, on his advice we up graded the rooms which offered us excellent view from balcony. .....Over all it was a memorable experience.

reviews.author: Darshan S
reviews.title: Heavenly Location & Amazing Staff
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber from 26 April to 29 April 2017 and had an absolutely amazing time. We booked our pick up from Srinagar through the hotel itself and it was a nice clean Innova. Our drivers name was Sajjad and he was quite well spoke. We stopped on our way to have lunch at Raja Dhaba which serves fantastic food. 

On reaching the hotel we checked into our room with the Himalayan view. I can tell you that photos do not do justice to the place. From leaving Bombay which is at 38 degrees C to be in Gulmarg at 5 degrees in less than 5 hours is something else. 

A piece of advice - please book room with Himalayan view (it is available with and without balcony) but is much better than the Gulmarg view. It could also be because of the season, I think the difference would be less if you went in Winter. 

A special mention to the staff - Enthusiastic and considerate about every request. Iqbal and Ashfaq at the reception were of great help. At the tea room and restaurant Junaid whipped up amazing Kahwa for us. Finally at the restaurant Sameer and Qadir were amazing and ever present. Ruhi was very helpful about answering any queries as well. 

The Spa was expensive but good. The pool is totally stunning and scenic. 

Book your Gondola tickets in advance and get a guide or someone or the other will keep pestering you. 

Go to this beautiful part of our country! I can't wait to go back. 

P.S: One small note - there were Monkeys in the balcony the day we checked out. It's a rare occurrence but don't leave stuff outside.

reviews.author: priya a
reviews.title: Picture Perfect View
reviews.text: We loved this place for its view, location and food. But above all, the friendly staff. If you are visiting Gulmarg, don't even think of exploring any other property. Khyber is the best option available!!

reviews.author: Sunehra K
reviews.title: Stunning Views and Lovely Staff!
reviews.text:
We arrived at Khyber late in the evening dog tired after a long day of traveling from Bangalore. Check in was very quick and in no time I was asleep in my super soft and comfortable bed. The next morning I woke up early and opened the curtains.... my jaw just DROPPED! What a view!!! The Himalayas!!! The Himalayaaaaahhhs!!! Never have I been so mesmerised by such a view. 
Apart from that, what a wonderful stay!! Kind and friendly staff members always giving us a happy greeting and helping with whatever we needed. Fabulous food!! Oh my god that Khyber Tarami, I'm still dreaming about it! And that pool... so warm and welcoming after such a cold day outside!!! It was just SUPERB!
Love the little things they did to go the extra mile. The Buffet Breakfast starts at 8, we were leaving at 7:30am so they quickly rustled something up for us. Ready advice on the activities in Gulmarg which by the way are just amazing!! Phase 1 was just AWESOME!!! 
And the driver (Arshad) who took us to the airport - what a ROCKSTAR! We are Indians and we know the Indian style of driving but Arshad's moves were pure innovation!!! Asif at the airport was also so helpful and took care of us till we went through security. No words!
Thank you to all the Khyber staff for looking after us so well.. I will be back, hopefully in February 2018 and will only be staying at The Khyber!

reviews.author: Jayashri K
reviews.title: Great location and service
reviews.text:
We stayed at this wonderful place for 3 nights last week and had a memorable break. 
Reservations - process was relatively smooth and special thanks to Irshad for providing us with a good package
Airport transportation - convenient, and efficient given the additional security at Srinagar airport. Allows for quick halts on the way to enjoy the vast coniferous forest, and pretty flower decked forest floor!! Thanks to Shahnawaz for making the trip to and from airport amazing!!
Rooms - Balcony rooms with Himalayan view are a great choice if you wish to enjoy a cuppa in company of snow clad mountains and coniferous vegetation, a sight not worth missing. Rooms are spacious, with enough room for an extra bed if required. Although constant reminder to housekeeping on the replenishment of utilities such as water and tea/coffee/creamer was a bit of a nuisance 
Food - good choice in the buffet especially if you are ok with select dishes and prefer Indian cuisine, the team takes care to call out on special requests is any. Kids especially loved pasta and lasagna made to order for them. Special thanks to Aijaz who took good care of us !!

reviews.author: sameer
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text:
I was there with my wife and son.  My kid is 19 months now. So I plan properties based on 5 star luxury cause my son needs it :) .
This resort is truly a five star 

Service =  This is very remote location about 90 mins from airport.  Sabzar picked us precisely at the time.  The surprising part is everyone is allowed at the baggage counter hence I found every all taxi driver looking for bags..  Reminded me of the Railway Station.  

The welcome was very good I did t bother doing anything..  Just gave I'd s and went to sleep (was exhausted after long flight)

Love the people at front desk and staff always having a smile. 

food is good.  But the spread matches of a two star.  
It was big turn off considering we a purely non veg.  They just have 3 non veg dished prepared every night and the fish was a repetitive in my last night.  
Only one kind of rice...  No Briyani no kebabs nothing.  
But  hats of to the Restuarant manager Abid he made sure at least my son got vvip treatment. Abid is best hospitality person I've met . He made sure we were very comfortable in terms of food.  
But again the spread was pathetic. 

location : they charge about 30k for a night in the room we stayed because the Himalayas is what u Pay for In a remote location. 
The property is truly 5 star. 

There is nothing to do here except going to the top of mountain and doing the activities like ski and atv.(Gondola)

That's just a day activity 

Considering the cost  I think two nights stay is perfect. 

Rooms are the best cause your likely to spend more time here staring at the snow capped mountains. 
We chose this may because it's not extremely cold cause we are travelling with toddler. But it's around 3 degree  that's very cold considering summer in India. during the day it warms up and feels good. 

But I dare young couples to go here during winter :) 
True honeymoon  destination. 

Spa was really world class and out of the world 

The swimming pool is temperature controlled  and excellent maintained.
Any thing warm is good thing . Additionally they have Jacuzzi,  steam and sauna felt really good 

They offer breakfast and dinner in package 
But for lunch and evening snacks this place is very expensive considering  tea 250 rupees and Briyani 1000 rupees which serves one person.  But the taste is good. 

People who drink prepare to get alcohol from outside when u land itself :)

Overall. 

Very good experience 
Will remember this for  years to come. 
Will want to come back if they give a good offer on rooms :) 

Thanks to Abid and support staff Iqbal

(who has best smile in the world and enjoy his work) 

And Wahid for arranging my Transport 

 Finally thanks to all the wonderful staff to make this happen. 

Hope to be back soon!

Thanks 
 Shahbaz

reviews.author: Unmisha
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with snow peaked himalayan view
reviews.text: The hotel is the most luxurious hotel in Gulmarg and has a perfect location . Facing the snow peaked mountains , it makes a perfect backdrop for the hotel. They have a temperature controlled pool which was heated and great steam, sauna and jacuzzi facilities . The multi cuisine restaurant had the best dinner buffet spread . Loved the starters spread! The hospitality was awesome too and the front office upgraded us since the occupancy was low . Small initiatives like these make a great difference to guest satisfaction and make us feel special. Thankful to the staff for the kind hospitality extended to us during our stay . Loved the hotel however prices were extremely high for a 5 star !

reviews.author: praveents
reviews.title: Luxury Resort with Stunning View
reviews.text: Our Stay at Khyber was perfect with unforgettable memories. The room is spacious with stunning view of snow clad mountains. Checkin was smooth thanks to Mr. Parvez who warmly welcomed us and offered hot kahwa.  The resort has heated indoor pool with nice view of the valley. The food was good but tad expensive, overall our stay was nice.

reviews.author: Parimal
reviews.title: It was an experience beyond words !! Superb location , kind hospitality and the ever smiling kashmiri people.
reviews.text: The hotel is just amazing with its views and hospitality. Great food and its proximity to the gondola rides made our trip a truly memorable one! The staff is very polite and always ready to help which is a true reflection of the kashmiri people. Would like to visit again and again 😊

reviews.author: 694devikas
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: My husband and I went to The Khyber to celebrate our first wedding anniversary. We had the Himalayan view room. It was nothing short of perfection. The room was amazing with a spectacular view of the mountains. The staff was extraordinary!! There was nothing that they couldn't cater to! Your every need or desire was taken care of. The staff is ever smiling, friendly and helpful. The food was fit for a king. Delicious food and well presented. The spa experience was extremely rejuvenating. The therapists were well trained. The pool overlooking the Himalayas was breathtaking. It was luxury unlimited. Overall it was a wonderful experience and I would most certainly recommend anyone going to Gulmarg to stay at The Khyber.

reviews.author: PGHG
reviews.title: Over-hyped!! Overall not bad, but left wondering why did we pay so much for this experience
reviews.text:
It is a nice place, but for a luxury hotel, we were truly left wanting more. 

We had gone there for a short break in search of peace and quiet. So we took a Mountain view room with a balcony, the best room possible. The room had broadly the things one would expect in a good hotel, but then the bed was two small for two of us, mattress too soft and the duvet just about adequate. We stayed there for 3 nights of bad sleep. Seating inside the room was not quite comfortable.

Rooms are on two sides of a long corridor, and the corridor appeared a bit dark. Rooms are not sound proof and one could hear loud voices all through the day, and that disturbed the afternoon siesta. Very little open spaces to roam around inside the hotel, especially given that there is nothing outside of the hotel in Gulmarg. The limited seating area was just too noisy with two large groups with children talking very loudly, littering here and there, and making too much of ruckus. Unfortunately none from the hotel requested them to conduct themselves otherwise.

Hotel allows two devices per room for free connectivity. That in itself is too little in today's connected world. But even allowing for that, you can't even disconnect a device and connect another. So it's not 'two devices at a time'. It's only 'the first two devices that you connect after checking in'. To be fair, they did allow me to connect another device free of charge, but that needed me to speak to the manager in charge.

Food is very good though and the service very courteous. Spa was another highlight. Really liked the message there.

On the whole, while we truly enjoyed the view, the food, and the spa, were left wondering did we make go for the best option for our 3 days short break, especially for the very high price we paid.

reviews.author: Emma and JC L
reviews.title: Wonderful location for a relaxed and tasteful holiday!
reviews.text:
The Khyber is wonderfully located at the foot of the mountains, with lovely views and a tasteful mountain lodge design. The gondola is 200 m away and can take you up to 4000m above the clouds for an amazing view of the Affarwat peaks. 
The Restaurant offers a lot of options, veg and non veg, Both Indian and Western and the food is really good.
The rooms are large yet cosy, wonderful indoor swimming pool with a lovely view of the forest and the mountains. Amazing treatments available at the L'Occitane spa.
But above all, what makes the Khyber a place you'll want to visit again is the staff. All of them are really polite, helpful, smiling and make you feel like a VIP. Big big applause to all of them, they really are outstanding and the service is up to level with the likes of the Oberoi and Taj hotels.

reviews.author: Rathi N
reviews.title: Superb place
reviews.text: Stayed here last month and it was one of the best hotels that I have stayed in.totally made of Khasmiri wood,surrounded by snow and a view to kill for!it was simply magical.the rooms were well appointed and with comfortable beds.the indoor pool was so inviting.The spa by Loccitance was world class.The food was good too.

reviews.author: Vivekanand G
reviews.title: Luxury at its best
reviews.text:
I had stayed in Khyber for one night during my visit to Kashmir in March and this is without doubt the best stay of the trip. 

The interiors are nice. Rooms and linen are top notch.The best thing about the resort is the temperature controlled pool and the jacuzzi. 

The staff were nice and cordial. Restaurant was alright.

I couldn't visit the spa because of the lack of time. I wish I had stayed here longer.

reviews.author: Vinod D
reviews.title: Luxurious!!!
reviews.text: Stayed here in may2016 for 3days.....very beautiful place to enjoy the scenic gulmarg....comfortable rooms...great food....a bit expensive though....very close to all the tourist spots in gulmarg....overall a premium place to stay.

reviews.author: Tejalk139
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: Khyber resort was a wonderful experience . The service n hospitality was excellent . The food n beverage team was excellent n manager Mr Bashart personally took care of our food needs.The 3 Bilal's took extra efforts to look after us. It's a great place to stay n enjoy the resort with beautiful n picturesque surrounding!!!

reviews.author: RamNit1996
reviews.title: Great location but not so great restaurant service
reviews.text: The biggest plus is the location and views. It is walking distance from the Gandola and hence you are very close to the biggest attraction of Gulmarg. Most locations of the hotel have a great view and many picture spots for families. The restaurant is really overpriced compared to the presentation and taste. Since there are not many restaurant options in Gulmarg you have to put up. Good place for one night stay but not more.

reviews.author: MD-qwerty
reviews.title: Great views, but leaves a lot to be desired. Not luxurious....
reviews.text:
Awesome location, Lovely views.
But for the price, not worth it.
No free wifi.

There is a general sense of stuffiness in the entire hotel. Many places you feel that you can smell sh**. Suddenly from somewhere you can smell this funny thing. It is all prevalent. From the toilets in rooms, to the lobbies, in the spa, everywhere.

The rooms are smallish. But well appointed. Again circulation of fresh air is not there. We had to keep the windows open, but at same time, close it every some while, because it got too cold.

The hotel has only one restaurant, and it gets really crowded. While service was very good, the food taste left a lot yo be desired. The hotel needs multiple dining options and definitely needs more covers. 

I think hotel realizes this and has placed about 15 covers just outside the restaurant to manage this, but 
A. It feels like you are eating on the street.
B. There is no service here.

The spa-pool area, also needs changes.
The swimming pool water looked dirty. I am not sure whether it looks dirty or is it actually dirty. But inspite of excellent setting, I didn't want to go in because of this.

The Spa by L'Occitane was ok. The area did not give a feeling of occasion. The room decor was not luxurious. The steam was not working properly inspite of changing the room.
While the massage itself was good, again the feeling of luxury was absent.

reviews.author: RohitSatiVini
reviews.title: The Khyber Paradise in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber is beautiful paradise in Gulmarg. I stayed in room no 2016 for two nights (19th& 20th May) with my wife and son. My experiences –
Don’t miss evening Kahwah and Tea in ‘Chaikash’ and beautiful view of snow covered hills of Pirpanjal range from ‘Chaikash’. 
‘Clove’ is beautiful restaurant its menu is filled with delicious, mouthwatering dishes. ‘Clove’ waiters are friendly loving persons, their affectionate behavior makes you very comfortable and gives homely feeling. Thanks to Chefs of ‘Clove’ for delicious breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Rooms are very comfortable with beautiful bathrooms and scenic views. 
‘Laundry’ don’t forget to tell them to clean your clothes properly, in hurry they forget to remove cloth stains.
Front office Mr Junaid is very cooperative, I forgot some article during check out, I had a telephonic talk with him after few minute telephonic talk he promised me to send it through courier. The Khyber is very caring.
The Khyber guide (Mr Javed phone no 09622716814) is awesome young man. He stood in Gulmarg Gandola ticket line at 4:45 am. He is a good skier, in phase 2 of Gandola he gave few good skiing lessons to my son. 
Take ATV ride from hotel or outside to see beautiful landscapes of Gulmargh.
Gulmarg is beautiful heaven in earth and The Khyber is its pearl. Looking forward to visit The Khyber in winters with family. Missing the sips of Kahwah and Pirpanjal range view from ‘Chaikash’.

reviews.author: Lovina B
reviews.title: Beautiful beyond words!
reviews.text:
The drive up to the property only became more and more awesome, the first look was simple 'WOW'. We were greeted with happy faces and breathtaking views. Every where you look, its simply amazing. 
The rooms were huge, the balconies had the view of the valley and the hills on either side. We were particularly lucky to have experienced both, a sunny day and the snowfall. The view changed dramatically from bright lush green pines to snow clad trees and frozen in time sights over our stay of 4 days. 
The service staff in the restaurant lacked training and weren't attentive at all but it hardly mattered as everything else more than made up for it. 
The hotel is spread over a large area and is beautifully made with wood and glass. The spa and pool is an exceptional experience. It was definitely the different views from the hotel that made it so special. 
Gulmarg (Kashmir), is certainly heaven as rightly said by the Persian poet, Amir Khusro, 'If there is paradise on the face of earth, It is this, it is this, it is this!' 
"Agar firdaus bar roo-e zameen ast, Hameen ast-o hameen ast-o hameen ast"

reviews.author: Ashish S
reviews.title: Excellent property with a poor service
reviews.text:
No doubt the property is itself a part to get explored like gulmarg.
Very beautiful property with such a brilliant view of the interior lounge, lobby, and many antiques wodden crafted things much more.
But thats a part of a 5 star property at the same time it's more important how the guest are treated we felt like the management head were in too much of attitude.
Staying here was a like a prison with many rules to be followed likewise had to go long way for smoking secondly the connectivity doors from swimming pool to the rooms are closed had to walk as if we are on tracking.
We complained of some chemical solution sprayed on wooden furniture  ( as of the entire property is made of wooden things and great wooden carving) but the person denied and even dint changed the rooms.
No doubt the food is excellent I rate it 5 star.

But after all dissatisfaction is more.

Remember it's a business promoted by word of mouth I was recommended by my cousin who visited in 2015 but I don't feel like advising any one.

reviews.author: Yash1977
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.text:
A stunning property. Great location. Beautiful rooms and views of the majestic Himalayas. Very luxurious interiors in our room. They also have a warm swimming pool and gym overlooking the mountains. Location also close to the gondola ride. Walking distance in fact. 

They don't serve alcohol but are fine with people carrying their own alcohol and consuming it in a nice room off the main lobby. 

They only flip side was the quality of the playing area for young children or toddlers. They could have invested a little more in getting better slides and swings for children. Additionally they have a play room which has a few screens, games (table tennis, carrom etc) and toys etc but given their location where they have heavy snow or rain this room needs to be focussed on a little more. Maybe some slides and other items for toddlers.  Additionally this room needs to be supervised as a lot of games and toys were in poor shape/broken. 

Food is excellent at their all day dining area.

reviews.author: vanesa01
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: Great  hospitality and luxurious room with breathtaking views. Perfect location especially if you want to go tothe Gulmarg gondola. Loved the spa and the massage was really awesome. This hotel  overlooks the snow clad mountains  of Mount Affarwat with pine and fir trees below- pristine beauty. Would love to visit during winter.

reviews.author: shar2210
reviews.title: Location location location!!
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel with amazing views.Its the place to stay in Gulmarg.
Easy walk to the ski lift and the cable car.
Its an uber luxurious place with a fantastic spa and pool
Well maintained well trained staff adn great food.
A winner all the way

reviews.author: Dhwanirshah
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text:
Definitely one of the best hotels I've ever been to in India. The view and hospitality were amazing. L'occitane spa is an absolute must for all spa lovers as its one of the best few spas In the country. 
There inhouse service is also very quick. I had a sprained ankle during my stay and the doctor was very kind to constantly come and check on me to make sure I was comfortable.

reviews.author: reetapatel
reviews.title: excellent holliday
reviews.text:
our stay at Hotel KHYBER was excellent. v stayed in suit with balcony over looking the snow clad mountains.Went for swimming in heated swimming pool, had sauna .The best part was u did not feel like leaving the premises atall. 
excellent breakfast n buffets. Very good, courteous  staff. Mr. Bilal  FNB head was very caring ,helpful, n looked after us so well..Our special thanks to him.
Even all the managers were always smiling n ready to help.Thoroughly enjoyed  our stay.

reviews.author: cigandhi
reviews.title: khyber is amazing place,
reviews.text: Khyber resort at gulmarg is excellent property, starting  from reception to all areas they score above every other resort, rooms are good and clean, food excellent. staff very cooperative and for jains there is no other place than this. you talk of any area they score excellent grade. one suggestion they should have one more restaurant if it is full you must plan your dinner nor you have to wait,and they should have one more lift to go down. I was there for 4 days with group and enjoyed stay.

reviews.author: Nikhil Shah
reviews.title: The Khyber @ Gulmarg Kashmir
reviews.text:
Its a fabulous property with breathtaking views. Excellent staff , service and very good spread of vegetarian food. The staff at the restaurant is extremely warm and very helpful and makes sure to make every meal of yours complete and fulfiling. Impeccable service by every person in the restaurant especially Bilal, Iqbal Bhat and Ganganesh. Even if you are travelling with children the meal options are very good. 
Excellent facilities, superb spa , heated swimming pool. It was really once in a life time experience when we were in the heated pool and we could see the snow falling outside.

reviews.author: Pramod L
reviews.title: heavenly hotel in middle of mountains
reviews.text: Excellent place nestled in the middle of the mountains.The mountain view rooms have a magnificent view of the snow clad mountains.Food is quite good and the property is well maintained.The staff makes sure that the stay is memorable.One advice to the hotel is to have some live music playing at the lobby or restaurant.

reviews.author: Richa C
reviews.title: Superb location!
reviews.text: Excellent overall experience! Very comfortable rooms, excellent service, great food and very super location! Hospitality was par excellence. From the management team Manzoor and Basharat were always present in the lobby to personally take care of every guest. Could not have chosen a better place to celebrate our 41st wedding anniversary

reviews.author: MenonRajeev
reviews.title: Great Place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed at the Khyber for 4 nights. Since this was our first trip to Kashmir, the expectations were very high and we were not disappointed.  The rooms were quite spacious to accommodate a family of 4 (extra bed included).  The view from the room was simply amazing.  The indoor heated swimming pool was definitely a hit with the kids.  The best part of the hotel is its location.  Buffet is expensive for the spread that they have.  Staff were courteous and helpful and we enjoyed our stay at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: sheen c
reviews.title: Elegant, Romantic stay...
reviews.text:
Stayed 2 nights in last July with my wife.  I loved not to sleep to enjoy the moments.....
Perfect architecture that suits to the area, friendly staff, better facilities and the food is awesome. In total excellent..

reviews.author: nikunj b
reviews.title: Very beautiful property and excellent service
reviews.text: Great place to stay and very near the Gondala. .Kids play area could be better located and more  lively.The interiors are beautiful and rooms spacious. Very good indoor pool. Courteous staff and good check out timings - 12 noon.

reviews.author: ruchika thakur
reviews.title: Haven in the mountains
reviews.text:
Nestled in the deep woods , the Khyber is located at the foot hills of the snow clad mountains . It gives you the illusion of actually being in the midst of snow and the perfect central heating allows you the best of both worlds- the comfort of waking up to the snow enveloped in the warmth of your room. 

The majestic entrance has kept the Kashmiri architecture in mind and the extensive use of wood adds a warm glow to the property. 
The rooms are spacious nd the balconies offer outstanding views . The sunk in bath tub overlooking the woods is the highlight of the room . 

The restaurant has a decent buffet , but the Wazwan was not upto the mark . The tabak Maas was dry and rubbery , the gravies were too thick and oily . The Haaq saag was excellent though . For us , the best was the trout which we ordered for starters . 
The kids had white sauce pasta which was excellent . The hotel does not serve alcohol , though they do allow you to have your own in the Hooka bar /-without corkage charges. 
The service was good 

It is located close to the  Gondolas .

reviews.author: Mukesh Mundra
reviews.title: A perfect hotel to spend quality time
reviews.text: A very well maintained property with amazing view. A must stay property. We stayed here for two days and the stay was amazing. The restaurant has pretty decent choices on a-la carte as well in buffet.

reviews.author: RajanCShah
reviews.title: Amazing Property! Stunning Location!! Simply Perfect !!!
reviews.text:
This is easily one of the most beautiful hotels that I've stayed in. We stayed in there for 2 Nights and 3 Days..... and I must mention that it was a very pleasant and satisfying experience.

The Location and The Hotel Property - The best part of the hotel is it's location. It is simply amazing. One can have breathtaking views from around the hotel. The rooms were just perfect. Rooms have great decor, perfect size, all the modern amenities that a 5 start hotel should provide. Rooms have great views of snow clad mountains dotted with pine trees.

Activities - There are plenty of activities available. The best one is indoor heated swimming pool!! The pool is located in a glass room with view of the snow just outside!! This is the most amazing and unique feature of the hotel. The hotel has a separate game room for activities like TT, Pool Video Games etc. They also provide board games on request. The hotel also has a nice hookah bar where one can just chill with hookah.  There is a lot of activities to do in the hotel.

Food - We had opted for a plan inclusive of breakfast and dinner. Both are provided in a buffet format. The food is delicious. The spread is also reasonable. Just felt that the restaurant size is a bit too small and under-staffed, resulting in slow service during rush time.

Staff - The staff is pretty courteous and pleasant. They are polite and helpful. The service is great. We reached the hotel way too before official check-in time and the staff obliged by giving us early check-in. What I noticed that the staff is really concerned about the experience guest gains and they always vie to make it pleasant for them. This is so commendable!! 

Overall - Khyber is easily one of the best hotels that I've stayed in. Had a great, relaxing an extremely pleasant stay. Will definitely return here - may be in different season, to enjoy great hospitality and location of this hotel.

reviews.author: travelindia09
reviews.title: The Khyber completes Gulmarg!
reviews.text: Just back from a 5 day trip to Gulmarg and Srinagar. Having heard a lot about the Khyber our expectations were high.. but the property managed to meet all our expectations and much more! Gulmarg without the Khyber is nothing but the gandola and rides on the donkeys! A fantastically done up property with to die for views of the Himalayas from all sides... The staff are super... special kudos to their attitude and their service quality. The Kashmiri food preparations were very good and by and large except for their fish items, the food was top class... If you plan on going to Gulmarg, definately stay at the Kyber... it beats all the other properties hollow!

reviews.author: Rumanaachwa
reviews.title: Excellent !!
reviews.text:
I stayed here for 2 nights with my husband. It's the best property at Gulmarg. It's very clean, comfortable and truly luxurious. The rooms and bathrooms are very well equipped and spacious. The staff is very polite, friendly and efficient . They have an excellent in house doctor, who lives on the property itself and his services are complimentary from the hotel. My husband fell ill during our stay from a kidney stone , and the doctor was extremely efficient not only in his diagnosis but also in his treatment, because of which our trip wasn't cut short in any way. Their premier indulgence room has breath taking views of the mountains in the distance and it was particularly magical during our stay because it had begun to snow. 
But on the downside, the food at the Kyber is terrible. We ordered a chicken quiche, from their pastry and savoury counter, and it was inedible. Even the food in their restaurant was poor. The mutton biryani , we ordered was more like mutton curry mixed with rice, while the quality of their buffet was way below par and shockingly over priced. All in all, Kyber is a wonderful luxurious resort and definitely worth a stay. But until they do not improve the quality of their food, you're better off eating else where.

reviews.author: Malini N
reviews.title: A gem on the snow capped peaks!
reviews.text: The Khyber Resort is truly a gem set in the beautiful Gulmarg. If you visit when Gulmarg is a beautiful breathtaking white magic carpet around you, and in the midst of it is set a beautifully crafted warm haven called the Khyber! Wood has been painstakingly crated throughout this hotel to give it warmth and natural ambiance of comfort. The warmth of the staff is another reason to stay here. The lobby is designed in traditional decor and the round, large heritage seating arrangements with cushions makes you want to curl up with a book and just relax. The hotel is a short walk away from the skiing centre and the famous cable car ride. The rooms are cosy yet royal and the balcony is a treat where you can watch the snowfall if you are lucky to have one, and take some amazing pictures. The authentic Kashmiri food and especially the meat preparations are a must try. Amazing indeed, served lovingly by the staff. A hotel  you will regret checking out of! If you are in Gulmarg Khyber is the place to stay.

Another strange thing was that the rooms had only heating facilities, not air conditioning. so no fresh air was coming in at night, and it would get pretty stuffy. The alternative was opening the windows. But that was a security issue on the lower floors. 
Also a library would be very welcome. Also, free wifi would be very welcome. The paid wifi was pretty steep

reviews.author: samirtrip
reviews.title: overhyped resort in the hands of unprofessional managers
reviews.text:
Khyber is a good property given its location and decent size. There aren't better option in and around Gulmarg either. However, it does lack the quality levels of other bigger players like Taj Vivanta and Lalit in Srinagar.

The worst experience I had was about its non-transparent policy. We had booked our rooms online through hotel about 45 days in advance and we were offered Rs. 21,000 for their premier category on EP which we found was being offered at Rs.19,000 by the hotel. When we inquired about this, one of the managers at the reception suggested we must book through a travel agent in order to get  the discount. The other said the hotel changes rates daily. They had no justification for the variation and were only trying to avoid the conversation. The desk manager was unfriendly and uncooperative. 

Moreover, considering the tariff the rooms were too small and stinking. For someone who  does not want to go hiking/skiing or do any outdoor activities there is no point in staying at Gulmarg and/or Khyber. If one is only interested in experiencing the Gondola ride and visit the highest point, it is better to make a day trip from Srinagar which has better hotels and packages than Khyber for sure. Both Vivanta and Lalit are a lot better options than Khyber. It would be criminal to spend more than Vivanta at Khyber.

Even while visiting the level 1 & 2 by Gondola, be careful about the full on cheating by the ski taxies (They transfer you to a short distance 400/500 mtrs on ski) which demand absurd amounts like Rs. 4000 per person. It is not worth spending more than Rs. 400 (four hundred). They try hard to scare you by talking about the adversities of the place, but one can easily walk down this distance. Please do not spend more than Rs. 500 on ski transfers.

reviews.author: arm648
reviews.title: Great place for a weekend getaway
reviews.text:
Our family of 5 stayed at the Presidential Cottage at Khyber for 4 nights. Overall, I would rate the stay as a value for money 4.5/5 star. It was a perfect weekend out in the mountains of Kashmir and we will definitely be returning soon.  I think the fact that the property is not part of a large major chain meant that they were not able to take advantage of the decades of luxury hospitality experience that fine hotel chains such as a Four Seasons, St. Regis or Relais and Chateaux would bring. Although some of the names I mentioned above would charge much more per night for a similar property but you would also expect to get a lot more. I feel that although for the money they charge, they fall within the top few properties in India, but if they truly want to be recognised amongst the best (and there is a lot of potential), a little more work needs to be done. In summary:

Positives:

1. One of the biggest reason we enjoyed our stay at Khyber was because of our butler Sameer. Sameer put in 16-18 hour days for the entire duration of 4 nights to make sure every little request from morning to night was met. He seemed to go out of his way to make sure we were comfortable. He was there to help us all the time. All we needed to do was lift our heads and look towards him and he was there before we could even lift our finger. Whether it was ordering room service, setting up the table, serving us, placing an order in the busy restaurant, helping us organize spa treatments, making sure we knew our way around, he was there all the time. 

2. The cottage was luxuriously appointed with 3 spacious bedrooms and bathrooms, large balconies (with 2 rooms) and a garden. The silverware and crockery was high quality and the dark wood panelled decor gave the apartment the feel of a high end European ski resort.

3. The property was large with lots of things to do both in and out. It was located at a walking distance to the cable gondolas which would take us higher up in the mountains where we could find snow. 

4. The front office manager and most of the staff seemed extremely courteous.

5. The food was good and there was a lot of variety (Chinese, Asian, Punjabi, Kashmiri, Italian).

Negatives:

1. I found most of the staff in the spa not trained enough to manage guest expectations. The changing rooms next to the pool area was badly maintained with water spewn all over the floor (I almost slipped a couple of times) and the jacuzzis were not functioning. I had a little incident in the spa. I feel at the level at which they desire to be, meeting guests needs (even though guests are sometimes wrong) should be a priority. As a guest paying the kind of money we were paying, I dont expect to be told that I cant have a head neck and back massage for 60 minutes because the head and neck treatment is 45 mins and the back option has to be for 30 minutes, nothing more nothing less. I was told that  either I would have to pay for 75 minutes even though my treatment would be 60 or select a 30/45 minute option. To be fair I was at fault for reporting late but at a service oriented 5 star property, 9 out of 10 times, the staff wouldnt argue about this and just satisfy the guest. The 2000 rupees didnt make a difference to me and neither would it make a difference to the hotel but it didnt speak the attitude of a truly exceptional hotel.

2. The bathroom in the bedrooms was not properly air-conditioned and most of the time, it was absolutely freezing and uncomfortable. I hope they would install some sort of heating before the arrival of the winter. 

3. The room description mentioned that there was a heated jacuzzi in the room but we were very disappointed to see that the jacuzzi was all ripped out due to some maintenance. Now ordinarily this wouldnt be a problem, but as a guest I expected to be told about this during the booking itself and not while being shown around the room the first time. 

Overall the property exceeded expectations and I hope to return soon. I complement the owners and managers of the property to be able to run a great operation such as this.

Regards,

Abhishek.
