reviews.author: monica j
reviews.title: Luxury without deliverance!
reviews.text:
I came back last month from an enthralling & rejuvenating holiday with my husband, in Kashmir. It was on our list for quite sometime, so we booked everything including accommodation, transport, tickets & some sightseeing, in advance. Though it was just the beginning of the tourist season, we were witness to traffic jams, queues, stampedes & cacophony all around us! God save those who plan on visiting in the high tourist season(may to july)! 

Lets talk about the great Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg, which claims itself to be the only 5 star property in the whole of Jammu & Kashmir state! 

Nestled in the Himalayan mountain ranges with striking views of the Affarwat Peaks in Gulmarg, India, it is no doubt a luxury property. It lies 65 kilometres away from Srinagar Airport ( 3 hour drive ) on top of a hill with views to die for(specially in winters)! The resort has eighty rooms, four luxury cottages and a Presidential Suite each with breath-taking views of the Affarwat Peaks and of the valley. Out of the 3 categories of rooms, the premier, premier mountain view & the luxury balcony rooms, we stayed in the luxury room with a grand balcony. There are several dining options like their restaurant called Cloves with splendid views, Nouf a covered deck to enjoy cosy meals besieged by breath-taking sights of the snow covered mountains, Chaikash a tea lounge with myriad flavours of teas to choose from & Calabash the cigar & Sheesha lounge. The Khyber Spa by L’Occitane is one of India’s most luxurious and holistic well-being spas, again with magnificent view. One cannot spend a dull moment in this imposing environment as a whole lot of recreational activities awaits you such as a fully dedicated area for children called the Igloo, a stupendous heated indoor swimming pool, gymnasium, game area for adults so on so forth. But for me everything ceases to importance if one fails to deliver!

They might have been recognised for their outstanding service delivery by the World Luxury Hotels, but I doubt it was the opinion of the guest or the staff itself! On this wise, in all humility & complete fairness, I express my analysis of the Khyber Himalayan Resort as follows: 

1. There were security screening machines installed at the entrance without people to operate them. My husband & I were not greeted upon arrival nor was there an inspection for security of persons, only for the baggage. I saw used overcoats just lying on the ground at the entry steps without being taken care off or noticed! I asked one of the guards if mine will be treated similarly! When we entered the resort, we were asked to identify the luggage, which my husband did. Then while we were waiting for the room, another person came & asked to identify the luggage, so I went & did so. It was the height of patience when another of the staff asked us a third time to identify the baggage! It shows the lack of communication among the staff! They seriously need training!!

2. The check-in time was 2:00 pm but we arrived an hour prior. Understanding the scenario we calmly waited, had buffet lunch & approached at the reception after an hour. While I was clicking pictures of the entrance I noticed that they are a part of the SLH group so I asked the reservations guy to upgrade my room. This took another 45-50mins & we were escorted by Ms.Shivangi to our room. This waiting for 2 hours killed us & wasted more than half of our day! Nevertheless, we checked in our luxurious room with a balcony & found it super comfortable & welcoming with respect to the freezing cold outside!

3. We took wi-fi for 24 hrs by paying INR.750, which we later realised didn't work for most of the time. Also, the sliding door between the dressing area & bathroom was completely broken! 

4. When we went to the restaurant to eat lunch where I met a family from Mumbai who were guests there as well. We immediately struck a conversation & they told me about the menu being repeated everyday. Like the manchow soup was served a day before & was repeated the day after. There was less choice for vegetarians for the outrageous price. Also, I did not find the food to the standard of a luxury class hotel. I went & informed this to Mr.Manzoor, who was at the front office & asked to be spoken to someone responsible. He said he will send someone to speak to me regarding the same, but in vain. I asked twice, but no one bothered to attend to me. In my opinion, he is seriously in need of proper training from a branded corporate organisation. This is absolutely not expected of this kind of a property. If it was Taj or Oberoi....immediate action would have been taken with the staff personally taking responsibility. 

5. I usually work on my machine in the night where I require to use the internet. I tried to connect several times but it was futile. Hence I called the reception, who transferred me to the IT department. After explaining the problem, he informed me that he cannot help me as everything seems to be alright at his end! I wonder why they charge for something they cannot deliver!

6. In the morning we looked forward to the breakfast, only to experience a bolt from the blue! It was pathetic! I ordered a masala dosa( a south Indian pancake made from rice batter), which was not even close to be called a dosa....very chewy with bland chutney! Then I tried my hands on parantha( an Indian shallow fried bread), it was hard as a rock! The food was cold, tasteless & disgusting! I again called the staff to make them aware of the situation....but no one was suited to handle the situation. 

7. We wanted to enjoy a swim in the inviting pool but as we didn't carry our costumes we couldn't. But I observed a couple of children & adults swimming in the pool without costumes. I asked for explanation but they just cleared the air saying we cannot do anything, as they do not listen to us! That was very convincing!!!

8. I am a traveller & a photographer who want to bring back places, people, destinations, cultures & a profusion of elements to the less travelled, confined at home. So I approached Mr.Manzoor again to let me have a person escort me, show around the property & photograph it. Apparently that didn't happen either. 

9. A warning for those taking for granted that this property being a 5 star luxurious one would serve alcohol....let me speak loud & clear, " this property does not have a bar or a liquor license ", so be prepared! 

10. Another letdown which came as shock to us later was the situation of transportation once we reached the hotel in Gulmarg. We were not informed of the fact that one cannot move in & around Gulmarg in an vehicle which is registered outside of Gulmarg. Even the hotel people cannot let their vehicle for travel within Gulmarg. So we either need to walk, take an ATV(all terrain vehicle, super expensive!) or hire a local car. 

11. This, what I am about to tell is rather unusual. Everytime a member of the staff went pass us in the hotel grounds, they acknowledged the presence of my husband only greeting him, hello sir, good morning sir...blah, blah & NOT ME! I don't understand why? I have noticed this for the first time in my life! 

Overall, it is a great option to stay in Gulmarg during winters for the location, view, snow, heating & indoor recreational activities, ONLY IF THEY IMPROVE UPON THEIR SERVICE, COMPETENCY, ATTITUDE & STAFF!

reviews.author: harmanchd
reviews.title: Luxury at its vey best
reviews.text: One of the most luxurious places i have ever been. Its totally worth every penny you spent there. The khyber Himalayan Resort and spa is situated at a walking distance from gondola. Gondola is a must visit place if you are traveling to gulmarg. It is the 2nd highest rope-way in the world.

reviews.author: Akshay B
reviews.title: Beautiful Wooden Palace
reviews.text: We Checked in here for a night, there's no dearth of wood here, wood paneled walls, wood floors, stairs and so on. The main attraction of this place is balconies where you can enjoy stunning views of beautiful Gulmarg. There's also a SPA in this property which have a heated swimming pool, sauna and Jacuzzi pool. My family was quite excited about this idea of swimming in a pool when temperatures out side are quite low. And we enjoyed Jacuzzi pool and steam in sauna room as well. But swimming pool was laced with access of chlorine, and quality of water was bad as well, which left our eyes burning even after few hours of swim. Another painful experience was their sole lift was not working at all, made our experience of staying here quite  tiring. There is no doubts this property is excellent, though they need to manage it in a more professional way.

reviews.author: meenakshee
reviews.title: great location. more interesting during winters may be with skiing going around.
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is great, since its just a 10 mins walk to the gondola that takes you up to phase 1 and phase 2. Walking down to the gondola is easy and also the way to nearby places for walk is great. the rooms were great with great views .loved it. i enjoyed sitting around reception lounge area and reading books on kashmir. stay was for 2 days.they also have kids area where kids enjoyed. liked it but quite expensive resort.I think it will be much more fun to visit this place in winters as its close to skiing area.food was great but quite expensive compared to VIVANTA TAJ,KASHMIR which was much more affordable.

reviews.author: nandini1571
reviews.title: Felt duped
reviews.text: As for most travellers, booking was done personally. During booking thru mail, the reservation team insisted that we have to take an extra room since room size being small, extra bed cannot be accomodated. We agreed, but on arriving, realised that room size was fine. On speaking to the manager on duty, a mass of denials and false assurances like "enjoy your stay, we will take care of this next time, Yes, extra bed could have been accomodated etc" were made. We felt duped as the money involved was appreciable. One does not expect this kind of cheap tactics from places like these. Pl always verify before booking specially couples travelling with kids.We lost an appreciable amount of money.

reviews.author: ananya s
reviews.title: Heaven is a place on earth
reviews.text:
We went to Khyber Himalayan at Gulmarg for a quick getaway weekend from Bombay and what a pleasant surprise! The hotel exceeds all expectations in terms of amazing hospitality and best in luxury. It is a slightly heavy on the pocket but the expense is worth it! The staff is extremely helpful and polite. The check-in was a breeze and the Kahwa served on arrival is welcome given the freezing temperatures outside. 

One must try the L'occitane Spa at the resort, which is one of the best I have been to (better than the Bombay 5 star spas). Tip: You should book it on arrival since it tends to get booked very quickly. 

Tip: Carry your swimsuits because the Hotel has an amazing indoor heated pool which you wouldn't wanna miss. Yes, I am talking about swimming while its snowing outside. The Concierge can arrange for Gondola tickets and Skiing instructors on request. 

Even though the buffet has a good variety, I believe that the hotel can improve on food. Tip: Take your own liquor because they have not yet received a liquor permit so the hotel doesn't serve alcohol. You must definitely try the Hookah Lounge, if you take your music and small speakers, they even let you play your own music (ask other's around you of course, before you do :)), you can sit there was as long as you want and no one will ask you to leave. 

The rooms are beautifully decorated and they have thought of the smallest of things. The hotel has ornate interiors and lots of nooks and corners to sit and have a warm cup of tea while lazing around with a book and a view of the snow capped peaks. Believe it or not, they have an in-house doctor who will even attend to you in the middle of the night if you have the smallest of headaches! That's the level of hospitality these guys offer.

All in all, if you looking for luxury amidst the most beautiful surroundings, Khyber Himalayan Resort is the place to go. World class standards, superb location, warm hospitality, simply outstanding!

reviews.author: Priyavrat Jhunjhunwala
reviews.title: Great Luxury Hotel
reviews.text:
The location of this hotel is great, since its just a 10 mins walk to the gondola that takes you up to phase 1 and phase 2. Walking down to the gondola is easy, but keep in mind, the walk back to the hotel is a steep up hill climb. The rooms themselves were large and spacious. The views of the mountain are spectacular. We visited when there was still plenty of snow around, as a result of which, the views were great. In terms of luxury it is definitely one of the best properties I have stayed at in india.
The food at the hotel is good, however, it is a bit on the expensive side (typical 5 star rates).
I used the spa for a foot massage. The spa attendants were well versed with the techniques and I found it very relaxing.
We were there for two nights and enjoyed every bit of it.
DO NOTE: To get your car up to the resort, you need  a printed confirmation from the hotel. The hotel may deny it, but the security at the main entrance to the gulmarg area will not allow you to get your car/taxi inside if you do not have this confirmation.

reviews.author: Nitin K
reviews.title: best place in gulmurg
reviews.text: We spent two night at this lovely resort which has beautiful interiors as well as the spa was also very very relaxing. Just was not very happy with the food, might be because of the hotel running on full capacity.

reviews.author: asunnylife
reviews.title: Superb Resort
reviews.text:
One of the best resorts in India I have stayed in! The swimming pool was under maintenance! Waiting to go back again. 

I wish they'd take over the Gulmarg Gondola station next to it and also make that experience as pleasant as their hotel!

reviews.author: ar_anupammittal
reviews.title: awesome but incomplete
reviews.text: Strange but true. The Khyber is just awesome property, one of the best wooden cladded castle I have ever visited and enjoyed every corner of it. During our stay last summer, we stayed there for three nights and could realize after first day sight seeing that the place must have much to offer with in he property so started looking for swimming pool, Spa, steam etc but surprisingly nothing was functioning and we were told that the work was on and could not be delivered this season. Since we had nothing else to do, we choose the entertainment room/ theater room for kids at least, that was good but overtly booked in absence of other amenities. I sincerely hope that the same has been taken care and one must check with them before booking this year.

reviews.author: jbee
reviews.title: In the lap of luxury
reviews.text: The khyber has a breathtaking view of snow capped mountains. Rooms are luxurious . Staff is friendly and hospitable. Breakfast spread is awesome. Sadly elevators never work. During my 2 day stay elevators were nonfunctional and we had to climb 3 floors up and down to lobby level . The dinner buffet is very expensive at Rs1700 per person .  While booking please request for lobby level rooms or else keep climbing. Play area has limited games. Pool is fab and temperature controlled. Worth visiting.

reviews.author: Sathyam R
reviews.title: Oasis in snow
reviews.text:
Khyber with its green roofs and timber walls contrasts well against the backdrop of white snow.
The rooms are spacious with touches of local linen and woodwork. The views from some of the rooms are breath taking. Most guests stay here for couple of nights during summer using it as easy access to the gondola ride, apart from that there is little to do here. There are no restaurants within walking distance so you dine in most of the time. The food is Ok but special mention must be made of Samir and Muzafir at the Cloves restaurant who went beyond the norm in taking care of us

reviews.author: Vinita2601
reviews.title: Gorgeous and Grand
reviews.text: Khyber is everything you have been told. Beautiful and grand. I loved the location and the views. However the best part was the temperature control system... if you are in the resort the outside temperature will not bother you at all. They have used some beautiful Kashmiri design elements in the interiors of the resort. Loved the woodwork, the silks and the carpets. The staff was very helpful. Avoid the l'occitane spa... well made but poor therapists.

reviews.author: Nareshparekh
reviews.title: Excellent view and great location
reviews.text:
Location : Excellent location can walk down to gondola.
Staff : Very very helpful and polite staff.
Rooms : Big and comfortable.As Gulmarg was experiencing snowfall the view was of snow al around the resort.Have an excellent climate control and hence never felt cold anywhere in the hotel premises.
Food : Need to add more variety in the buffet as it is not value for money as the cost compared to other 5star is very high.
Amenities : A very good heated swimming pool and billiards table.Children centre toys or games were non functional a turn off for children.

Worth a stay would surely visit once again with complete family.

reviews.author: punyapanday
reviews.title: Classy and Luxurious  !!!
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber for 2 nights and we found it to be very Luxurious and classy  . Right from the lobby to the rooms were very well done up and the view from the coffee shop and rooms was  excellent . Staff was very cooperative - at reception  Mr Zafar and Miss Preet were great at their job . While Mr Shyam ( F & B Head ) and his team were superlative at the restaurant . My Son is a fussy eater and they made everything he asked for despite of the rush  . 

The hotel was at almost 100% occupancy and the staff put extra effort in meeting the needs of all the guests . 
We were there for our anniversary and they  decorated the room and got a nice cake for us for our special occasion   . 

The swimming pool was not functional which was a put off but the rest was great  . 

Thanks to the team for making our stay special  .

reviews.author: CFerns
reviews.title: Perfect Hotel, best location in Gulmarg but lacking service
reviews.text: I and my family really loved the hotel. The entire hotel surroundings were covered with snow during out stay and you wake up to a beautiful view of the Afarwat mountains from the hotel windows. The overall service wasn't up to my expectation compared to the hotel star status and room rates. The hotel climate control seemed to have some problem with some kind of bad stench at times. To make matters worse, the elevators were not working. I also had a problem with their reservation. My reservation included 2 adults and 2 kids but they charged me extra for a child citing problems with their reservation system when I didn't even ask for extra bed. Maybe they were right but from my perspective it's unethical practice not to show accurate charges at reservation time. The restaurant staff were the only saving grace. Overall the hotel is good value for money with the view, proximity to the cable car, the heated pool and enough entertainment for kids.

reviews.author: Jennifer Lobo
reviews.title: A perfect getaway in the lap of LUXURY!!!
reviews.text:
the Khyber Gulmarg was everything it promised to be. Opulent , luxurious, warm and splendid. Right from its fabulous lobby to the breathtaking view from the terrace to its spacious and lavishly done up rooms, absolute delight!!

Khyber also serves one of the best Kawah in Kashmir which is also the welcome drink. Children were engaged thanks to the entertainment zone, indoor pool and the SNOW all around the property. Its proximity to the Gandola is a plus and makes the visit convenient.

The restaurants serve delicious meals be it breakfast or dinner, the service too is excellent. Our stay was made more comfortable thanks to the warm and well trained staff. Special mention to Mr Zaffar from the front desk who made it a point to look after our well being.

Khyber is a perfect getaway for those seeking peace and tranquility amidst the lap of luxury. Sure to come back again in December - Jan to enjoy snowfall.

reviews.author: mukulsGurgaon
reviews.title: Most beautiful resort with a splendid view
reviews.text: Khyber is a beautiful resort very tastefully decorated, food could have been better, breakfast spread was good, rooms excellent and specially the paper mache wall and excellent room size with lovely balcony and furniture. Bathrooms were very good. Beds very comfortable.

reviews.author: RahulP
reviews.title: Luxury amidst snow!!
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying - this was one of my best trips & credit goes to Kashmir & Khyber!

Our journey with khyber started with a small glitch - we faced some difficulties at the time of booking - the manager who was co-ordinating with us on mail went unwell & hence there was lack of communication. but it was later sorted out. we were sent pick up cars to Srinagar apt on time & good vehicles. The driver was very good & courteous. we were blessed with heavy snowfall on our way!! at the entrance of gulmarg we were stopped by locals (I guess taxi union) to show our reservations. as the papers were with my other friends who were in another car we were made to made there in heavy snowfall for 20 minutes. again a small area of improvement for the resort

Once we reached the resort it was bliss - nicely built, excellent décor, courteous staff. the rooms are well laid out. the best part is the resort occupies a large area & hence we played in snow in the resort itself. our kids enjoyed the snow at its best!! they have a small verandah outside the main lobby where the kids made snowman! the rooms were awesome, beautiful bathroom, excellent TV connection, good hot water.. I was impressed by the kind of services they were providing in this extreme climate! the rooms had lovely views of snow & long trees.. what a sight! the swimming pool was lovely- it is surrounded by full glass enclosure.. again what a beautiful setting.. though providing a heated swimming pool itself is commendable i would advise the resort to work on making the heating more strong..  the kids playing area igloo was superb. good facilities. but a big downside - the area was not heated!! it was very cold for the kids there.

now for some downsides - the resort charges for Wi-Fi. being a luxury 5 star it should provide free wifi. the food is really average for a vegetarian. they should include more varities & work on to suit indian tastes. the in-room, swimming pool & Igloo heating should be more strong. 

All in all a lovely experience!

reviews.author: Rahul R
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
The staff and the interiors of the hotel are the best I have seen till date in this country.... must stay hotel when visit to Gulmarg. .....

Thanks to Mr. Zaffar and Ms. Preth for the wonderful welcome and stay they provided.

In a line.... worth spending time in The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa.

reviews.author: 160EXPERIENCE
reviews.title: Our stay at Kyber last month
reviews.text:
Dear General Manager,

Would like to share our good experience at your Khyber hotel Gulmarg booking dates 24/04/2014 2 nights the booking name was Mr. & Mrs Parikh.
Please note:
1.	It is the best property in Kashmir
2.	Few staff where the breakfast was served were very good.
3.	Your staff at the main counter while checking in and checking out Mr. Zaffar Malik was extremely courteous, helpful, gave correct guidance for everything around, explained about the hotel property and always had a smile on the face which is what customers look at when you enter a property like yours or anywhere else. What a customer needs is a good care at the hotel and attend them with their questions / queries which Mr. Zaffar Malik did all in the best way he could! If your hotel has such staff then definitely customers like us will flow in without fail!

It would be really nice of your organization if such staff is appreciated and promoted for their best work!      

Thanking you and look forward to staying at your hotel next!

reviews.author: Bhavya H
reviews.title: Lovely interiors but non funtional lifts
reviews.text: The khyber is definitely worth a 4 or 5 star if not for the non functional lifts. We stayed in room no  6003 for which you have to climb or get down 6 fleets of stairs. It is nearly impossible if elders are travelling with  you. We stayed for 2 nights and 3 days and had a tough time  climbing up all the time. This is something you dont expect in a hotel of this standard and tariff most importanly.Please enquire before booking your room.The food was okay but the waiters were very disappointing. They took their own jolly time to get us our order.They lack hospitality. It was as if they were doing their duty to get home their salary. The property is really good but needs to be maintained by a professional. Rooms were fine. Bathroom was little congested , otherwise no complaints. It is really close to the gondola ride which is the main attraction in gulmarg. Anyway I loved the property and hope to see improvements in specified fields. Interiors are classy, Iust say. Good luck guys!

reviews.author: Jovita L
reviews.title: India's Best
reviews.text: I visited Gulmarg with a bunch of friends this January for a skiing trip. I have to admit that the Khyber is one of India's finest hotel properties. The interiors are gorgeous, the hospitality was brilliant and the food was super delicious. For skiers the location of the property makes it the best place to stay in Gulmarg. A special mention to Aditya Mata who took such special care of us and gave our stay that special touch.

reviews.author: Ferozgandhi
reviews.title: No views from hotel
reviews.text: We recently stayed in khyber gulmarg , though the hotel is new and good but the views from the hotel are average as you cannot see the gulmarg bowl open views. Highlands park which we went to check out offers the best views in town. Food specially for vegetarians is pretty average but service is god. Overall not recommended because of limited views the hotel offers.

reviews.author: Akash Choudhari
reviews.title: Amazing views...Good Hotel....
reviews.text:
Visited Gulmurg after 15 years with the family. There was still plenty of snow which was a pleasant surprise. 

The hotel is well located right next to the Gondola (which is nothing but the cable cars which takes you to the top of the mountain and probably best thing to do). The views are as good as you can get and it has a heated indoor poor with one of the best views you can image (full glass facing the mountains). Hotel rooms are good with greats views but slightly run down but nothing to complain about (probably in such extreme weather the wear and tear is going to be high). The Kashmiri food was very good but make sure you order well in advance (they took 40 mins to get the food). Also you need to have the Kava Tea in the coffee shop (overlooking the mountain) which was the best I have had in all the hotels and restaurants I visited in Kashmir.

I left my bag in the Srinagar airport and Staff was quite helpful in getting it for me. So overall a Good Experience.

reviews.author: Jeevan G
reviews.title: bliss at 8000 ft
reviews.text: I was very much excited about the stay in khyber since i thought of gulmarg trip and the hotel was more than everything i expected.Right from check in the staff were very great. The room is spacious and the view from my room was breath taking. The food is just awesome the restaurant staff were very good and helpful especially Muzzafar in cloves resaturant was very friendly overall iam looking forward for my next trip there

reviews.author: hsk s
reviews.title: Unbelievable Property at Gulmarg, Kashmir
reviews.text: If you want to have a feel of Switzerland in India, you must visit this property. Its heaven at 8800 feet above mean sea level. Rated as one of the best small Luxury Hotels in the world, this is an awesome Hotel with best in class facilities, F&B, Spa, Ice Skiing at winter and super cool Green at summer. With the travelling environment improving a lot in Srinagar, its a must visit Property for Holiday lovers. Double room starting at around INR13000/- per night is worth paying for such a nice place.

reviews.author: Friend2Travel
reviews.title: Breathtaking Views and Decor
reviews.text: The Khyber is a beautiful property, with a prime location. The Gondola ride is very near to the hotel. We were particularly impressed by the decor of the hotel & great views from our room as well as from the lobby.

reviews.author: khuku
reviews.title: Home away from Home!
reviews.text:
As soon as we entered the hotel, Shubhangi at the reception was surprised by our senior status & immediately gave us a room in the same floor, so we do not have to use the stairs! Such consideration to minor details justifies its name in the World's Small Boutique Hotels! In this hotel the staff addresses us by our names & knows us personally. 

Our rooms were very comfortable with a beautiful view of snow. Our children and grandchildren enjoyed the snow & all the fun that involves while we seniors enjoyed watching them. 
The food was very good & we had a great vacation bonding with our children & grand children! The staff went out of their way to give us this memorable holiday.

reviews.author: TheTravelLobby
reviews.title: VERY HIGH CLASS
reviews.text:
I booked this Hotel for my Guests with below reviews:

Amazing Place
Good Food
Very Good Housekeeping, Hospitality and Catering
Central Heating System is good
We just love staying in Khyber

KEEP IT UP!!!

reviews.author: Kanwarbs
reviews.title: Simply The Best
reviews.text:
Simple the best one can get. Amazing property, nice people. Everyone in the hotel greets you all the time whenever you cross. Zaffar engage well in case travelers reach before check in.

Simply Superb & Excellent !

reviews.author: ms14_delhi
reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: When I entered the hotel, I was greeted by a lousy guard who was not willing to pull out the luggage from the boot of my car. This just set the tone of the entire experience at this hotel. The front desk staff conveniently told me that I should have given them a call from the toll point for them to arrange for someone to pull out the luggage. I had a taken the basic room that costed 20k. No airport transfers or breakfast is included in the room fares. The room was small, I would say congested for the price I was paying. The bathroom was cluttered as well with a really small bath tub. The only positive about the hotel was the interiors. The carpets, woodwork, blanket seemed to be authentic kashmiri stuff. The view from the hotel is pretty average. All you can see from the room is a few pine trees. All in all, a below average room size and outside room view for a luxury 5* tourist hotel. The service is even worse. The phone in my room was not working, so was the DTH connection, the mini-bar was empty and the safe locked. I asked for a toothbrush in the morning that arrived after 45minutes. A DVD player which is available in the hotel never arrived in my 3 days of stay even after I asked for it repeatedly. The service was really poor with the staff taking 40minutes to make up the room when they came 30 minutes after being called. In short, the service is disappointing to the say the least. The hotel is absolutely not worth the pice. Avoid if you dont want to spoil your holiday.

reviews.author: jyotigupta105
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Situated in Gulmarg, Kashmir, this hotel was a 2.5 hour drive from Srinagar. The property is beautiful and a lot of wood has been used in its construction. The rooms facing the snow-covered mountains have a much better view so do specify in advance at the time of booking, else you might regret getting the other view. Although I was under the assumption, thanks to my travel agent, that there was a working spa, beauty salon and pool, I was a bit disappointed that these services have not yet begun and are still under construction and might start only from September 2013. I was looking forward to a relaxing time using the spa services and their indoor heated pool, but I guess that will have to wait for my next trip. Also, they can do a better job with the garden- there were hardly any flowers in bloom. The food is excellent- breakfast buffet, lunch and dinner, despite just one restaurant. The staff is very courteous, helpful and friendly. On reaching, we were served an excellent kashmiri kahwa. They have a small section in the lobby called 'chaikash' which is a station to serve all-day coffee, tea, snacks etc. and I enjoyed the lovely hot chocolate every day of my trip here. The hotel does not have a bar. Overall, a lovely hotel built in a beautiful region, surrounded by a view of snow-capped mountains. Away from the scorching 45 degrees heat of my hometown Delhi, it was a lovely change with perfect weather. Definitely recommend Khyber to all visiting Gulmarg

reviews.author: Gauri407
reviews.title: Unforgettable location, forgettable service
reviews.text:
The Khyber at Gulmarg is a beautifully designed hotel located most ideally facing the snow capped mountains on one side and the valley the other. The hotel itself is well designed in harmony with its surroundings. The rooms with a balcony over unparalleled views and should not be missed. Alas, if only the service was a match for the building.
We booked a room online through the hotel website for a two day stay. There are no options on the site for inclusion of meals or breakfast in the package so we thought we would get the details on arrival. Upon arrival, we were asked to pay for our first day of stay before we entered the room. 
So the plus points were the amazing location ( magnificent views) and the breakfast spread is both wide and scrumptious. 
On the desperately seeking improvement areas are the service and the infrastructure. 
Most importantly, on learning that there is a package which includes breakfast we went to the reception to request for it. Then we learned that the only people who knew about the packages were the ‘reservation people’ who were unavailable on phone but were on their way to speak to us. We waited for 10-15 mins after which we were told to go out and that they would call us. Upon our return in the evening, the same discussion took place. In the evening again we requested and again we were told that they were busy and that they had come to meet us when we had left. (This is the same person who told us to go and that the reservation person would call us). The details of the packages are available only to these people and the conditions on which you can switch from one to another depends on a ‘variety of reasons including mode of booking, time of booking, etc’. No apology was ever given for this behaviour. 
Also, while bathing, the water can move from warm to cool even without the power cuts. In a place like Gulmarg, this can be a bit problematic. The heating in the room on the first day took a good 3 hours to kick in. The turn down service which included water replenishments, etc. was offered only on the second day. The bathtub though beautifully designed was not cleaned during our two day stay. The food during lunch is okay and not a patch on breakfast. Even the traditional Kashmiri drink served on arrival is better at the market downstairs.
Given that the Khyber has positioned itself as a luxury hotel such quality of service was mildly shocking and even more so since it was running on 20-25% occupany during our stay.
Try and negotiate good rates for yourself if you plan to go sine the hotel is new and occupany is quite low.

reviews.author: IEatLOVEPray
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Our friend's booked us at The Khyber for our two night stay at Gulmarg. Nothing could have been more pleasant. The staff were efficient and friendly and the Kahwa at check-in was yummy given the chilly weather that evening. Breath-taking views  of snow-capped mountains and pine forest from every window of the resort - just magical. Rooms were well planned and spacious and I loved the cosy bathroom and the wooden flooring.  My only gripe was that spa and gym were not yet operational - sigh! There is one small set back in that there is only one restaurant in the whole resort! Having said that, the a la carte menu has a wide offering and the Chef is very hands on and accommodating. All staff from the doorman to the servers were excellent and ever so polite. Tariq and Deepak stood out at mealtimes where they took care of all 15 of us brilliantly!!

reviews.author: Nisha B
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: The hotel is situated inside Gulmarg and just 2 minutes from the popular Gondola ride. The property is big and is tastefully built. One can view the distant snow-capped peaks from the tea lounge, and beautiful pine trees and snow from the room/balcony. We received a warm welcome and the hotel upgraded us to luxury rooms for free which was a bonus. The rooms are spacious and truly luxurious. The service is prompt and up to the mark. Breakfast has good variety and can please most taste buds. The room tariff and the restaurant are both expensive, but I think that goes for most hotels in Kashmir. The hotel is a steep ride up and not comfortable to walk. One can ask for pick-ups and drops which is a wonderful addition to the service provided. A tip: To have outside cars inside Gulmarg, one needs to have hotel's booking voucher. Make sure you carry yours with you to avoid any hassle.

reviews.author: gvicky
reviews.title: "Fantasctic Hotel "
reviews.text:
I opted for Khyber Hotels in Gulmarg after reading favorable reviews by other travelers. I too was not disappointed. The staff was humble. The staff(from manager to cleanliness staff) will notice you and greet you even when you are roaming in the hotel gallery.
I stayed in Luxury Balcony Room. Though The Restaurant is not too spacious but the service staff maintained and manged the restaurant in a perfect way specially Rajeev & Deepak. We had a great time staying at the resort... The service was impeccable... 

The Food is bit expensive .
Room Tip: All the rooms have good view. This Hotel is in the middle of the valley.. so you will see great view.

reviews.author: ANAND Gulani
reviews.title: May 7th-May 9th, Luxury at its best !!!
reviews.text:
We started from Pahalgam towards Gulmarg and after having a hearty meal at Pine View Hotel Tangmarg, the climb of 13km to reach Gulmarg was just beautiful. Once we reached Gulmarg, we drove all the way in and up to reach the bestest property in Kashmir "Khyber Gulmarg", what a property. 

Check in welcome was so smooth and relaxing while sipping hot Kahwa and seeing the beautiful snowcap mountains was just fantastic
Gulmarg and Khyber really made me and my family feel really Euphoric, very very happy.
Location, food, service was simply fantastic and upto the mark

We loved this property so much even though the spa and pool were not yet operational, I can imagine what this will be once they are set rolling "Paradise in itself at Gulmarg"

We did both the levels by the Gondola and it was superb. We got a great guide Bilal arranged by the hotel and he really helped us a lot from the tickets to getting into the line to negotiating for the rides, taking to the best food at level 1, he was great. 

One can easily spend a week at this property by not stepping out, it has the needed expance, great location, breathtaking views and service.

Would like to really thank and mention Faheem Qureshi, Wasim Raja, Mithun Mandal, Suheel, Muddazar,Hamid and from the restaurant big thanks to Shyam, Deepak, Yatinder, Arun, Anu.
My cell phone was not working and I needed to make a couple of important calls and Mithun along with staff helped he there too which was much much much appreciated.

It was a pleasure to meet with mr Alex Koshy GM of the property and the owner Mr. Omar Tambroo and really thank them for their hospitality

ONLY +VES, NO -VES, THIS IS A DREAM HOTEL IN A DREAM LOCATION. IF YOU WANT THE BEST IN GULMARG, THERE IS ONLY ONE KHYBER THE SUPREME, YOU HAVE NO CHOICES AND YOU NEED NO CHOICES, IT IS KHYBER ALL THE WAY

reviews.author: friend777
reviews.title: The Hotel is just WOW..but........
reviews.text:
Good Luxury room, guess its the one of the best hotels i have stayed in my life  
View was good
Food was very bad and extremely expensive ( avoid eating there as it not worth at all )
we were charged Rupees 1600 for a buffet dinner with only veg food which was tasteless and with very few choice of starters and main course 
Fitness center and spa not started yet 
Its very close to the gandola ride
Service was very good
Staff were pleasant and helpful
Mobile phones dont work in this hotel as there is no network, Hotel Internet is usually not working

reviews.author: khan22
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
It's a review that comes with a red warning light...
The hotel is amazingly located and beautifully made. It is a place I would strongly recommend to anyone who wants to have a great time. Majorly wood,  some Glass, metal and papier mache interiors make you want to live there for a while before you move on.
RED ALERT: The food is horrible and EX..P..EnSiii...VE. If you are staying here try to either eat out or order basic meal. The taste is not worth half the price.
The staff is extremely pleasant. Tariq  from the hukkah bar is a knowledgeable young man who is also very kind to give you the right advice when asked for.
Deepak from the restaurant is pleasant and kind enough to make you comfortable and does his bit to make things easier for you.

reviews.author: Subodh V
reviews.title: Paradise in gulmarg
reviews.text:
My first trip to gulmarg could not Hv been better
We were fortunate to experience snow on first may which I am told is quite unusual
Coming to this beautiful property which has been recently opened our stay was extremely enjoyable
We occupied room no 2001 on the first floor which offers breathtaking views of the snow clad mountains .The rooms itself are large open with a large toilet which also has a view of the mountains.The only issue was the over heating of the rooms and difficulty in adjusting the temperature 
The reception area ,the lounge, and the cigar corner are all well located cozy with great views
The staff is still raw and need more training and polishing 
The food was good They do not Hv a Kashmiri chef and therefore the local cuisine was good but not outstanding
One negative issue was the non availability of Vodaphone signal in the hotel 
All in all a wonderful resort which will certainly invite repeat visits

reviews.author: asifwani21
reviews.title: just for lunch
reviews.text:
Slow service ...confused staff ...Restaurant is absolutely hopeless. Food is slow ... doesn't taste good. cold!Takes hours for everything. 
I was pissed off by their Food & Beverage service...and hell you are on top of a mountain so where else can u eat!
The staff is pretty new and the concept of service is not at par with other five stars in the state or elsewhere. 
Mobiles do not work in the hotel due to lack of network. 
Though the hotel has an excellent location and provides a great view of the afarwat mountain, 
the service was not good. The staff had to be reminded many times before they could serve us. 
The restaurant staff were not knowledgeable about the menu. 
Sadly, they did not provide us with the service and courtesy.
EXCELLENT VIEW!! Certainly the best in the gulmarg for the view.

reviews.author: Akhilchat
reviews.title: Excellent service, amazing property and feel at home atmosphere
reviews.text: This is the the hotel to stay in gulmarg, it may be expensive but worth every penny. One can book private theatre and longed if in big group. The food quality is good. The hotel has been made with lot of style and elegance.

reviews.author: Vinay290
reviews.title: not good experience.
reviews.text:
The hotel would have great potential they have Big beautiful rooms with stunning mountain view.

the hotel is near to Gondola but far from the market.

no bar, indoor pool, gym, spa are not in a working state & they are showing it on the internet, this was very disappointing and the room rates are high.

problem with the local people they are not allowing to take a cab to roam around which is disturbing & irritating because the hotel & Govt authorities seems to be doing nothing about it, they literally fought with us after we came back from gondola & spoiled our trip.

food is ok

Restaurant is overpriced.

service people seems to be confusing.
